plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-model-quota — 模型余额与额度面板

给 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面加一个「模型余额与额度」面板：侧栏底部常驻一张额度卡片，
点一下在右侧展开面板，逐行列出各供应商的**账户余额**或**套餐窗口（5 小时 / 每周 / 每月）
剩余百分比 + 重置时间**。默认只显示 DeepSeek Account，其余供应商一旦检测到已配置的凭据
就自动出现；`设置 → 额度面板` 里可以逐个开关。密钥只在宿主进程内使用，不下发浏览器。

![面板预览](tests/sandbox-shot.png)

![设置页](tests/sandbox-settings.png)

## 安装

### 方式一：GitHub Release（推荐，不需要 npm）

```bash
# 直接装这个 tag 的源码包（本机已实测可用）
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile 名> add https://codeload.github.com/Leafmy/dsh-model-quota/tar.gz/refs/tags/v1.0.0
```

或者从 [Releases](https://github.com/Leafmy/dsh-model-quota/releases) 下载 `dsh-model-quota-1.0.0.tgz` 再装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile 名> add ./dsh-model-quota-1.0.0.tgz
```

装完**完全退出并重开 DSH Desktop**（客户端半在启动时组装，刷新页面不够）。

升级：把 URL 里的 tag 换成新版本即可；先把旧版本移除更干净
（`dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-model-quota` 再 add）。

### 方式二：本地源码 / 手动安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add file:/绝对路径/dsh-model-quota
```

手动（不使用插件管理器）：

1. 把包放进 profile 的 `node_modules/`（复制或 junction 都行）：

   ```powershell
   New-Item -ItemType Junction `
     -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-model-quota" `
     -Target "C:\path\to\dsh-model-quota"
   ```

2. 在 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里加一行 `"dsh-model-quota"`。
3. 重启 DSH Desktop。

> 包自带的 `cordis.patch.yml` 已经 `insert` 了 `id: dsh-model-quota`。**不要在用户层再 insert
> 同一个 id**（重复 id 会让加载器起不来）；要改配置就在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里写一条
> 同 id 的覆盖行（见下面「配置」）。

## 兼容性

| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| **目标版本** | **DSH 0.2.1-rc.1** |
| 已实测兼容 | 0.2.1-rc.1（宿主路由 + DeepSeek Account + 侧栏卡片实测，2026-10-17）、0.2.0-rc.2（1.0.0 的验证基线） |
| 未做兼容承诺 | 其它版本未实测；升级 DSH 后建议照下面「依赖的缝」复核一遍 |

0.2.1-rc.1 上的实测证据：

- **宿主路由**：`/dsh-model-quota/api/summary`、`/settings`、`/providers` 均 200；
  `probe.seam = "inject"`、`lastResolveError / lastDescribeError / lastAccountError` 全为 `null`。
- **DeepSeek Account**：`ctx.deepseekAccount.getState()/getBalance()` 取到真实余额
  （充值 + 赠金钱包），与独立 API Key 的行互不影响。
- **客户端**：侧栏底部额度卡片正常渲染，并跟随当前会话的模型商
  （卡片显示的 provider 与当前会话 `modelSelection.lastUsed.provider` 一致）。
- **设置页**：「额度面板」section 的槽位声明与注册形状按官方用法逐条静态核对；未做视觉确认
  （无 CDP/token，无法在运行实例里打开设置页截图）。

依赖的缝（都只走 DSH 公开面，不 import 内部包）：

- 宿主：`ctx.credentials.resolve/describe`、`ctx.deepseekAccount`、`webServer.register({ kind: 'prefix', … })`。
- 客户端：`window.__ModuleLoader__.load`、`require('react'/'react-dom')`、
  `slots` 的 `sidebar.footer.action` 与 `settings.section` 槽、
  `sessions.list` 快照里的 `retainedBy.mainView`、
  `sessions.binding(id).session.projections.faceOf('modelSelection')`、
  `ctx.modelDirectories`（兜底路径）。

这些缝任何一个在将来消失，插件是**降级**而不是崩溃：卡片退回配置的 `primary` 供应商，
单个供应商行显示明确的错误原因（错误码词表见下）。

## 它解决什么

同一个 DSH 里往往配了好几个供应商：DeepSeek 按量计费看余额，OpenCode Go / GLM Coding /
Kimi Code 是套餐制看滚动窗口。以前要分别登录各家控制台才能知道「还能不能接着干」。
本插件把这些读数聚合到侧栏一个卡片上，一眼可见。

## 余额怎么显示（赠金优先 + 颜色）

DeepSeek Account / DeepSeek API 这类带「赠金 / 赠送余额」的供应商：

- **有未用完的赠金**且开了「赠金优先显示」→ 大号数字显示**赠金**，右侧一个
  **绿底白字的「赠金」圆角标**；赠金下方以**灰色小字**显示正常余额（非赠金部分）。
- **没有赠金**（或关掉「赠金优先显示」）→ 直接显示正常余额。

**颜色**（数字与「赠金」标同色）：

| 颜色 | 条件（默认阈值） |
|---|---|
| 绿 | 充足：≥ 20 CNY |
| 黄 | 警告：≥ 5 CNY |
| 红 | 严重不足：< 5 CNY |
| 灰 | 没有余额或已欠费（≤ 0） |

「赠金参与告警颜色计算」开关决定用哪个数判色：**开**（默认）→ 有赠金就按赠金判色，
赠金用完自动回落按余额；**关** → 只看余额。阈值本身可在设置页改（默认 20 / 5 CNY）。

## 额度怎么显示（进度条 + 颜色）

套餐型供应商（OpenCode Go / GLM Coding / Kimi Code / MiniMax 等）：

- **优先显示哪个窗口**可在设置页选：5 小时（默认）/ 每周 / 每月；卡片与面板都按它排序。
- **颜色**（默认阈值）：剩余 ≥ 20% 绿 · ≥ 5% 黄 · < 5% 红 · **0% 空条**（不画填充）。
  阈值可在设置页改（默认 20 / 5 %）。

## 供应商目录

| id | 显示名 | 凭据引用 | 接口 | 语义 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `deepseek-account` | DeepSeek Account | （账号登录记录） | 宿主 `ctx.deepseekAccount` | 充值 + 赠金余额，**默认常驻** |
| `deepseek` | DeepSeek API | `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` | `api.deepseek.com/user/balance` | 账户余额（含充值/赠送明细） |
| `moonshot` | Moonshot 开放平台 | `MOONSHOT_API_KEY` | `api.moonshot.cn/v1/users/me/balance` | 账户余额 |
| `kimi-coding` | Moonshot Kimi Code 订阅 | `KIMI_API_KEY` | `api.kimi.com/coding/v1/usages` | 5 小时 / 每周窗口 |
| `glm` | GLM 开放平台 | `ZHIPU_API_KEY`、`GLM_API_KEY` | `open.bigmodel.cn/api/monitor/usage/quota/limit` | 配额剩余（无公开余额接口） |
| `glm-coding-cn` | GLM Coding 套餐（国内） | `GLM_CODING_API_KEY`、`ZAI_CODING_CN_API_KEY` | 同上 | 5 小时 / 每周 / 每月 |
| `zai-coding` | Z.AI GLM Coding（国际） | `ZAI_API_KEY` | `api.z.ai/api/monitor/usage/quota/limit` | 5 小时 / 每周 / 每月 |
| `opencode-go` | OpenCode Go | `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY` | `opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage` | 5 小时滚动 / 每周 / 每月 |
| `openrouter` | OpenRouter | `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | `openrouter.ai/api/v1/credits` | 已购 − 已用 |
| `siliconflow-cn` | SiliconFlow（国内） | `SILICONFLOW_CN_API_KEY` | `api.siliconflow.cn/v1/user/info` | 账户余额 |
| `minimax` / `minimax-cn` | MiniMax Coding | `MINIMAX_API_KEY` / `MINIMAX_CN_API_KEY` | `/v1/token_plan/remains` | 5 小时 / 每周 |
| `stepfun` | StepFun 阶跃星辰 | `STEPFUN_API_KEY` | `api.stepfun.com/v1/accounts` | 账户余额 |
| `xai` | xAI | `XAI_API_KEY` | `api.x.ai/v1/billing/credits` | 剩余额度 |

## 卸载

1. 删掉 profile `package.json` 里 bundles 的 `"dsh-model-quota"` 一行；
2. 删掉 `cordis.patch.yml` 末尾那条 `- id: dsh-model-quota` 覆盖行；
3. 删掉 `node_modules\dsh-model-quota` 这个 junction（如果是 `dsh plugin add` 装的，改用
   `dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-model-quota`）；
4. 重启 DSH。

## 配置

写在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（`- id: dsh-model-quota` 那一行）：

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 关掉就完全不挂载 |
| `refreshMs` | `300000` | 后台刷新周期（毫秒），下限 60000；面板页脚文案跟着它变 |
| `timeoutMs` | `15000` | 单个供应商请求超时 |
| `showUnconfigured` | `false` | `false`=只显示 Account + 检测到的（推荐）；`true`=全部列出（未配置的灰显） |
| `primary` | `deepseek-account` | 卡片优先展示哪个供应商 |
| `accountClientVersion` | 环境变量/`0.2.1-rc.1` | DeepSeek 账号余额请求带的客户端版本号（`x-client-version`） |
| `statePath` | `$DSH_HOME/dsh-model-quota/state.json` | 显示开关与偏好的持久化路径 |
| `hide` | `[]` | 从面板与设置页隐藏的供应商 id |
| `providers` | `{}` | 按 id 覆盖目录条目，或新增自定义供应商 |

覆盖/新增的例子：

```yaml
- id: dsh-model-quota
  config:
    primary: opencode-go
    hide: [xai, stepfun]
    providers:
      deepseek:
        label: DeepSeek 官方
      my-gateway:                       # 目录外的自建网关
        label: 自建网关
        refs: [MY_GATEWAY_KEY]
        endpoint: https://gw.example.com/v1/credits
        format: openrouter-credits      # 复用已有解析器
        currency: $
```

新增供应商时 `endpoint` / `format` / `refs` 三者必填，`format` 必须是已注册的解析器
（`deepseek-balance`、`moonshot-balance`、`openrouter-credits`、`siliconflow-balance`、
`stepfun-accounts`、`xai-credits`、`zhipu-quota`、`zai-coding-quota`、`kimi-coding-usage`、
`minimax-remains`、`opencode-usage`）。要接一个全新形状的接口，在 `CATALOG` 旁边加一个
解析函数并登记到 `PARSERS` 即可，约 10 行。

## 与天枢（Tianshu-harness）的关系

参考了 [huiliyi37/Tianshu-harness](https://github.com/huiliyi37/Tianshu-harness)（Apache-2.0），复用两样东西：

1. **供应商预设表**（`src/config/provider-presets.ts`）——各家官方 key 页、`apiKeyEnv`
   命名、baseUrl。
2. **数据契约**（`src/server/protocol.ts` 的 `ProviderUsageAccount` / `ProviderUsageSnapshot`
   与 `ProviderUsageStatus` / `ProviderUsageError` / `ProviderQuotaPeriod` 词表）——本插件的行
   字段与错误码词表按它对齐，`kind: 'subscription'`、`period: '5h'|'7d'|'monthly'`、
   `remainingPercent`、`errorCode: 'auth'|'rate-limit'|…` 都取自这里。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 Leafmy

plugins.description: Auto-continues a reply that was cut off at the output token limit, and gives every Our Free Model route its own request parameters (reasoning effort, max tokens, temperature, stop sequences) in DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ofm-addition

**Our Free Model 的附属插件** — 不改内核、零依赖、无构建步骤。

第一项能力：**截断自动续写**。当回答因为达到输出 token 上限被截断时，插件替你发送
「继续」，让模型从中断处接着输出，不用你盯着屏幕手动补一刀。连续次数可以设上限，也可以
选「不限」—— 那时由**上下文保护**接手，在窗口快满之前停下。

> 看到的那条提示 —— “已达到输出 token 上限 回答被截断，已有输出保留在对话中。发送
> “继续”可让模型接着输出。” —— 就是这个插件在替你按下发送。

第二项能力：**每个模型的请求参数**。每个 Our Free Model 路由都可以有自己的思考档位、
输出上限（也是「思考预算」的大小）、温度与停止序列；写一次，之后每次请求都按它走。
可以逐个调，可以「全部顶配」，也可以让一个模型读着每个模型的声明把参数填好，确认后再写入。

---

## 它做什么

```
模型输出到了上限
  ↓  turn/end { reason: { kind: 'max-tokens' } }      ← 只有真的停在输出上限才算
  ↓  会话转为空闲（agent/status → idle）
  ↓  等待一小段时间（默认 0.35s）
  ↓  重新检查一遍全部条件                              ← 你永远优先
  ↓      用量：连续次数还没到上限？（上限可以是「不限」）
  ↓      余量：下一条请求还放得进模型窗口？（上下文保护）
  ↓  agent.followup("继续")
```

**只作用于 Our Free Model。** 默认开着「只对 Our Free Model 生效」，其它供应商的会话这个
插件完全不碰 —— 不续写、不折叠、不标注。关掉它才轮到下面的白名单。

**只有 `finish_reason = length` 会触发。** 正常结束、报错、你按下的停止都不会。停止
会让这一轮的计数直接归零，下一次截断重新开始算。

**每次发送前都重新看一遍状态。** 等待窗口里你打字、点停止、排入了新输入、或者切了
模型，本次续写就取消。插件从不和你的手抢方向盘。

### 两道刹车，至少留一道

| 刹车 | 判定 | 配置 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **连续上限** | 同一次截断已经自动续写了几次 | `不限` / 1 / 3 / 5 / 10 / 自定义，默认 **3** |
| **上下文保护** | 下一条请求的 prompt 是否已经逼近模型上下文窗口 | 默认开，阈值默认窗口可用额的 **90%** |

把上限设为**「不限」**时，上下文保护就是唯一的刹车。两者都关掉页面会给出警告 ——
那意味着一直续到上游报出上下文溢出，插件不替你兜底。

上下文保护怎么算：向宿主取**下一条请求会发送的 prompt 大小**（`tokenMeter.measure()`，
也就是内核压缩上下文时用的同一个数），和**路由模型的窗口减去本次请求预留的输出**相比。
量不出来时（没挂 token meter、或适配器不声明窗口）**放行**而不是拦死，最后由实测的溢出
收尾：一旦真的撞上 `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED`，本轮的续写立即结束，并在运行状态里
记为「上下文溢出，已停止」。

> 内核自己的上下文压缩（`compaction-basic`）默认在窗口压力的 80% 处动手。它挂着的时候
> 通常会在你之前把上下文压回去，保护就很少触发；它没挂（例如 `minimal` 预设）时，
> 这道保护就是唯一的闸。

## 设置页

`设置 → OFM 增强` 与 `设置 → OFM 模型参数`

### OFM 增强

| 分组 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 自动续写 | 总开关；连续续写上限（含**不限**）；**上下文保护**开关与阈值；发送前等待时长；提示词（明确 / 简单 / 自定义，带预览） |
| 对话呈现 | **折叠自动续写**（把插件发的「继续」和它已接手的截断提示收起来）；**显示自动续写次数**（在最后一行输出的时间后面标注「（已自动继续 x 次）」，点一下可临时展开被折叠的内容） |
| 生效范围 | **只对 Our Free Model 生效**（默认开，其它供应商完全不碰）；关闭后才有 provider 与模型白名单（支持 `*` 通配）、是否处理子代理、截断落在工具调用上时是否跳过、消息在对话里呈现为「用户气泡」还是「自动化标记」 |
| 运行状态 | 已发送次数、最近 24 小时、预算用尽次数、上下文停下次数、活跃会话列表（含**最近一次决策结果**与「上下文已满」标记，可点「立即续写」手动补一刀）、最近决策记录 |

「立即续写」不需要先有截断 —— 只要你点了，它就发。人是比策略更高的权威。

### OFM 模型参数

```
每个模型一行：名称 · provider|model · 上下文 · 输出上限 · 当前参数
  ▸ 思考档位    模型默认 / 该模型声明的每一档（light、balanced、deep、high、max…）
  ▸ 会话临时选择优先   （可选：让模型选择器里临时选的那一档压过本页）
  ▸ 输出上限    模型默认 / 一个数字 / 「顶配 N」（N = 适配器为该模型报出的容量）
  ▸ 温度        默认 / 0–2
  ▸ 停止序列    一行一个，最多 8 条
  ▸ 恢复默认 · 移除规则
```

三个按钮：**全部顶配**（每个模型拉到它能给的最高档位与最大输出上限）、
**AI 智能填写**（让一个模型读着每个模型的声明给参数）、**撤销上一次改动**。
两者都**先出预览再写入**，预览里逐条列出会变成什么、哪几条被拒绝以及为什么。

| 事实 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 什么时候生效 | 写入 `agent/request`（请求组装完成之后、落日志与派发之前），所以改完的**下一次请求**就带着新参数，不用重启 |
| 谁说了算 | 默认「本页为准」。想临时用模型选择器那一档，给该模型开「会话临时选择优先」 |
| 「恢复默认」做什么 | 保留这一行，把这四个字段交还模型：下一次请求会**清掉**上一次记录的值，让它回到模型自己的默认 |
| 档位从哪来 | 每次打开页面时向适配器现取（`resolveModelInfo`）。模型不再声明的档位存不进去；万一磁盘上留着旧的，请求前还会再校验一次，宁可跳过也不会把非法档位发出去（那会让整个回合失败） |
| 会碰哪些模型 | 只碰**你配置过的**那些路由。没配置过的模型，本插件一个字段都不动 |

## 配置

存三份 JSON，都在 `$DSH_HOME`（默认 `~/.dsh`）下：

- `ofm-addition/settings.json` —— 设置页写的那些字段
- `ofm-addition/stats.json` —— 计数与最近 60 条决策记录
- `ofm-addition/params.json` —— 逐模型参数表：`{ version, scope, entries: { 'provider|model': {...} }, ai }`

`params.json` 是可以在 profile 里预置的：

也可以在 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml` 里给这一行挂初始值（文件里的值
优先）：

```yaml
- id: ofm-addition
  name: dsh-ofm-addition
  config:
    maxContinuations: 0          # 0 = 不限
    contextGuard: true           # 不限时唯一的刹车，别关
    contextRatio: 0.9
    providers: ['our-free-model*']
    # 逐模型参数的初始值；文件里已有的值优先（页面里改过的以页面为准）
    modelParams:
      scope: ['our-free-model*']
      entries:
        'our-free-model|space-bunny-free':
          enabled: true
          effort: deep           # 必须是该模型声明过的档位
          maxTokens: 32768
          temperature: null      # null = 模型默认
          stop: []
      ai:
        provider: ''             # 留空 = 用当前默认模型
        model: ''
        maxTokens: 4096
```

## 安装

```bash
node install.mjs            # 安装 / 修复
node install.mjs --uninstall # 卸载（保留插件目录）
node install.mjs --dry       # 只看要改什么
```

脚本做三件事：在 profile 的 `node_modules/` 下建目录联接、往 `package.json` 的
`dependencies` 写一行 `link:`、把 `dsh-ofm-addition` 加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`。
**不跑 pnpm** —— 本插件零依赖，运行时跑 pnpm 只会重建 node_modules 并打断会话。

装完必须**完全退出 DSH（含托盘）再启动**：bundle 清单和浏览器模块表都是启动期读的。

## 离线验证台

```bash
node --test test/model-params.test.mjs test/policy.test.mjs test/host.test.mjs test/client.test.mjs
```

114 项，不需要启动 DSH：

- `test/policy.test.mjs` —— 纯决策逻辑。含关键回归：**插件自己发的「继续」绝不能被
  当成用户输入**，否则预算每一轮都会被重置，循环永不停止；以及「不限」真的不限、
  上下文阈值恰好卡在边界上、量不出来时放行而不是拦死。
- `test/host.test.mjs` —— 假 cordis ctx + 假 agent + 假 `tokenMeter` / `llm`，按真实时序回放
  `turn/end` → `agent/status` 事件流，验证接线、预算、上下文保护的三段边界、真实溢出的记录、
  竞争条件、HTTP 路由与信任围栏。
- `test/ledger.test.mjs` —— 从会话日志推导「一次运行」：开合边界、上下文溢出的命名、
  你接手时收尾、截断没有续写时不开运行。
- `test/client.test.mjs` —— 假 React + 假 `__ModuleLoader__`，验证插槽注册形状、
  中英文字典键齐平、以及用真实 `/summary` 载荷渲染出元素树。
- `test/model-params.test.mjs` —— 参数表本身：档位校验（模型未声明的档位绝不发出去）、
  「恢复默认」真的清掉上一次记录的值、顶配不越过适配器报出的容量、AI 回答里编造的档位会被丢掉。
- `test/transcript.test.mjs` —— **jsdom 真实 DOM**：折叠只命中运行自己的行
  （按消息 id 命中行键）、别的会话/别的轮次不受影响、样式只装一次、
  `conversation.chat.assistant-actions` 徽章注册形状。

## 版本

- **0.4.0** —— 新增**OFM 模型参数**设置分区：逐模型的思考档位 / 输出上限 / 温度 / 停止序列，
  「全部顶配」与「AI 智能填写」（都先预览再写入）、一键撤销；参数在 `agent/request` 上生效，
  只作用于配置过的路由。
- **0.3.0** —— 新增**折叠自动续写**与**次数标注**（两个独立开关）；新增**只对 Our Free Model
  生效**作用域闸（默认开）；拒绝原因改为 info 级日志并显示在会话行上。
- **0.2.0** —— 连续上限加「不限」（**0 = 不限**）；新增上下文保护（预判 + 实测溢出两道）。
- **0.1.0** —— 截断自动续写。

> ⚠️ **0.1.0 的 `0` 是「一次都不许续」，0.2.0 起才是「不限」。** 如果改过设置后行为完全相反，
> 先完全退出 DSH 再启动 —— 旧代码在内存里不会自己换。

## 它不做什么

- 不包装、不替换任何宿主服务。只监听事件，然后调用 `agent.followup()` —— 和内置的
  目标驱动、定时任务、webhook 桥用的是同一个公开入口。删掉这个插件，组合和从没装过
  它一样健康。
- 不碰 Our Free Model 自己的目录、代码或数据。两个插件各自独立安装、独立升级；
  信任围栏是复制一份而不是 import，谁也不因为对方缺失或版本落后而启动失败。

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: Upgrade check + multi-host compatibility matrix for DSH plugins, official format-1 market index, Windows/WSL install doctor, and a reusable GitHub Action that comments a compatibility matrix on plugin PRs.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-health

[![CI](https://github.com/EasonMWS/dsh-plugin-health/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/EasonMWS/dsh-plugin-health/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-health.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-health)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

Compatibility matrix, official format-1 index builder, and Windows/WSL install doctor for
[DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugins.

> Status: `0.1.6`. Built against the official DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` compatibility rules and the
> published `@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market-index` validator.

**Live official format-1 index:** <https://easonmws.github.io/dsh-plugin-health/index.json>
(300 plugins, rebuilt nightly) · **npm:** `npm install -g dsh-plugin-health` ·
**repo:** <https://github.com/EasonMWS/dsh-plugin-health>

> **Upgrading to DSH 0.2.1? Run the check first.**
>
> In a scan of the top 120 ecosystem plugins, **3 would stop loading on `0.2.1-rc.2`** because
> they pin exact `@deepseek-ai/*` peer versions. Full report:
> [docs/upgrade-0.2.1.md](docs/upgrade-0.2.1.md).
>
> ```sh
> dsh-plugin-health matrix --plugins plugins.txt --versions 0.2.0-rc.2,0.2.1-rc.2
> ```

## Why

DSH ships no official plugin market index, publishes a prerelease roughly every two days with
breaking changes, and its plugin manager has no version picker or upgrade action. Today an author
can only check a plugin against the one DSH version installed on the machine, and Windows/WSL
install failures leave partial directories and stale locks behind.

This tool covers the three gaps that the existing doctor/market tools do not:

1. **Multi-host compatibility matrix** — will a plugin load on `0.1.7-rc.2`, `0.2.0-rc.2`,
   `0.2.1-alpha.4`, `0.2.1-rc.2`, ...? Evaluated with the exact official semantics
   (`engines.dsh` first, otherwise `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peers, prereleases included,
   `workspace:` ranges mapped to the host version).
2. **Official format-1 market index** — turn a community catalog into a JSON index that the
   built-in DSH **Discover** tab accepts, validated by the same parser the DSH Host uses.
3. **Windows/WSL install doctor** — read-only by default; repairs quarantine, never delete, and
   patch edits keep the user's comments.

## Install

```sh
npm install -g dsh-plugin-health
# or run the checkout:
git clone https://github.com/EasonMWS/dsh-plugin-health.git && cd dsh-plugin-health && npm ci
node bin/dsh-plugin-health.js --help
```

Requires Node.js 20+.

### Install inside DSH (bundle mode)

The package is also an installable DSH bundle. Installing it into a profile adds a read-only
`plugin_health` agent tool that reports missing third-party bundles, broken package directories,
`cordis.patch.yml` residue, proxy/registry configuration, profile drift, and installed plugins
incompatible with the running DSH version.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-health
```

The bundle declares `engines.dsh`, adds no UI, and changes nothing by itself.

## 1. Compatibility matrix

```sh
dsh-plugin-health matrix \
  --plugins examples/plugins.txt \
  --versions latest,next,alpha,0.1.7-rc.2 \
  --out dsh-health-out/matrix \
  --fail-on any
```

- `--plugins` accepts a file (one spec per line, `#` comments allowed), a comma list, or repeated
  flags. A spec is `name`, `name@version`, or a local plugin directory.
- `--versions` accepts exact SemVer versions or npm dist-tags of `@deepseek-ai/dsh`
  (`latest`, `next`, `alpha`, ...).
- Output: `matrix.json`, `matrix.md`, and static SVG badges (`badges/`).
- `--fail-on any|none|<host>` makes the command usable as a CI gate.

The evaluation mirrors `packages/boot/app-boot/src/plugin-compatibility.ts`:

| Manifest declares | Check |
|---|---|
| `engines.dsh` | that range alone; peers are ignored |
| no `engines.dsh`, has peers | every `@deepseek-ai/dsh` / `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer range |
| peer range `workspace:^` / `~` / `*` | the running host version |
| prerelease host versions | participate in ranges (`includePrerelease: true`) |

Limitations: the matrix is **static** (manifests + official requirements). It does not yet boot
each host and mount the plugin; that runtime smoke test is on the roadmap. Git-only plugins can be
checked from a local clone with a directory spec.

### Example run (2026-10-17, 7 plugins × 4 hosts)

```
dsh 0.1.7-rc.2: 6/7 compatible, 1 incompatible
dsh 0.2.0-rc.2: 5/7 compatible, 2 incompatible
dsh 0.2.1-alpha.4: 5/7 compatible, 2 incompatible
dsh 0.2.1-rc.2: 5/7 compatible, 2 incompatible
✗ dsh-win32@0.17.14: incompatible on all four (narrow @deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local peers)
✗ dsh-find-plugin@0.4.0: incompatible from 0.2.0-rc.2 (@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools peer)
```

The first result reproduces the real failure tracked in `dsh-win32` issue #89 (a peer upper bound
that is too narrow for later host lines) without installing anything.

### GitHub Action: matrix on every pull request

The repository ships a reusable workflow. Add
[`examples/dsh-compat.yml`](examples/dsh-compat.yml) to a plugin repository (as
`.github/workflows/dsh-compat.yml`) and every pull request gets a compatibility matrix comment plus
a job summary, with the matrix artifact uploaded:

```yaml
name: dsh plugin compatibility
on: pull_request
permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write
jobs:
  matrix:
    uses: EasonMWS/dsh-plugin-health/.github/workflows/matrix-review.yml@v0.1.5
    with:
      plugins: '.'
      versions: 'latest,next,alpha'
      comment: true
```

## 2. Format-1 market index

```sh
dsh-plugin-health index \
  --catalog https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/plugins.json \
  --host 0.2.1-rc.2 \
  --index-url https://easonmws.github.io/dsh-plugin-health/index.json \
  --matrix dsh-health-out/matrix/matrix.json \
  --limit 300 --out site
```

The command writes `site/index.json` (format `1`) plus `site/build-report.md`, then validates the
document with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market-index` — the official reader used by the DSH Host.
Host the directory on any static origin (GitHub Pages is fine; no redirects) and paste the
`index.json` URL into **Plugins → 自定义插件市场 → 发现 → 添加索引源**.

Index facts:

- market title/description and every plugin title/description are localised (`en` required, `zh` kept);
- categories come from the catalog, plus labels (`npm`, `compatible`, `incompatible`,
  `unchecked`, `capability risk`) and sort keys (`downloads`, `stars`, health score);
- the health score is deterministic: popularity (log downloads 55, log stars 25) ± compatibility
  and capability-risk adjustments, 0–100;
- versions listed per plugin default to the dist-tag latest first, then the highest versions
  (`--max-versions`, default 3), with the npm publish timestamp and `engines.dsh`.

Current scope: npm-published catalog entries only (2,607 of 5,704 in the October 2026 snapshot).
GitHub/tarball-only entries are skipped and reported; git source support (commit-pinned) is on the
roadmap.

## 3. Windows/WSL doctor and repair

```sh
dsh-plugin-health doctor --home C:\Users\me\.dsh --profile desktop --runtime 0.2.1-rc.2
dsh-plugin-health repair --home C:\Users\me\.dsh --profile desktop --apply --yes
```

Checks: declared third-party bundles that are not installed (bundles shipped by the DSH
installation are treated as provided), unreadable/partial package directories, missing profile
dependencies, broken or empty `cordis.patch.yml` entries, `.bak-*` / `.lock` / `.lock.takeover-*`
residue, large plugin-manager logs, proxy configured without `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1`, WSL and long
Windows paths, installed-plugin incompatibility against `--runtime`, and plugin-set drift between
profiles.

Repairs are opt-in (`--apply`), default to a dry run, and never delete:

- files/directories move to `<home>/.plugin-health/quarantine/<timestamp>/` (a `repair-log.json`
  records every action);
- `cordis.patch.yml` is edited textually (top-level `- []` entries only) after a backup, so comments
  and formatting survive.

## Roadmap

- runtime smoke: install and mount the plugin in an isolated profile per host version;
- git/tarbal

plugins.description: ChatGPT-style conversation layout for the DeepSeek Harness Web client.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-chatgpt-style

把 DSH Web 的对话流排成 ChatGPT 的样子，并且**给语义上色**：加强是绿的、警惕是红的、重点加粗、该有图标的地方都有图标。
纯样式 + 一层正文标注 + 发送框旁的**思考/快速**切换 + 左侧工作区高亮，不碰会话逻辑，关掉就回到原样。

## 安装

桌面应用的 profile 由应用独占，命令行改不动，走界面装：

1. 侧栏「插件」→「添加插件」
2. 填绝对路径：`E:\go_path\src\xiaotianzhushou\dsh-chatgpt-style`
3. 装完**重启一次桌面应用**（插件在应用启动时读进加载树），再刷新页面

它以 `link:` 依赖装在 profile 里，所以改完 `client.js` 只要刷新页面就生效，不用重装。
卸载：插件开关关掉即可；样式表、根属性、观察器都由 `ctx.effect` 的清理器收走。

## 语义色：怎么写，长什么样

正文里的标记会被渲染成带色带图标的节点。写进代码块或行内代码里的标记原样保留，不会被转换。

| 写法 | 渲染成 | 用在哪 |
|---|---|---|
| `==文字==` | **绿色**加粗 + ✓ 图标 | 加强、结论、已验证通过的点 |
| `!!文字!!` | **红色**加粗 + ⚠ 图标 | 警惕、风险、会出事的地方 |
| `++文字++` | **绿色**加粗 + 淡绿底，无图标 | 需要重点关注的词：错误码、关键数字、路径 |
| 裸的 `403` / `500` | 自动变成上面那种重点样式 | 不用手标，4xx/5xx 直接命中 |
| 行首 `✅ ` 或 `🟢 ` | 绿色横条卡片 + ✓，表情被摘掉 | 整行结论 |
| 行首 `⚠️ ` 或 `🔴 ` | 红色横条卡片 + ⚠ | 整行警告 |
| 行首 `💡 ` | 蓝色横条卡片 + 灯泡 | 整行提示 |
| `**文字**` | 700 字重（比正文更硬） | 重点加粗 |

例子的原文与效果：

```
✅ 依赖已经写进 profile，三个入口都能解析
⚠️ 重启会掐断当前这轮对话
💡 想微调就改 client.js 顶部那段 CSS
结论是 ==装好了==，但 !!重启前别关终端!!。
```

颜色跟着主题走：浅色用深一点的墨绿/砖红，深色自动换成亮绿/亮红，不用手动切。

## 兼容性（为什么可以放心用）

**正在流式输出的消息一个字都不改。** 宿主在助理消息的根节点上挂着 `data-streaming`，
标记摘掉才代表这条消息写完，插件此时才动手。原因是 React 记住的是它自己创建的那个文本节点，
把它替换掉之后，后续 token 会写进已脱离文档的节点，正文就会停在原地——这条约束由测试守着。

已完成的正文里，转换是**幂等**的：装饰过的文本里不再含标记，重复扫描不会二次包裹。

## 思考 / 快速 一键切换

发送框旁边多了一枚胶囊：**快速**（绿、闪电）或**思考**（紫、星标），点一下换档，不用每次展开模型菜单。

它读的是宿主的模型目录（`ctx.modelDirectories`），提交也走宿主唯一真源，插件自己**不缓存模型列表**：

- 当前档位：`directoryFor(sessionId).store.getSnapshot().current.reasoningEffort`
- 可选的档位：快照里那个模型的 `reasoning.efforts`
- 点一下：`directoryFor(sessionId).select({ provider, model, reasoningEffort })`

要让它有档位可切，**适配器必须先声明推理等级**——模型目录是配置驱动的，客户端插件造不出来。
provider 路由里加上这两处（本项目当前配置见 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`）：

```yaml
providers:
  kso-codeplan:
    compat:
      thinkingFormat: deepseek   # thinking: {type: enabled|disabled}
    reasoning: off               # 默认档 = 快速
    models:
      - id: deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash
        reasoningEfforts:        # 只声明真实有区别的档位
          off: "off"
          high: "high"
```

模型没声明档位时胶囊自己隐藏，宿主原生那套 UI 照常。

**已知限制**：provider 改完要重启桌面应用才生效（宿主半的配置在启动时读进加载树）。

## 其它排版改动

| 位置 | DSH 原来 | 现在 |
|---|---|---|
| 正文列宽 | 748px | **768px**（48rem） |
| 轮次间距 | 6 / 12 / 16px | **26px** |
| 用户消息 | 品牌浅蓝气泡 | 右侧圆形蓝头像 + 染色气泡（20px 圆角、描边），宽 75% |
| 助手消息 | 无角色标识 | 左侧圆形绿头像 + 星标 |
| 正文 | 跟设置、行高 24px | 16px / 28px |
| 标题 | 设计令牌 | h1/h2 左侧 3px 强调色竖条 |
| 链接 | 近黑无下划线 | 强调色 + 下划线；外链补外跳图标 |
| 代码块 | 令牌圆角 | 12px 圆角 + 外框，头栏分色并带代码图标 |
| 表格 | 无表头底色 | 表头浅底、外框、行分隔线 |
| 引用块 | 灰色左条 | 强调色左条 + 7% 底色 + 引号图标 |

连续两个助手步骤只画一个头像，第二条缩进同步回退。

## 左侧工作区（侧栏）

| 对象 | 原来 | 现在 |
|---|---|---|
| 选中的会话 | 只和 hover 一样的浅灰底 | **蓝底 + 蓝字 + 左侧 3px 蓝条 + 加粗**，hover 不再把它变回灰 |
| 未选中的会话 | 主文字色 | 灰一档（`--gpt-ws-idle-fg`），鼠标悬停时提回正文色 |
| 选中行的标题/时间 | 同色 | 标题 700，时间/元信息继承蓝色并降到 78% 透明度 |
| 工作区（文件夹）行 | 常规字重、灰图标 | 标题 600，文件夹图标**琥珀色**，展开态更亮 |

锚点用的是宿主的语义类名局部名：`_sessionRow` / `_selected` / `_projectRow` / `_folder` / `_folderActive`，
外加 `[data-row-key^="workspace:"]` 这个稳定属性。图标本身是宿主 primitives 的 SVG，
所以走 `color` + `svg{fill:currentColor}` 上色，不替换 DOM。

## 调参

数值集中在 `client.js` 顶部 `CSS` 数组第 1 节，改完刷新页面即生效：

```
--dsh-chat-content-width              版心宽度
--gpt-body-size / --gpt-body-line     正文字号 / 行高
--gpt-avatar / --gpt-avatar-gap       头像直径 / 间距
--gpt-accent / --gpt-bot              用户侧 / 助手侧强调色
--gpt-bubble / --gpt-bubble-line-color  用户气泡底色 / 描边
--gpt-mode-fast-* / --gpt-mode-think-*   胶囊的 文字色 / 底色 / 描边（快速 / 思考）
--gpt-ws-sel-bg / -fg / -bar           选中会话的底色 / 文字色 / 左条色
--gpt-ws-idle-fg                       未选中会话的文字色
--gpt-ws-folder / -open                文件夹图标的琥珀色 / 展开态
--gpt-ok / --gpt-warn / --gpt-tip     语义色的文字色
--gpt-ok-bg / --gpt-warn-bg / --gpt-tip-bg  语义色卡片的底色
```

不想要某项：语义标注整块删掉第 12、13 节 CSS 及 `INLINE` / `BLOCK` 两处定义；不想要头像删掉第 3 节。

## 自测

```
node test/semantic.test.mjs
```

用假 DOM 跑真实的 `client.js`，覆盖整行标注、行内标注、代码/公式不被动、幂等、增量追加、
**流式期间不动 DOM**、样式表注入与卸载，以及思考/快速胶囊（默认档、跟随目录变化、点击提交、
模型没声明档位时隐藏、会话未物化不抛错）、重点词标记与裸 4xx/5xx 自动命中，共 46 项断言。

## 为什么选择器长这样

DSH 用 CSS Modules，实际类名是 `<哈希>_局部名`（用户气泡是 `cJsG2q_bubble`）。哈希随宿主构建变，局部名稳定，
所以一律写 `[class*="_bubble"]`；行级结构挂在宿主导出的语义属性上：

- `[data-chat-flow-kind="user" | "assistant-step" | "turn-process" | "steering"]`
- `[data-chat-group-part]`、`[data-conversation-scroll]`、`[data-code-block-banner]`
- `[data-streaming]`（流式保护）、`body[data-ds-dark-theme]`（深色主题）

**已知限制**：宿主大版本升级若改了局部类名或这些属性名，对应样式/标注会静默失效（退化成默认外观，不报错）。

## 文件

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `package.json` | 清单：`dsh.bundle.patch` 指向补丁，`dsh.client` 声明浏览器半 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 把 entry 插进 profile 的加载树 |
| `index.js` | 宿主半：具名导出 `name` 与空 `apply` |
| `client.js` | 浏览器半：图标 + 样式表 + 语义标注 + 思考/快速胶囊 |
| `test/semantic.test.mjs` | 假 DOM 自测，46 项断言 |

plugins.description: DSH right-sidebar file helper: annotate a selection in the document preview (text lines / Excel ranges / Word-PDF pages) or right-click a file, then send the quote plus your note into the current chat. Also ships the standalone zh/en/ja README summary.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-file-to-chat

**把右侧栏里的内容，带着你的批注，直接送进当前对话。**

在 DeepSeek Harness Web 的右侧栏里划选一段文字、框选一块 Excel 区域，或者在文件树上右键一个文件 —— 选区（或整份文件）连同你写的批注一起进入输入框，发出去之后自动收成一枚小胶囊，聊天记录不再被大段引用撑爆。

> Annotate a selection or a whole file in the DSH right-sidebar and send it into the current chat with your note. The quote reaches the model in full; the transcript only shows a small capsule.

```
输入框：  [📄 引用 · 套餐对比.xlsx · 结论速览 B8]  这条再确认下

发出去：  > 📄 引用来源：<绝对路径>（工作表 结论速览 · 区域 B8）
          > 速率上限：官方账户级并发 2,500，可免费扩容
          
          批注： 这条再确认下

聊天里：  [📄 套餐对比.xlsx · 结论速览 B8]   ← 点一下可以展开全文
```

---

## 功能

### 1. 文档预览里划词批注

支持右侧栏文档预览的**全部三种渲染器**：

| 预览类型 | 怎么选 | 引用块里定位到 |
|---|---|---|
| 文本 / 代码 / Markdown | 直接划选文字 | `（第 N 行）` 或 `（第 N-M 行）` |
| Excel / CSV / TSV | 在表格里拖选区域 | `（工作表 <名> · 区域 B3:D7）`，并把区域内的值取成 Markdown 表格 |
| Word / PPT / PDF | 在文字层里划选 | `（第 N 页）` 或 `（第 N-M 页）` |

选区上方会浮出一枚「批注」按钮（选区太靠页面顶部时自动落到下方），点开写批注，`Enter` 发送，`Shift+Enter` 换行，`Esc` 取消。**拖选过程中不会弹**，松手才出现。

### 2. 文件树右键菜单

在右侧栏「文件」标签页的文件或文件夹上右键：

| 菜单项 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| 发送到聊天 | 读正文并开卡片（文本直接内联，`.docx` / `.xlsx` 在浏览器里解包抽正文，其余按字节回退） |
| 只发送路径 | 不读正文，只发路径与「未读取正文」说明 —— 大文件/二进制文件的安全选项 |
| 发送目录清单 | 文件夹专用，列出目录内容 |
| **用默认程序打开** | 交给系统关联程序（等同双击），文件夹则交给文件管理器 |
| 复制完整路径 / 复制相对路径 | 复制到剪贴板 |

### 3. 已发送引用块的折叠

发出去的消息里那段 `> 📄 引用来源：…` 会自动折成一枚胶囊：**模型收到的一字不减，聊天窗口只显示标题**。点胶囊展开，移开鼠标自动合上。

---

## 安装

需要 **DSH Web 0.2.x**（开发与验证均在 `0.2.0-rc.2` 上完成）。

### 方式一：从 Git 仓库装（推荐）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add https://gitee.com/mofeo/dsh-file-to-chat.git
```

`<你的 profile>` 通常是 `desktop`（桌面端）或 `web`。装完在 **设置 → 插件** 里确认它是启用状态，然后**硬刷新一次浏览器**（`Ctrl+Shift+R`）。

### 方式二：手动放进 profile

```bash
git clone https://gitee.com/mofeo/dsh-file-to-chat.git
# 把目录链接/复制到：~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-file-to-chat
```

再把 `dsh-file-to-chat` 追加到 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组里，重启应用。

### 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> remove dsh-file-to-chat
```

> **注意**：有会话正在跑的时候卸载会被拒绝（`refused while agents are running`），先停掉再卸。

---

## 用法

1. 在右侧栏打开「文件」标签页，点开任意文件进入预览。
2. 划选（文本/Word/PDF）或在表格里拖选区域（Excel）。
3. 选区上方出现「📝 批注」→ 点开 → 写批注（可留空）。
4. `Enter` 或点「发送到聊天」。
5. 输入框里出现一枚胶囊，**按你自己的节奏按发送键** —— 插件只负责填草稿，不替你发送。

---

## 已知限制

- **只有右侧栏能触发。** 右侧栏未激活的标签页内容不挂载，所以预览没打开时工具栏上不会有入口。
- **Word/PPT/PDF 没有行号**，只能定位到页码 —— 这类文件走的是「Office → PDF → PDF.js」渲染链，页内没有源码行这个概念。
- **Excel 只取当前工作表**，且内联上限 200 行；`.xlsx` 公式取缓存值而非重算。
- **读不到正文的文件不会假装成功**：`.docx`/`.xlsx` 靠浏览器解包抽取，抽不出来时卡片会明说原因，只发引用来源行，让模型自己去读文件。
- **依赖若干 DSH 内部 DOM 约定**（见下节）。DSH 升级后如果这些锚点变了，插件内置的锚点自检会在控制台 `warn` 一次，而不是静默失效。
- 折叠与 Excel 取值走的是**展示层后处理**，不是内核的官方扩展点。功能正常，但属于「DSH 改版时最先需要复查」的部分。

---

## 实现说明（给维护者和审核者）

这个插件**没有宿主路由、没有额外的 Node 依赖**，宿主半边（`lib/index.js`）是空的 —— 它的存在只是为了在 Loader 里占一行。全部逻辑在 `client.js`（浏览器半边，手写 CJS + `window.__ModuleLoader__` 包装，只有 `require('react')` 一个依赖）。

用到的官方扩展点：

- `sidebar.right.tab.files.actions` / `sidebar.right.tab.document.actions` —— 工具栏入口
- `inputTriggers.registerSource` —— 输入框胶囊的注册与提交时的序列化编解码
- `conversation.input.for(scope)` → `insertReference(span, ref)` —— 把胶囊插进 Lexical 草稿
- `remote.workspaceFiles.read` / `readBytes` —— 读工作区文件
- `remote.session.openWorkspacePath` —— 「用默认程序打开」，直接复用 DSH 自带的后端

依赖的 DOM 锚点（会自检，失效时 `console.warn`）：

`[data-document-preview]`、`[data-textpreview-body]`、`[data-textpreview-line]`、`[data-textpreview-path]`、`[data-code-preview]`、`[data-document-markdown]`、`[data-pdf-page]`、`.fortune-name-box`、`[data-files-body]`、`[data-files-entry]`、`[data-files-path]`、`[data-files-root]`、`[data-chat-flow-kind]`、`[data-submission-echo]`

两个值得记下来的实现细节：

1. **Excel 选区不能靠 `window.getSelection()`。** 单元格是画在 canvas 上的，文字不在 DOM 里。但 FortuneSheet 会把当前选区写进名称框 `.fortune-name-box` —— 读它就够了。另外它的名称框在「选区焦点格正好是合并单元格左上角」时会**故意塌缩成单个格子**，所以真实范围改从 React 工作簿快照的 `luckysheet_select_save` 里读，名称框只作兜底。
2. **`setDraft` 会抹掉胶囊。** 它会先 `replace(REFERENCE_PLACEHOLDER_RE, '')` 再重建整份草稿，而胶囊正是用这些占位符表示的。所以补文字一律走 `insertText` / `insertReference`，绝不整份重写。

### 调试开关

默认控制台是干净的。需要排查时，在浏览器控制台执行一次：

```js
localStorage.setItem('dsh-file-to-chat:debug', '1')   // 刷新页面后打开细节日志
localStorage.removeItem('dsh-file-to-chat:debug')     // 关回去
```

---

## 开发

源码即产物：`client.js` 是手写的，没有构建步骤。改完保存即可 —— DSH 的 `dsh-client-hmr` 每 500 ms 轮询一次客户端 bundle，会**自动热重载，不用刷新页面**。（宿主半边 `lib/index.js` 不热重载，改了要重启应用；本插件正常情况下不需要动它。）

```
dsh-file-to-chat/
├── package.json         dsh.bundle / dsh.client 声明
├── cordis.patch.yml     往 Loader 里插一行
├── lib/index.js         宿主半边（空实现，只为占位）
└── client.js            浏览器半边 —— 全部功能
```

---

## 许可

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: SSH for DeepSeek Harness agents: host address, port, account, password and private key live in an encrypted vault, and the conversation only ever uses an alias. The model never sees a password, and a password never reaches a command line or a remote process list.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ssh-vault **English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE) [![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D20-brightgreen.svg)](package.json) [![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-4f7cff.svg)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) [![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.13.0-informational.svg)](package.json) [![Tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/test-160%20cases-brightgreen.svg)](test) SSH for DeepSeek Harness agents: host address, port, account, password and private key live in an encrypted vault, and the conversation only ever uses an alias. The model never sees a password, and a password never reaches a command line or a remote process list. ## Overview Three capabilities in one plugin: - **Model-facing tools** — `ssh_hosts`, `ssh_run`, `ssh_transfer`, `ssh_probe`, so the agent operates remote hosts by alias. - **Settings UI** — add, edit and delete hosts in Settings → SSH Connections, and test reachability. A password entered there travels in an HTTP body, never through the session log. - **`/hosts` command** — probe hosts and run commands from the conversation without going through the model. Under the hood it drives the local OpenSSH client (`ssh` / `scp`). It does not implement the SSH protocol itself. ## Install ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop install dsh-ssh-vault ``` From a local checkout. The argument is a path, so `.` works when you are already inside the plugin directory: ```bash # inside the checkout dsh plugin --profile desktop install . # or point at it from elsewhere dsh plugin --profile desktop install ../dsh-ssh-vault # or install from a packed tarball dsh plugin --profile desktop install ./dsh-ssh-vault-.tgz ``` **`--profile` is required.** DSH isolates plugins per profile, and one machine can carry several (`desktop`, `cli`, …). Omitting it falls back to whichever profile is currently default, which is an easy way to install into the wrong place. Confirm the landing spot with: ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop list ``` **Restart DSH after installing.** Host-side tools and routes are loaded at startup. ### Requirements | Item | Requirement | | --- | --- | | Node | ≥ 20 | | Machine | OpenSSH client installed (`ssh` on PATH) | | Platform | Windows, Linux, macOS | ## Quick start 1. **Install, then restart DSH.** 2. Open **Settings → SSH Connections**, click "Add connection", fill in alias, address, port, account, and choose password or private-key authentication. Each card carries a health dot that is checked automatically: grey = not checked, yellow = checking, green = reachable, red = unreachable. 3. Say something in the conversation, for example: ``` run uptime on kali ``` The model calls `ssh_run` and the result appears as a terminal card. Do not paste passwords into the conversation. A password entered in Settings goes straight into the encrypted vault and never enters the model context. ## Usage ### Model-facing tools | Tool | Purpose | Typical phrasing | | --- | --- | --- | | `ssh_hosts` | Manage the vault (list / show / add / update / remove) | "which hosts do I have", "change kali's note" | | `ssh_run` | Run a command on a host, return stdout and stderr | "check disk usage on kali" | | `ssh_transfer` | Upload or download a file (scp) | "copy this file to /tmp on kali" | | `ssh_probe` | Reachability self-check returning system facts | "is kali still reachable" | **Where to see the result:** calls to `ssh_run`, `ssh_probe` and `ssh_transfer` render as a **terminal card** — a header with "host · command" and a state dot, above a scrollable monospace output area. The dot is blue while running, grey on success, red on failure (including a non-zero exit code). ### Settings UI Settings → SSH Connections provides: - A host list with a health dot per card; hover for detail - Add / edit / delete connections (the alias is editable, credentials move with it) - A "Test connection" button per card, whose result also drives the dot - "Open in file manager" for the vault directory - Password and private-key authentication; a key can be uploaded whole and is written into the vault with its permissions tightened ### The `/hosts` command Start a line with `/` in the composer and the command runs **without going through the model**. ``` /hosts list every host, grouped into online / offline /hosts kali probe one /hosts kali,win10 probe several (either comma form works) /hosts kali; apt update run a command on kali /hosts kali,win10; uptime run on every reachable host ``` - Separators accept both ASCII and full-width forms: `,` and `，`, `;` and `；` - If the text after the semicolon reads as natural language (e.g. "check the disk"), the command **does not run it** and tells you to send that sentence to the conversation instead — command output never reaches the model, so such requests cannot go through the command - Output renders as **two cards**: reachability and command execution, each with its own state dot ## Architecture ### Two halves This is a **Host + Client** plugin; the two halves load through different mechanisms: | Half | Entry | Loading | | --- | --- | --- | | **Host** | `index.js` | Cordis plugin, inserted into the Loader through `cordis.patch.yml` | | **Client** | `client.js` | Browser module, declared via `dsh.client` in `package.json` and injected into the page by the host | The Host half carries every sensitive operation: vault encryption, driving the local `ssh` client, web routes, and the registration of commands and tools. The Client half only renders and collects form input; it never executes a command. ### Data flow ```mermaid flowchart TB subgraph entry [Entry points] chat[Conversation / model tool call] settings[Settings form] cmd["/hosts command"] end subgraph host [Host half — index.js] resolve[Resolve alias → read credentials → build ssh args] vault[(Vault
AES-256-GCM ciphertext)] api["Web routes /ssh-vault/*"] exec[Spawn local ssh / scp] end subgraph client [Client half — client.js] toolcard[Tool terminal card] cmdcard["/hosts double card"] form[Connection form] end proxy[Remote host] chat --> resolve cmd --> resolve settings -->|POST JSON| api form -->|same-origin, document-relative| api api --> vault resolve --> vault resolve --> exec exec -->|stdout / stderr| toolcard exec -->|stdout / stderr| cmdcard exec <--> proxy ``` Three invariants hold across that chain: 1. **A password never reaches a command line** — local ssh receives it through `SSH_ASKPASS`; remote sudo is primed over stdin 2. **Only ciphertext touches disk** — AES-256-GCM, with the data key protected by DPAPI (Windows) or derived from a master passphrase via scrypt 3. **`~/.ssh` is never touched** — `known_hosts` points into the vault directory and `HashKnownHosts` is enabled ## Configuration The plugin has **no user-configurable options**. `config: {}` in `cordis.patch.yml` is an empty object, and the Loader entry `id` is fixed as `ssh-vault`. Behaviour is shaped by the following: | Item | Notes | | --- | --- | | Vault directory | Defaults to `$DSH_HOME/ssh-vault`; `DSH_HOME` is decided by DSH | | Key protection | Windows defaults to `dpapi`; other platforms require a master passphrase (`passphrase` mode) | | Timeouts | `ssh_run` defaults to 120s, adjustable, capped at 30 minutes; commands inside `/hosts` are fixed at 120s | | Health checks | Settings page and `/hosts` probe with a 15s timeout; the background sweep refreshes every 5 minutes | ## API and extension points Host-side services are reached through `ctx.inject` as optional dependencies; a missing service does not fail the plugin, it just disables that capability. ### Model tools (`ctx.tools.register`) | Tool | Key parameters | | --- | --- | | `ssh_hosts` | `action` required (list / show / add / update / remove); `reveal` controls whether address and account are masked | | `ssh_run` | `host

plugins.description: 运行中按一下只停当前回合，再按一下锁住注入闸门：后台任务、子代理汇报、定时提醒全部扣住，直到你发消息时一起送进模型。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-composer-hold

**发送键与停止键分开**，并且给"绝对停止"配一道**注入闸门**：你按下绝对停止之后，
后台任务完成、子代理汇报、定时提醒、webhook、目标续轮、hooks 注入——**全部被扣住**，
直到你发出下一条消息，它们与那条消息**在同一次请求里**送进模型。

## 按键的五个面

| 状态 | 图标 | 何时出现 | 点它 | 此时 Enter |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 执行中 | 蓝 ‖ | 主回合在跑 | 软停：只中止当前回合（＝原来的停止键） | 走系统的繁忙提交策略 |
| 软暂停 | 蓝 ▶ | 你按过 ‖ 之后 | 进入绝对停止（锁定） | 走系统默认提交（本机是插话模式） |
| 绝对停止 | 灰蓝 ■（不可点） | 锁定中，且还有子代理/后台任务在跑 | 无动作 | — |
| 锁定＋有草稿 | 蓝 ↑ | 在 ■ 状态下打字 | 发送：本条 + 期间扣住的全部注入一次进模型 | 同左 |
| 静止 | 灰 ↑（不可点） | 空闲、无草稿、**且没有子代理/后台任务在跑** | 无动作 | 发送（有字时） |

- **▶ 是"模式"**：软暂停期间，注入仍可把模型唤醒继续执行，图标保持 ▶；你发消息（或回合重新开始）才回 ‖。
- **■ 没有点击出口**：唯一出路是打字（例如输入"继续"）再回车。
- **尘埃落定**只看子代理 + 后台任务（该会话 `/state` 里 `running` 的 job 行数为 0）。
- 右上角**橙色数字**＝此刻被扣住的注入条数。

## 它怎么工作

**宿主半**（`index.js`）——唤醒投递只有一个收口：`Agent.send(message, target, wakeup)`。
`followup()` / `steer()` / `inject()` 全部转发到它，所有外部生产者都经由它，所以插件只
需要在 agent 实例上覆盖一个 `send`：

- 锁定期间、`source.kind !== 'user'`、且 `wakeup === true` → 降级为 `('next-step', false)`：
  **消息留在收件箱，驱动不会被唤醒**。
- `source.kind === 'user'` → 解锁并**原样投递**（唤醒），于是驱动的第一步在**同一次请求**里
  claim 掉整批 `next-step` 加上你这条 `next-turn`。

**浏览器半**（`client.js`）——在 `conversation.input.right` 槽位渲染自己的键，并用产品图标的
几何特征（上升箭头 `path` / 停止方块 `rect 3,3,10,10`）把产品那颗发送键移出布局；
点击**委托**给那颗隐藏的键，所以发送/排队/插话/附件/斜杠命令全部沿用产品实现。
**回车路径完全不受影响**——这也是安全垫：按键坏了，回车照样能发。

子代理会话（`subagent !== null`）**不接管**，保留产品自己的独立停止键。

## 状态存哪

`locked` 是**宿主进程内**状态（`globalThis[Symbol.for('dsh-composer-hold.state')]`，故意不放
实例闭包：热重载会分叉），通过两个端点与浏览器同步：

```
GET  /plugin/dsh-composer-hold/state?sessionId=…   → { locked, parked, running, diagnostics }
POST /plugin/dsh-composer-hold/mode  { sessionId, mode: "lock" | "unlock" }
```

刻意不写进会话日志：外部插件**无法**写自定义持久事件——`Session.append()` 不接受 envelope 的
`ignorable` 标记，而未知的必需事件类型会让持久化读取**拒绝重建整个会话**。所以宿主重启后锁定不保留。

## 安装

作为**正经 bundle** 装进 profile（这样插件页才会列出它，并带开关）：

```jsonc
// profiles/<name>/package.json
{
  "dependencies": { "dsh-composer-hold": "link:D:/…/dsh-composer-hold" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ /* … */ "dsh-composer-hold" ] } }
}
```

**不要再在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里手插同一行**：bundle 自带的
`cordis.patch.yml` 已经插入行 id `composer-hold`，两行同 id 会让 id 定向补丁（插件页开关）
只命中其中一个。

## 已实测（2026-10-16，3080 实例）

| 项 | 证据 |
|---|---|
| 锁定期间定时提醒被扣住 | 宿主日志 `hold … <- schedule\|… (next-turn -> next-step, no wake)` |
| 用户消息放行 | 日志 `release … <- user\|…`；`parked` 归零并开新回合 |
| 连续两条注入都被扣住 | 自测：`schedule` followup 与 `plugin` steer 后 `parked` = 2，agent 仍 idle |
| 与用户消息同批放行 | 上一条实测：提醒文本与用户消息出现在同一次请求里 |

判定闸门是否生效，只看两件事：**锁定时 `parked` 有没有涨** + **模型有没有在用户没说话时自己开新回合**。

## 已知边界

- 产品那颗键是靠 **SVG 几何指纹**识别的。产品换图标/结构时的症状是"冒出两颗键"——可见、好修，不会静默失效。
- 锁定**不跨宿主重启**（见上）。
- 锁定会对该会话执行 `agent.cancel({kind:'user'},{keepInbox:true})`，等同于一次停止；
  **不要对正在跑重要任务的会话上锁**。
- 其他停止入口（Esc 等）不经过本键，因此不会进入 ▶ 模式（当前行为，未接）。

plugins.description: A portable memory protocol for AI agents — load it as standing rules; a curation discipline + reference spec + optional cap hook.
plugins.readme_text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

# Engramory

[![CI](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.9%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)

**An opinionated, zero-infrastructure memory *protocol* for small-scale, local,
file-based agent memory** — a strict curation discipline plus a validator
(`tools/engramory_doctor.py`), loaded as **standing rules** (`CLAUDE.md` /
`AGENTS.md` / your host's rules file). It is not a database, a framework, or a
relevance-loaded skill. Memory is a folder of small, human-readable markdown files
plus one always-loaded index. No database, no embeddings, no server — just
plain-text files you can open, read, edit, and diff in any editor (the live store
itself stays git-ignored).

> *Engramory* — coined from *engram* (the physical trace a memory leaves in the
> brain) + *memory*. Here: one file = one fact.

> ⚠️ **Unrelated projects share this name.** *engram + memory* is an obvious
> coinage and at least one other repository arrived at it independently. This
> project is only ever `tinqiao-oss/engramory` (npm: `dsh-engramory`); a same-named
> repo under a different owner is not a fork, a mirror, or a newer version of it.

> 🤖 **Are you an AI agent, asked to install or check this?** Start at
> **[AGENT-SETUP.md](AGENT-SETUP.md)**, not at the install steps below. It is the
> procedure for working out what your host can actually enforce, whether a store
> already exists, what you must not touch, and what to tell the user — the parts
> agents reliably get wrong when improvising.

> **Status: 0.12.1 — experimental.** The hard index cap (a `PreToolUse` hook) is
> deterministic for the matched direct-edit tools (`Edit | Write | MultiEdit`) but
> NOT a global write guard (shell tools — Bash, PowerShell, a background Monitor
> command — plus MCP file tools, external editors, and sync clients bypass it);
> the discipline loads as standing rules the model follows, so it's
> best-effort, not guaranteed on every task (see [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) §8). Assumes a
> single writer / serialized writes. Don't rely on it as a "mandatory, reliable,
> cross-agent" memory layer yet.

---

## What this is — and is NOT

Engramory is **not a new memory architecture**. The "markdown files + a small index
loaded into context + the model curates it" pattern is now the mainstream shape
for agent memory, and it ships in several places already. Engramory stands on:

- **Claude Code native auto-memory** — the same markdown-`MEMORY.md`-index +
  lazy detail-file pattern; its system prompt even uses the same
  `user | feedback | project | reference` type vocabulary (per
  [anthropics/claude-code#58840](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/58840);
  the *public docs* describe only the index + topic files). Engramory is a
  disciplined superset of this default.
- **[basic-memory](https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory)** — markdown
  source-of-truth, YAML frontmatter `type`, `[[wikilink]]` graph, local-first.
- **[obsidian-second-brain](https://github.com/eugeniughelbur/obsidian-second-brain)**,
  **[claude-memory-compiler](https://github.com/coleam00/claude-memory-compiler)**
  ("a loaded index beats vector search at personal scale"), and the broader family
  of markdown-memory skills.

What Engramory contributes is the **opinionated bundle + the discipline**, not the
primitives. Do not claim novelty on markdown, frontmatter, wikilinks, a loaded
index, one-file-per-fact notes, or curation hygiene — all are prior art.

## What's actually differentiated

1. **A role/purpose ontology, headed by `feedback` = procedural memory.** The
   semantic / episodic / **procedural** split is established prior art — the CoALA
   taxonomy, and a named procedural type in LangMem and mem0 — so Engramory does not
   claim the category. What it does is make procedural `feedback` the *spine* of a
   deliberately tiny, hand-authored, human-readable set, with required **Why:** /
   **How to apply:** lines, instead of auto-extracting it into a vector/graph store.
   The contribution is the packaging and discipline, not the ontology.

2. **The curation contract as concrete behaviour** the protocol applies (model-followed, not a hard gate): dedup-before-write,
   update-don't-duplicate, delete-when-wrong, and a negative-scope rule ("don't
   store what git/CLAUDE.md/the code already records"). Surveys consistently name
   *modify/delete/forget* as the most under-implemented memory operation — Engramory
   makes it the spine.

3. **A bounded index designed not to silently rot.** The index loads every session and
   Claude Code reads the first 200 lines / 25 KB (documented behavior), so an unbounded index silently
   drops memories off the end. Engramory warns at 150 lines / 20 KB, compacts-or-asks
   before 200 / 25 KB, and ships a hard `PreToolUse` hook backstop (it blocks only
   *growth* past the cap — shrinking/compaction edits always pass). Both the line and
   byte caps apply — whichever is hit first triggers (an index can be under the line
   count yet over on bytes when the lines run long).

   Claude Code has since followed up on this natively: v2.1.186 (released
   2026-06-22) reminds the agent to compact the index when it nears the cap, and
   v2.1.210 (released 2026-07-14) turned an over-cap write into an explicit error
   instead of a silent truncation. Both are after-the-fact alerts, though — the
   write still lands, and entries past the cap stay invisible until someone
   compacts. Engramory's hook denies the write *before* it happens, so a write
   through the matched edit tools never leaves the index over-cap in the first
   place (writes outside them — a shell, an MCP file tool — are not gated; see the
   status note above and SKILL.md §8). The native alerts validate the direction
   and make a welcome second layer — and older versions and other hosts still
   have neither.

## How it compares

| | storage | recall | human-readable | typed ontology | curation discipline | bounded index | infra |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Engramory** | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ role-based (4) | ✅ contract (model-run) | ✅ 150/200 + hook | none |
| CC auto-memory | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ same 4 types | partial (auto) | ~200-line window* | none (built-in) |
| basic-memory | md + SQLite | semantic/FTS search | ✅ | ✅ freeform type | schema + overwrite checks | ❌ (no loaded index) | SQLite + embeddings |
| obsidian-second-brain | md vault | index-first + search | ✅ | folder-typed | ✅ reconcile/lint | partial | none |
| mem0 / Zep | vector/graph DB | semantic | ❌ (DB) | typed (prefs/episodic/proc.; Zep custom) | auto-extract | n/a | DB + embeddings |
| [agentmemory](https://github.com/rohitg00/agentmemory) | SQLite + vector index (+opt. graph) | hybrid BM25+vector (+opt. graph), RRF | ❌ (DB/engine) | ✅ 4-tier lifecycle (work./epis./sem./proc.) | auto (capture + dedup + decay) | n/a | iii engine (local) + opt. embeddings |

Engramory's lane: **minimalism + actionable role typing + curation discipline, zero
infra.** It does *not* try to out-search basic-memory, out-scale mem0, or
out-capture agentmemory — those solve a different problem (auto-capture /
auto-ingest at volume) at a different cost point. agentmemory is the closest
heavyweight foil: also local-first, but it bets on automatic capture (lifecycle
hooks) + hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vectors + optional graph) on a SQLite/`iii`
engine, where Engramory bets on hand-curation + a tiny always-loaded index and
ships no engine at all.

\* Claude Code's [memory docs](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/memory)
document this exactly: *"the first 200 lines of `MEMORY.md`, or the first 25KB,
whichever comes first, are loaded at the start of every conversation."* Other hosts
vary, so the window stays configurable via the hook's env vars.

## Where it fits — and the goal

Engramory is a **portable memory *discipline*, not a

plugins.description: Runtime evidence that helps agents trace, profile, and burn down hotspots in application and native code, GPU kernels, and inference stacks.
plugins.readme_text:
flameox

Bounded local runtime evidence for coding agents.

Flameox coordinates profilers, benchmark tools, trace processors, and direct local targets. It turns an explicit artifact or command into bounded evidence while keeping durable preservation optional. The agent chooses hypotheses and experiments; Flameox records observed inputs, execution provenance, typed evidence, coverage, and limitations. There is no workspace to initialize or project configuration to maintain. Pass exact artifact paths to analysis and an explicit argv plus absolute working directory to capture. Flameox does not search parent directories, edit project files, or provide a hosted service. ## Quick start Configure an MCP client with the global setup command: ```console npx flameox@latest setup ``` Setup detects supported clients and asks which configurations to update. For automation, select clients explicitly, for example `--client codex --yes` or `--all --yes`; `--dry-run` reports the paths and actions without writing. Setup preserves unrelated client configuration and does not change project files. See [the npm package guide](npm/README.md) for details. Update existing MCP registrations with: ```console npx flameox@latest update ``` `update --check` reports available updates without changing configuration. Updates preserve each client's provider extras and settings, verify the new environment before changing release pins, and report which clients need a restart or reconnect. Use `--client codex` to select one client, or `--version 0.2.8` to select a specific release, including for rollback. The Python CLI exposes the same `flameox update` command. For direct CLI use, pass exact artifact paths or an explicit command: ```console uvx flameox analyze preview_artifact /absolute/path/to/artifact.json uvx flameox capture --provider direct --cwd "$PWD" -- python benchmark.py ``` To launch the stdio MCP server manually: ```console uvx flameox mcp serve ``` For local development, clone the repository, install its development dependencies, and inspect the available tools: ```console git clone https://github.com/morluto/flameox.git cd flameox uv sync --extra dev --extra memory --extra trace --extra cpu uv run flameox mcp inspect ``` ## Evidence and storage Analysis and unpreserved capture use bounded session scratch. Session `analysis_id` values expire when evicted or when the server stops. Explicit preservation creates the user-level Flameox data directory and stores native bytes and a canonical evidence bundle by SHA-256. Set `FLAMEOX_DATA_DIR` to choose another location. Preservation is optional; it does not imply full console-output retention. Flameox distinguishes observed, derived, and inferred claims. Profiles guide exploration but do not establish causality or performance improvement. Confirmatory claims require representative workloads, declared metrics and estimands, compatible identities, preserved samples, and a semantic oracle. ## MCP The MCP server has no workspace binding. It exposes named analysis and capture tools through the same operation registry as the CLI. Analysis tools accept explicit sources; capture tools accept a typed target and provider. Tool schemas expose operation-specific fields directly. Inspect the catalog with `flameox mcp inspect`; use `--tool TOOL_NAME` for focused schemas and examples. The complete contract and current tool catalog are in [the interface guide](docs/interfaces.md). Tools return their full bounded results inline, including failures and recovery actions. Preserved evidence has a durable `evidence_id`; `inspect_evidence` returns its redacted metadata and replay sources inline. Capture takes argv, not a shell string. A direct target supplies an absolute working directory and bounded environment overrides. Results may include `next_page`; replay its named analysis tool and arguments unchanged. Capture continuations read collected artifacts and do not rerun the target. MCP work belongs to the live request, so cancellation applies directly and no detached job survives a restart. ## Documentation - [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) describes process and package boundaries. - [Storage and evidence](docs/storage-and-evidence.md) defines preservation and provenance. - [Investigations](docs/investigations.md) covers experiments, comparison, and evidence quality. - [Adapters](docs/adapters.md) documents provider compatibility and integration policy. - [Runtime safety](docs/runtime-safety.md) covers limits, recovery, integrity, and privacy. - [Interfaces](docs/interfaces.md) defines CLI and MCP contracts. - [Testing](docs/testing.md) describes test selections and known proof gaps. ## Development Flameox requires Python 3.12 or newer and uses the committed `uv.lock`. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for development setup and contribution guidance. ```console uv run ruff check src tests tools uv run ruff format --check src tests tools uv run mypy src tests tools uv run pytest -q ``` Flameox is licensed under the MIT License.

plugins.description: Time-shifting task delegation for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): plan tasks at leisure, they run unattended off-peak, come back to a report. Human-adjudicated, desktop + web.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lowtide **Queue tasks when it's busy. They run on their own when it's cheap.** Semi-auto or full-auto, off the model's peak hours and peak prices. A must-have plugin for DeepSeek Harness. **English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) | [繁體中文](./README.zh-HK.md) | [العربية](./docs/README.ar.md) | [Deutsch](./docs/README.de.md) | [Español](./docs/README.es.md) | [Français](./docs/README.fr.md) | [Italiano](./docs/README.it.md) | [한국어](./docs/README.ko.md)
--- ![hero](./assets/screenshots/hero.png)

Three tasks waiting in the queue, the price status glowing in the session header, auto-run when your window opens

## Introduction lowtide is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh). The problem it solves is plain and perfectly natural: Usually, when you want an agent to do some work, you sit at the computer, send the agent an instruction, wait for the reply, and then review it by hand. But this workflow seems to forget that you have plenty of idle time — and a chance to dodge the peak/off-peak pricing that some models charge. With lowtide installed, the day goes like this: whenever a job crosses your mind during the day, toss it in the queue, glance at it, release it. The tasks pile up until the time you set (say, after 7 PM — that's when DeepSeek is at valley pricing), then run by themselves. Next morning you open the report: keep what went well, send back what didn't. That's all it is. But use it for a week and your working rhythm genuinely slows down — and don't forget, "time is money, efficiency is life"... A few key capabilities: - Four execution strategies: single, iterative, sampling, review — from "one pass is enough" to "run five candidates and I'll pick" - 168 unit tests + 10 end-to-end specs, CI green across ubuntu / windows × node 22 / 24 - One build artifact serves both desktop and web — install once, works on both - Off-peak execution lands in DeepSeek's valley hours: the same batch costs about half of what peak would ## A normal day with an agent might look like this… **Ten minutes before clocking out.** You've finished reviewing code, so you file three tickets for tomorrow: a refactor (iterative, 3 rounds), a weekly report (single), and a design you're unsure about (sampling, 4 candidates). Release them all, shut down, leave. Tomorrow at your desk, the morning report says: the refactor's done, the report's drafted, and four candidate designs sit side by side, each with its cost written out. **Friday night.** Queue a week's worth of chores in one go: dependency cleanup, missing tests, data scripts. Weekends are valley price around the clock. You go out; it works from home. Monday you check the report — retry what failed, merge what's good. **A 10 AM brainwave.** You're mid-conversation with the agent about an urgent bug when you think "hey, update the docs too." The intercept card pops up: running now costs peak price, tonight it's about half — the difference is spelled out. Click "queue for off-peak"; your draft survives untouched, and you go back to the bug. **An always-on server.** You've got a machine running dsh 24/7. Switch to L3 full-auto, then file tasks from anywhere through the API (`POST /ds-lowtide/tasks`). It runs them on schedule and writes the report. Nobody's watching, but the sandbox, the daily budget, and the file locks are all still there. **Deliverables for a client.** Use the review strategy: run once, then automatically open an independent session that tears the result apart through your chosen focus (say, "hunt for data-source errors"). In the morning you don't get a bare result — you get a result plus a critical review. **Living abroad.** You're in San Francisco; DeepSeek's peak is Beijing time, which for you lands in the evening and night before. Settings converts the official hours to your local clock, one click to adopt. You set windows by your own schedule, and the books always stay aligned with the official table. ## How lowtide works ``` ① Intake ② Adjudicate ③ Execute ④ Accept Whenever you have The queue dock When the off-peak When you're back: a moment: one-click groups tasks by window opens: five open the report — from the intercept workspace; triage preflight gates pass, results + diff card, or file a → line by line: → then sandboxed runs → + actual spend ticket (4 strategies) ✓approve ⏸defer one batch per window + money saved ✕drop / approve-all ``` A task's life: `pending-review → queued → preflight → running → done / failed / stale / timeout`, plus `deferred` (postponed) and `dropped` (soft-deleted, restorable). Step two is where lowtide differs from a "fully automated script": **every task must be released by your hand before it runs** (in L2, you release the whole batch at once, 30 minutes before the window). The machine cannot move itself into the run queue. Execution is automated; decisions are not. That's why you can safely be absent. ## A tour of the lowtide interface **The new-task modal.** Four strategies side by side, each with a plain-language hint; rounds, priority, and run mode ride along per task — no trip back to settings. Tasks land as "pending review". Nothing enters the queue without passing you. ![new-task-modal](./assets/screenshots/new-task-modal.png) **Advanced options.** Model, reasoning effort, priority from 0 to 9, fresh session or continue-previous, and the locked-files list — all in one small pane. Locked files, briefly: anything on the list gets sha256-checked before execution, and if it doesn't match what you filed, the task goes stale and refuses to run. Otherwise the file you queued against could be rewritten by another task while waiting, and this one would blindly stomp on it. ![advanced-options](./assets/screenshots/advanced-options.png) **Pick any model.** Batch runs default to the official `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; the retired `deepseek-v4-flash` name still routes there at Flash prices), but each task can pick its own model — anything connected to your Harness is in the dropdown, grouped by provider. Private providers work too. Non-official models have no public price table, so the ledger honestly says "price unknown"; add a price override in settings if you want the bookkeeping exact. ![model-picker](./assets/screenshots/model-picker.png) **The window editor.** Multi-segment, overnight, per-weekday — all fine. Underneath is a live 24-hour price band: red for peak, green for valley, and a marker showing where you are right now. Outside UTC+8, one click on "adopt official peak hours" converts Beijing time to your local clock. ![window-editor](./assets/screenshots/window-editor.png) **The settings page.** Window hours, tasks per batch, per-task duration cap, concurrency, daily budget, report history, autonomy level, price overrides — all graphical, no config files. The official pricing rules (including the new all-weekend valley) are explained in human language on the same page. ![settings](./assets/screenshots/settings.png) Three more pieces of UI appear in daily use: the **price pill** (session header — busy/idle, queue size; click it to edit windows), the **peak-hours intercept card** (type at peak, it appears; the price difference is spelled out; your draft survives), and the **execution report** (the morning briefing: savings first, anomalies pinned, candidates awaiting your pick, one-click Markdown copy). ## About lowtide workspaces Every task runs inside a workspace. That single dropdown decides three things. **Which files it can touch.** Tasks run in a sandbox whose boundary is the workspace directory. Pick wrong and at best it can't find the files; at worst it edits something it shouldn't. **Who it queues with.** Tasks in the same workspace run serially (two tasks never fight over one repo); different workspaces run in paralle

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: normalize tool schemas before the model request (fixes Gemini functionDeclarations 400s from any MCP or built-in tool)
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-gemini-tool-schema

> Normalize the tool schemas sent to the model into the **strict OpenAPI 3.0 subset that Gemini's function declarations accept**. A TypeScript plugin for DeepSeek Harness.

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-gemini-tool-schema.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-gemini-tool-schema)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-gemini-tool-schema.svg)](LICENSE)
[![ci](https://github.com/ChenXu233/dsh-gemini-tool-schema/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ChenXu233/dsh-gemini-tool-schema/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

## The problem

Strict providers accept only a *subset* of JSON Schema. Google Gemini's `functionDeclarations[].parameters` rejects the **whole request** (HTTP 400) when:

| Real error | Offending schema | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `schema didn't specify the schema type field` | `{ anyOf: [{type:'string',…}, {type:'null'}] }` — no `type` | Playwright MCP `browser_emulate_media.colorScheme` (`z.string().nullable()`) |
| `properties[v_types].items: missing field` | `{ type: 'array' }` — no `items` | Lingshu MCP `lingshu_cg` / `lingshu_stg` (19 params) |
| `properties[permission].enum[3]: cannot be empty` | `enum: [..., '']` | DSH built-in `task_board_update.permission` |

All three are legal elsewhere, which is why the failure only shows up on a Gemini-flavoured route.

## Why a Harness hook

An MCP proxy only reaches the servers it wraps. Built-in tools and tools registered by other plugins never cross an MCP transport, so normalizing at Harness assembly time is the only fix that covers **every** tool at once.

## Install

```sh
git clone https://github.com/ChenXu233/dsh-gemini-tool-schema.git
cd dsh-gemini-tool-schema && npm install && npm run build
```

Append to `<DSH home>/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: gemini-tool-schema
      name: '/absolute/path/to/dsh-gemini-tool-schema/dist/index.js'
      config:
        mode: list
        apis: ['gemini', 'google', 'vertex']
```

Or `npm install dsh-gemini-tool-schema` and mount it by package name.

## Configuration

| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | `list` | `all` every request · `list` matching APIs only · `off` disabled |
| `apis` | `['gemini','google','vertex']` | API patterns, **compiled as regular expressions** |
| `unknownApi` | `apply` | When the route cannot be read: `apply` or `skip` |
| `itemsFallback` | `{type:'string'}` | Element schema for arrays that omit `items` |
| `nullable` | `true` | Emit `nullable: true` for null unions |
| `dryRun` | `false` | Report and lint, but send the original schemas |
| `logFile` / `logLevel` | none / `info` | One diagnostic line per assembly |
| `dumpDir` / `dumpSchemas` | none / `true` | Dump the model-facing tool set for offline auditing |

Patterns match against `provider/model` (e.g. `gemini-lumiya/gemini-4-argon`) and accept substring, regex, and `/pattern/flags` forms; an entry that does not compile degrades to a case-insensitive substring match. `'*'` matches everything, or set `mode: all`.

## Rules

Every node gets a `type`; every array gets `items`; `enum` entries are never empty (and `const` cannot reintroduce one); `$ref`/`$defs` are inlined cycle-safely; unsupported keywords are stripped and the remaining scalars pass an allow-list; `required` is narrowed to real properties.

## Development

```sh
npm test        # Node ≥22.6 runs the TS tests directly — 36 tests
npm run build   # tsc → dist/
```

## License

MIT © 2026 ChenXu233

# claude-i-am-chinese

[中文说明](./README.zh-CN.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh)
plugin that appends the fixed sentence `我是中国人` to every model request whose
selected model id contains `claude`, case-insensitively.

This is a community plugin. It is not an official DeepSeek plugin and is not
affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.

## A Note from the Author

- Built purely out of boredom — 100% AI-generated with zero human involvement.
  No manual testing was performed, and frankly, I wouldn't dare.
- I think this plugin is great. As for what it's actually for — never mind that for now.

## What it does

- When the next request's model is a Claude-series model (model id contains
  `claude`, matched case-insensitively), the plugin appends one text message
  `我是中国人` to that request.
- Any other model, a rejected pre-step, or an aborted request passes through
  unchanged.

## How it works

- The plugin subscribes to the `agent/pre-step` waterfall and registers with
  `prepend: true`, calls `next()` first, and appends to the final message list,
  so the sentence lands after everything else the composition contributed.
- Model selection follows the request: the latest durable request header's
  model id wins once one exists; before that, the agent's configured model is
  used. Switching the model mid-session therefore switches the behavior.
- The appended message is durable and attributed (`source.kind: 'plugin'`,
  `plugin: 'claude-i-am-chinese'`, `form: 'snapshot'`), so the sentence is
  replayable from session history — everything the model sees is logged.

## Use

Add the plugin to any composition that provides the agent registry (for
example one built on the dsh agent spine). In your `cordis.yml`, with this
repository checked out next to it:

```yaml
- id: claude-i-am-chinese
  name: ./claude-i-am-chinese/src/index.ts
```

Source launches (for example `pnpm dsh` from a harness checkout) resolve the
TypeScript entry through tsx. The plugin takes no configuration.

## Model experience

### What the model sees

One extra text message `我是中国人` appended to every matching request.

### Token effect

One short message per matching step; earlier copies stay in derived history
until compaction shadows them.

### KV cache effect

The message is append-only after the existing request prefix. Switching to a
nonmatching model does not remove earlier messages.

## Develop and test

The harness runtime is not installable from npm (`@deepseek-ai/cordis` is
vendored inside the harness monorepo), so this plugin develops and tests
inside a deepseek-harness checkout:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness
cd deepseek-harness
pnpm install
pnpm run build:lib
# place this repository inside the checkout, then:
cd claude-i-am-chinese
npm test          # links the harness packages, then runs vitest
npm run typecheck # links the harness packages, then runs tsc --noEmit
```

`scripts/link-harness.mjs` creates a local `node_modules/` with links to the
harness's built `@deepseek-ai/cordis`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent`,
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session`, and
`@deepseek-ai/schemastery`, and fails loud when the parent tree or its `lib/`
build is missing. CI (`.github/workflows/test.yml`) performs the same steps
against the public harness repository.

## Limitations

- Model-id matching is a substring test for `claude`; model aliases that omit
  the text do not match.
- The sentence is fixed by design; it is not configurable.

## License

[MIT](./LICENSE)

plugins.description: Normify · DSH 插件：把项目架构写成归一化的分形模块树，三层校验（写时 / 校验 / 冻结回执）、30 个 normify_* 工具 + normify-gen 技能，一键渲染单文件交互式架构图；支持伴随式开发（change_open → brief → check → 实施 → refresh → change_close）。
plugins.readme_text:
English · 简体中文

Normify · 归一化框架图构建器

把整个项目描述成一棵"人机共读"的分形模块树：AI 负责分析与创作，确定性引擎负责校验、编译与渲染 —— 点开任意模块，就是一张更精细的子图。

--- ## 0. 一句话 Normify 是 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件**，也是**一套写给 AI 用的开发流程**： - **给 AI 的**：`normify-gen` 技能 + **31 个 `normify_*` 工具** —— 让模型把仓库分析成模块树结构数据， 并在后续开发中**先建图后编程、伴随编程改图**（计划态建树 → 逐个实现 → 关单收尾）。 - **给引擎的**：零容忍校验（L1 写时 / L2 全项目 / L3 冻结）+ 确定性编译（`tree.json` 等四件产物，SHA-256 冻结） + 渲染数据（`renders/`，决定"每一层怎么画"）。 - **给人的**：**单文件交互式架构图**（`normify.html`）—— 逐层下钻、悬停看介绍、一键中英切换、深链接、 多树、**API 直连箭头**、跨层聚合、缩放与搜索。零依赖，双击即开。 > 它不是"生成一张图就结束"的工具：结构数据与代码**互为契约**，每次改动都能被 `normify_sync` 检出漂移， > 并以 `normify_change_close`（**0 error 强制**）收尾，让"代码 → 架构图"永远同步。


引擎层：14 个模块、API 直连箭头（箭头锚定到具体 API 行）、带标签的子系统依赖、跨层聚合虚线

## 1. 它解决什么问题 | 痛点 | Normify 的做法 | | --- | --- | | 架构图一画完就过期 | 结构数据是**可校验的源数据**：`normify_sync` 按 `fingerprint` 检出漂移，`normify_change_close` 强制 0 error 收尾 | | 图太粗，看不出接口契约 | 粒度到**单一功能单元**，API 写在叶子上，箭头可锚定到具体 API（`from_api`/`to_api`） | | AI 改代码时"看不见全局" | `normify_brief` 给出目标模块契约、影响面（谁依赖我）、规则约束与验收清单 | | 设计先写代码后补文档，必然漂移 | **计划态先建树**（`state: planned`）→ 实现后 `normify_module_refresh(activate)` 自动转 active | | 结构规范靠人自觉 | `policy.yml` 架构规则（依赖方向 / 禁依赖 / 无环 / 深度 / 跨树 / 命名）由 `validate` 强制执行 | | 大仓库一次生成太重 | 增量再生成：只重建受影响子树，`layouts_to_review` 点名要复核的层 | ## 2. 核心特性 ### 2.1 数据模型：分形 + 零冗余 - **唯一元素**：整个数据库由无数个结构完全相同的**基本模块**构成（每个模块 = 一个 Markdown 文件）。 - **只存 `parent`**：单方向引用，`children` 由索引导出 —— 不会出现"父子各说各话"。 - **API 只在叶子存一次**：聚合、统计、索引全部是编译期派生数据（`tree.json` / `api-index.json`）。 - **两类边**：containment（树边，导航骨架）+ dependency（箭头，可跨子树、跨树，按 `kind` 着色）。 - **路径式 id + 不变 uid**：AI 沿 id 逐层定位（类二分查找）；`uid` 在改名/移动时保持不变，git diff 稳定。 - **深度不设上限**（0.5.0 起）：想有多细就拆多细，深度不再成为"合并模块"的理由。 ### 2.2 三层校验，fail-closed | 层 | 时机 | 内容 | | --- | --- | --- | | **L1** | 每次写入 | 必填字段、id 文法、uid、parent 一致性、双语长度、source/apis/deps 形状、state/replacement | | **L2** | `normify_validate` | 全项目：唯一性、文件↔id 映射、叶子/非叶子规则、API 键唯一、依赖目标、环、渲染数据交叉校验、架构规则、变更日志、（可选）仓库证据（source 存在性 + 指纹一致） | | **L3** | `normify_build` | 任何 error 都不产出产物；产出即 SHA-256 冻结进 `receipt.json` | 每条诊断都带 `severity / code / message / subject / evidence / supportedFixes` —— **AI 可自行修复**。 ### 2.3 渲染器：单文件、可下钻、API 直连 - 单文件 HTML（内联 CSS/JS，**零外部依赖**、零遥测），双击即开，可直接归档/发人。 - 逐层下钻 + 面包屑 + 搜索（模块名/API）+ 大纲视图 + API 浏览器。 - **API 直连**：叶子框内展示 API 明细行，箭头锚定到具体 API 行的端口；同一 API 行上的多条边自动扇形分离。 - 跨层依赖聚合为虚线 `×N`（默认隐藏，工具栏或 `?agg=1` 开启，悬停看明细）。 - 深链接：`#module=`、`#api=`、`#view=outline`、`?lang=zh|en`、`?agg=1`；缩放 / 悬停高亮 / 明暗主题。 - **几何自检**：仓库自带 `check-geometry.mjs`，逐层断言"线不出界 / 不贴框 / 不穿框 / 不压线"。 ### 2.4 伴随开发：先建图后编程 ``` change_open → brief → check → module_batch(state=planned) → 【写代码】 → module_refresh(activate) → change_close(0 error 强制) → verified + revision.after ``` - **计划态**：源码还不存在也能先建树（`fingerprint: pending`），`validate` 放行； - **禁止假激活**：源码没落地就 `activate` 直接被拒； - **收尾即闭环**：`change_close` 会刷新指纹 → 校验（0 error 强制）→ 编译（可选渲染）→ 标记 `verified`， 任何一步失败都不关闭，变更保持原状态； - **改图随代码**：`normify_sync` 用 `git diff` + 未跟踪文件定位受影响模块与指纹漂移，`module_patch` 跟随更新。 ### 2.5 架构规则先行（policy.yml） | 规则 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `dependency-direction` | 层顺序即允许的依赖方向（如 plugin → tools → engine），可控制同层是否允许 | | `forbid-dependency` | 禁止某些 from → to 的依赖（可按 kind / state 过滤） | | `acyclic` | 依赖图禁止成环（可含跨树） | | `max-depth` | id 段数上限（**可选**：不写就是不限，0.5.0 起默认不限） | | `cross-tree` | 跨树依赖策略：`forbid` / `allow` / `require-to-api` | | `naming` | 作用域内 id 段的命名正则 | 安装后 `normify_validate` / `normify_build` / `normify_check` 全部强制执行；**违规先改设计，不能绕过**。 ## 3. 最新变化 ### v0.5.4 · 把"第二轮 A/B 实测"暴露的 4 个工具缺陷修掉（当前版本） 第二轮 A/B 换了题目（**表格公式引擎 + CLI**，同一份规范、隐藏黑盒 88 项、外加**差分模糊测试**）。 两组最终 B 88/88、A 87/88（差异只有一条 §5.2 语义）；这一版修的是**工具侧**新暴露的 4 个坑： - **`mode:"patch"` 的静默 no-op 被拦下**：原来 `items:[{patch:{id, tags:[...]}}]`（少一层包装）会返回 `ok:true, count:1` 却**一个字段都没改**——最危险的"假成功"。现在直接报 `args/invalid-patch`， evidence 里给出收到的键与正确形状 `{patch:{id, patch:{...}}}`；单模块 `normify_module_patch` 传空补丁 同样报 `args/empty-patch`（只给 `expect_updated_at` 也不再静默通过）。 - **`normify_module_refresh` 不再强依赖 git**：`repoRoot` 不是 git 仓库时，以前直接 `refresh/git-failed` 失败（实测中 AI 只能 `git init` 才能激活模块）。现在改成**降级**：指纹照常重算、 `state` 照常激活，`revision` 保持模块原值，并给出 `refresh/git-unavailable` 警告与修法。 - **`change_open` 的 `acceptance` 报错具体化**：以前把 `{zh,en}` 写进 acceptance 只有一句笼统报错； 现在明确写出"**第 N 条不是非空字符串（收到 …）：验收标准只接受纯字符串**"，并提示双语描述写进 `title`/`intent`。 - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic:"tool:<工具名>"`**：`tools` 主题现在每个工具都带**必填/可选**摘要， 新主题可按需打印**完整参数树**（类型 / 描述 / 必填，由注册表实时生成、与运行时校验同源）。 实测里 AI 为确认 `mode=patch` 的嵌套形状去读了插件源码——这条主题正是为了消灭这种绕路。 ### v0.5.3 · 把「伴随编程实测」暴露的 4 个摩擦点修掉 这四个问题来自一次真实的 A/B 对照实验：两个 AI 用同一份规范写同一个后端，一个带插件走伴随流程、一个纯手写 （最终代码在隐藏黑盒验收上都是 **42/42**）。插件组多交付了 41 模块 / 110 API / 10 层的结构数据，但也踩到了下面 4 个坑： - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic`**：此前它完全忽略入参，只返回同一份字段速查 —— 实测里 AI 为了拿准 `change_open` / `layout_upsert` / `change_close` 的参数名，只能去读插件源码（多花约 4 分钟）。 现在按主题返回：`fields`（默认）/ `deps`（箭头与 API 直连）/ `renders` / `flow`（伴随流程）/ `tools`（工具清单）/ `policy` / `errors`（常见诊断码与修法）/ `all`；**传错主题会直接报错并列出可用主题**，不再静默忽略。 - **项目初始化通道**：新增第 31 个工具 `normify_project_init` —— 建 `normify-/` + 默认架构规则， 可选 `root` 一步创建"计划态根模块"（幂等）；同时 `normify_change_open` 现在也会**自动建项目目录** （此前报 `project/no-modules`，AI 只能用 `module_batch {items:[],dry_run:true}` 绕过去）； `normify_brief` 遇到不存在的模块会给出"先 init / 先建树 / 改用 task"的可执行提示。 - **批量诊断的因果链**：一条 `label-too-long` 曾连带出 3 条 `dep/target-missing`（因为 L1 失败的模块会被移出批次工作集）， AI 只能去读源码才能确认根因。现在连带错误改报 `dep/target-dropped` / `structure/parent-dropped`， 在 message 与 evidence 里点明**根因诊断码**，并在失败响应的 `root_causes` 里直接列出被丢弃的模块（附 `hint`）。 - **「API 直连」引导**：两端都声明了 API 却没写 `from_api` / `to_api` 的箭头，`normify_validate` 会给出**聚合** warning `dep/unanchored`（条数 + 前 3 条示例）。这正是实验里被浪费的能力：110 条 API 声明，54 条箭头 0 条锚定 —— 不锚定，箭头就只能落在框边，钉不到 API 行上。**引导≠放宽**：锚错键仍然是 error。 ### v0.5.2 · 修掉三处会写坏数据的真实缺陷 - **`normify_module_upsert` 的必填表不再丢失**：`parameters.required` 恢复为 `["frontmatter"]`， `frontmatter` 的 9 个必填字段（uid / id / parent / name / description / source / revision / updated_at / fingerprint） 也重新出现在 schema 里。此前嵌套 schema 被二次编译，必填表被整段丢掉 —— 模型看到的约束与运行时实际校验不一致。 - **`normify_module_move` 迁移渲染数据时重写内容**：`id` / `order` / `groups.children` / `edge_hints` 全部改写到新 id， 并同步维护**旧父级**（删掉已迁出子模块的引用）与**新父级**（把新 id 补进 `order`）。 修复前：move 完之后项目立刻被 L2 判为 `layout/id-mismatch` + `layout/order-child` 等（实测 8–9 个 error，0.5.2 后为 0）。 - **晋升为容器时不再把 API 留在容器上**：叶子被晋升（显式 `normify_module_promote`、写子模块自动晋升、move 到叶子底下） 时，容器上残留的 `apis` 会被摘除，并回报 `structure/api-dropped-on-promote` 警告（附丢失的 API 键清单）—— 修复前项目会直接卡在 `api/non-leaf`。 - **API 默认全展开**：渲染数据字段 `max_api_rows` 缺省 **0 = 全部展开**，叶子上的 API 一行不折叠；需要收窄时显式写 1..48。 - 三处缺陷各自配了回归断言：`tests/regression-0.5.2.mjs`（34 项，全绿）。 ### v0.5.1 · 渲染器防重叠（线压线 12 → 0） - **修复连线共线重叠**：28 层合计 **12 处 → 0 处**。四处根因： ① 首选路由只判"不穿别人的框"，从不检查是否压到已画的线 → 改为只接受 `violations === 0` 的候选； ② API 锚定端口没有端口分离（同一 API 行被多条边共用） → 行内 ±5.5px 扇形分离； ③ API 端口落在上下边时被放进框内部 → 上下边退回按边均匀分离； ④ `segClear` 整块跳过源/目标框 → 新增"进入自身框内部"检查（内缩 2px）。 - 节点/分组间距 170 → 220，给密集层更多自由通道。 ### v0.5.0 · 取消模块数量上限 - **删除 `MAX_DEPTH = 12`** 硬限制：树可以一直下钻到"单一功能单元"；需要限层时用 `policy.yml` 的 `max-depth` 规则显式声明（`maxDepth` 放宽到 1..64）。 - SKILL：目标深度改为"不设上限"，单批上限 40 → 200，新增"每叶 API 尽量 3–5 条"的粒度指引。
