plugins.readme_text:
# DSH-forJP-TUI

DeepSeek Harness (dsh) のための**日本語ネイティブ TUI**。

> **状態: Phase 0（走路骨格）完了。描画は未着手。**
> 自作バンドルが DSH の Cordis 木に載り、自前の入口（C）から起動し、C が壊れれば
> `dsh --profile` 子プロセス（B）へフォールバックし、`session/event` の生イベントを捕捉できる。
> 検証は `node scripts/verify-bundle.mjs`（12検査）。

## これは何か

dsh の TUI サーフェスを、日本語を第一級に扱う形で自作する。
既存の [dsh-TUI](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI) を参考にしつつ、
コードは共有せず、描画層から自分で設計する。

## 目的

| # | 目的 | 設計要求 |
|---|---|---|
| P1 | 見た目を自分で設計できる | 描画層を自前で握る。装飾演出を既定で入れない |
| P2 | 日本語ネイティブ | 文言を最初からカタログ化。日本語を言語パックに追い出さない |
| P3 | 上流更新で崩れにくい | 依存する上流の非公開契約を最小化し、その数を常時計測する |
| P4 | UX 研究の土台 | UI 層とハーネス層を分離し、UI の反復試行を安くする |
| P5 | 将来ハーネスごと差し替える（思想として保持） | ハーネス境界を1箇所に閉じ込める |
| P6 | ハーネスチューニング研究 | ハーネスの挙動を外から差し替え可能に保つ |

## 確定している方針

- **DSH への載せ方**: in-process の Cordis バンドル（`dsh.bundle.patch`）。承認・ユーザー質問・モデル切替を
  人対話で行うには、これ以外の経路が存在しない（公式 SDK / ACP には承認チャネルが無い）
- **起動**: 自前のフル host-entry を持つ。ただし**失敗時は必ず `dsh --profile` 子プロセスへフォールバック**する
- **描画層**: upstream の [Ink](https://github.com/vadimdemedes/ink) **v8.0.0**（commit `26d2c3f8`）を fork し、
  `src/ink/` に置いて自前で拡張する。Ink 本体はマウス選択・ヒットテスト・スクロール固定を持たないため、
  これらは自作する
- **v0 の範囲**: 入力解析 / 差分描画 / 全角幅 / 入力欄 / ストリーム表示 / ツールカード /
  承認パネル / ユーザー質問パネル / セッション結線 / 中断と終了

## ドキュメント

| 文書 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| [`docs/design/0001-architecture-and-roadmap.md`](docs/design/0001-architecture-and-roadmap.md) | **設計書とロードマップ**（決定ログ D1〜D9、Phase -1〜5、リスク R1〜R8） |
| [`docs/reports/2026-10-18-phase0-walking-skeleton.md`](docs/reports/2026-10-18-phase0-walking-skeleton.md) | **Phase 0 完了レポート**（達成項目・設計を変えた発見・やっていないこと） |
| [`docs/research/2026-10-18-dsh-bundle-authoring.md`](docs/research/2026-10-18-dsh-bundle-authoring.md) | バンドル／Cordis プラグインの書き方（公式実物からの抽出） |
| [`docs/research/2026-10-18-dsh-headless-recipe.md`](docs/research/2026-10-18-dsh-headless-recipe.md) | 公式 `dsh-headless` から抽出したエージェント駆動手順 |
| [`docs/research/2026-10-18-sandbox-and-dsh-home.md`](docs/research/2026-10-18-sandbox-and-dsh-home.md) | 実行環境の制約と `DSH_HOME` 差し替えによる検証方法 |
| [`docs/research/2026-10-18-dsh-integration-surfaces.md`](docs/research/2026-10-18-dsh-integration-surfaces.md) | DSH の統合面・バンドル契約・SDK プロトコル・Ink 反証 |
| [`docs/research/2026-10-18-dsh-core-public-surface.md`](docs/research/2026-10-18-dsh-core-public-surface.md) | DSH 本体の公開インターフェース |
| [`docs/research/2026-10-18-dsh-tui-seam.md`](docs/research/2026-10-18-dsh-tui-seam.md) | 参考実装が DSH とどう接続しているか |
| [`docs/research/2026-10-18-dsh-tui-feature-inventory.md`](docs/research/2026-10-18-dsh-tui-feature-inventory.md) | 参考実装の機能・UX 棚卸し |
| [`docs/research/2026-10-18-renderer-options.md`](docs/research/2026-10-18-renderer-options.md) | TypeScript TUI レンダラ基盤の比較 |
| [`docs/research/2026-10-18-dsh-third-party-tui-web.md`](docs/research/2026-10-18-dsh-third-party-tui-web.md) | DSH と第三者 TUI の外部情報 |

調査ノートには**環境依存のローカル絶対パスをマスク**してある（`$HOME/<workspace>/...`）。

## 開発

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm build
node scripts/verify-bundle.mjs          # 構造検査（A〜D）
COMMANDCODE_API_KEY=... node scripts/verify-bundle.mjs   # 実モデル実行まで（E）
```

検証は `$HOME/.dsh` に**一切書き込まない**。`DSH_HOME` をワークスペース内の `.dsh-home/` に向けて
プロファイルとバンドル解決を完結させる（[理由](docs/research/2026-10-18-sandbox-and-dsh-home.md)）。

入口は `lib/bin.js`（`dsh-forjp`）。環境変数で挙動を切り替えられる:

| 変数 | 値 | 意味 |
|---|---|---|
| `FORJP_ENTRY` | `auto`（既定） | C を試し、失敗したら B へフォールバック |
| | `in-process` | C のみ。失敗したら異常終了 |
| | `child` | B を強制 |
| `FORJP_PROFILE` | 既定 `forjp` | プロファイル名 |
| `DSH_FORJP_HOST_PACKAGE` | 未設定 | ホスト `@deepseek-ai/dsh` のパッケージディレクトリを明示 |

## ライセンス

MIT（[`LICENSE`](LICENSE)）。

fork 元の [Ink](https://github.com/vadimdemedes/ink) も MIT であり、`src/ink/` に取り込む時点で
Ink のライセンス表示を同梱する。

plugins.description: DSH 桌面通知：所有前端失焦时把决策 / 授权 / 中断 / 完成发到 Windows 通知中心；点击复用已有页面切回对话。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-desktop-notify

> 所有 DSH 前端都失焦时，把「需要你决策 / 需要你授权 / 意外中断 / 任务完成」发到 Windows 通知中心；通知标题是会话标题，点击通知复用已打开的 DSH 页面切回对应对话。

![Windows 通知截图](docs/notification.png)

![自绘通知卡片](docs/card.png)

## 安装

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add @carbonzhao/dsh-desktop-notify
```

重启 `dsh web`，然后硬刷新页面（Ctrl+Shift+R）。也可以从源码安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add github:CarbonZhao-02692/dsh-desktop-notify`。

## 能力分类

界面与体验。

## 它能做什么

| 事件 | 触发点 | 通知内容 |
|---|---|---|
| 需要你选择决策 | `user-questions/request`（含方案确认 plan-review） | `需要你选择决策：<问题>` |
| 需要你授权 | `approval/request` | `需要你授权：<工具名> — <原因>` |
| 意外中断，请重试 | `turn/end` reason=`error` / `interrupted` / `max-tokens`，以及 `api-session/error` | `任务意外中断：<错误>，请重试` |
| 任务已完成 | `turn/end` reason=`completed` | `任务已完成（用时 X）` |

通知标题取自**对应会话的标题**（`sessionTitle` 服务折叠出的标题）；标题还没生成时回退到该会话第一条用户消息。通知正文是对应提示。

## 焦点判定：所有 DSH 前端都失焦

每个 DSH 页面每 3 秒向 `/dsh-desktop-notify/focus` 上报：

```json
{ "id": "页面 id", "focused": true, "visible": true }
```

`focused = document.visibilityState === 'visible' && document.hasFocus()`。浏览器窗口失焦、切到其他标签页、焦点在地址栏，都会使 `focused` 为 false。

host 的门控只有一条：

- **任意一个页面 `focused=true` → 不是“所有前端失焦”，静默不发。**
- **所有已上报页面 `focused=false` → 发通知。**
- 页面关闭时通过 `sendBeacon` 上报 `closed: true`，立即从汇总移除。
- 后台标签页的定时器可能被浏览器节流，所以 3 分钟内没有心跳才按已关闭处理；所有页面都关闭时视为“全部失焦”。

`visible` 只用于状态展示，不参与门控。

## 通知模式与点击回到对话

配置项 `enableCard` 决定通知形态：

### `enableCard: false`（默认）

只显示正常的 Windows toast，不显示自绘卡片：

1. toast 带 `activationType="protocol"` 和 `launch="dsh-desktop-notify://open?session=<id>&origin=<origin>"`；Windows 调用协议 helper `assets/open.ps1`。
2. 同时启动 `assets/toast-listener.ps1`，在隐藏 PowerShell 进程里保持 `ToastNotification` 存活；如果 `Activated` 事件被投递，也会调用同一个 helper。
3. helper 把会话 id POST 到 host 的 `/dsh-desktop-notify/activate`，用 `ShowWindow` / `SetForegroundWindow` 恢复并置前 Edge/Chrome 窗口（只有最小化时才 `SW_RESTORE`，最大化保持不变）。
4. helper 通过 UI Automation 把标题匹配的 DSH 标签页切到前台；已打开的 DSH 页面每秒轮询 `/dsh-desktop-notify/activation`，收到后调用 `uiWorkspace.openSession(sessionId)`。
5. host 只把请求投递给**用户最后使用的那个页面**，多标签不会一起跳。

### `enableCard: true`

只显示右下角原生 WPF 卡片，不发送任何 Windows toast：

1. host 启动 `assets/notify-card.ps1`，显示应用名、鲸鱼图标、会话标题和正文，不抢焦点，20 秒后自动关闭。
2. 点击卡片调用 `assets/open.ps1`，后续的激活、窗口恢复、标签页切换与上面相同。
3. 不使用浏览器通知；通知中心不会留下记录。

**没有页面时的兜底**：如果 host 发现没有任何已连接的 DSH 页面，会让 helper 在默认浏览器打开一个引导页；引导页把会话 id 写入 `localStorage` 并跳回 DSH，新页面加载后自动打开对应对话。

## 设置页与测试

DSH 设置 → 通用 → **桌面通知**：

- 显示当前上报页面数和焦点汇总状态（有前端聚焦 = 静默中 / 全部失焦 = 会通知）。
- “自绘卡片”开关：切换 `enableCard`，立即生效并持久化到 `%DSH_HOME%\super-injector\dsh-desktop-notify-config.json`；关闭则只发 Windows toast，打开则只显示可点击卡片。
- “发送测试通知”按钮：强制发一条通知，忽略焦点门控，用来验证当前模式、应用名、图标与点击行为。

也可以直接调用 HTTP 接口：

```powershell
# 查看焦点状态与最近通知
Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing http://127.0.0.1:3080/dsh-desktop-notify/status

# 强制发一条测试通知（force 忽略焦点门控；带 sessionId 时点击会回到该对话）
$body = @{ kind='complete'; force=$true; sessionId='session-...'; body='测试通知' } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Method POST -ContentType 'application/json' `
  -Body ([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($body)) `
  http://127.0.0.1:3080/dsh-desktop-notify/test
```

## 配置

默认值在 `lib/index.js` 的 `DEFAULTS` 里；通过 loader 行的 `config` 覆盖：

```yaml
- id: dsh-desktop-notify
  name: '@carbonzhao/dsh-desktop-notify'
  config:
    onlyWhenUnfocused: true   # false = 页面聚焦时也发
    clickToOpen: true         # false = 通知不可点击回会话
    enableCard: false         # true = 仅自绘卡片；false = 仅普通 Windows toast
    ignoreSubagent: true      # 后台子代理会话不提醒
    notifyOnDecision: true
    notifyOnApproval: true
    notifyOnInterruption: true
    notifyOnComplete: true
    minTurnDurationMs: 0      # 完成提醒的最短轮次时长（毫秒）
    toastAppId: 'DeepSeek.DSH.Notify'
    toastAppName: 'Deepseek Harness Notification'
    toastIconPath: ''         # 默认 assets/deepseek-harness.png
    toastAppIconPath: ''      # 默认 assets/deepseek-harness.ico
```

## 兼容与运行要求

- DSH `web` profile；实测 `0.2.1-rc.2`（当前 checkout）。
- Windows 10 / 11，Windows PowerShell 5.1（WinRT toast）。
- Node.js >= 20。
- 页面必须保持打开才能上报焦点；没有页面时点击通知会走兜底新开页。
- 浏览器 / DSH Desktop 需要允许 Windows 通知；系统“专注助手”可能拦截。
- 仅实现 Windows toast；其他平台只写日志、不发通知。

## 权限与外部服务

- 写入 `HKCU\Software\Classes\dsh-desktop-notify`（自定义协议 helper）。
- 写入 `HKCU\Software\Classes\AppUserModelId\DeepSeek.DSH.Notify`（应用名与图标）。
- toast 模式会注册 `HKCU\Software\Classes\dsh-desktop-notify` 协议；卡片模式不发送 toast，也不注册协议。
- 通过 `powershell.exe` 显示 toast 或卡片，并在临时目录写一个 `.ps1` 脚本。
- helper 使用 Windows UI Automation 查找并切换浏览器标签页（不需要管理员权限）。
- 本机 HTTP 路由：`/focus`、`/status`、`/test`、`/activate`、`/activation`、`/open`；其中 `/activate` 和 `/open` 只接受 loopback 请求，`/open` 还需要每次进程随机生成的密钥。
- 没有外部服务、没有上传、没有网络请求（除本机 DSH 地址）。

## 真实输出

### toast 模式（`enableCard: false`）

```xml
<toast activationType="protocol" launch="dsh-desktop-notify://open?session=session-...&origin=http%3A%2F%2F127.0.0.1%3A3080">
  <visual><binding template="ToastGeneric">
    <text>示例会话标题</text>
    <text>点击通知应回到对应对话</text>
    <image placement="appLogoOverride" src="file:///.../assets/deepseek-harness.png"/>
  </binding></visual>
  <audio src="ms-winsoundevent:Notification.Default"/>
</toast>
```

### 卡片模式（`enableCard: true`）

```text
shown
clicked
start uri=dsh-desktop-notify://open?session=session-...
activate hwnd=... minimized=False maximized=True foreground=True
tab selected: 示例会话标题 — DeepSeek Harness ...
activation queued session=session-... target=dsh-... live=1
activation delivered session=session-... client=dsh-...
```

## 已知限制

- 后台子代理会话默认不提醒（它们的完成由主对话那一轮覆盖）。
- `enableCard: false` 时通知中心里的 toast 点击是否触发协议/Activated 取决于 Windows 环境；当前这台 Windows 10 上两者都未触发。
- `enableCard: true` 时可点击的是右下角原生卡片；卡片 20 秒后自动关闭。
- 窗口恢复/置前对 Edge/Chrome 使用 Win32 `ShowWindow` + `SetForegroundWindow`；只有最小化时才 `SW_RESTORE`，最大化窗口保持最大化。系统前台锁定、虚拟桌面切换等极端情况仍可能失败。
- 标签页切换 / 窗口激活目前针对 Edge / Chrome；DSH 在 Firefox 中时不会自动切回该标签页。
- 标签页切换按标题匹配；多个标签页标题相同时，可能选中同标题的另一个 DSH 标签页（仍会落在对应会话）。
- helper 日志：`%TEMP%\dsh-desktop-notify-helper.log`；卡片日志：`%TEMP%\dsh-desktop-notify-card.log`；toast listener 日志：`%TEMP%\dsh-desktop-notify-toast.log`。
- Windows 可能缓存 AUMID 的应用名/图标；重启 Explorer 或清空通知历史后会刷新。

## 开发

插件是纯 ESM/CJS JavaScript，无构建步骤、无第三方运行时依赖。

- host：[lib/index.js](lib/index.js)
- client：[lib/client.js](lib/client.js)
- 协议 helper：[assets/open.ps1](assets/open.ps1)
- toast listener：[assets/toast-listener.ps1](assets/toast-listener.ps1)
- 原生通知卡片：[assets/notify-card.ps1](assets/notify-card.ps1)
- 图标：[assets/deepseek-harness.png](assets/deepseek-harness.png)、[assets/deepseek-harness.ico](assets/deepseek-harness.ico)
- 条目：[cordis.patch.yml](cordis.patch.yml)

本地修改后重新加载插件或重启 DSH。

## License

MIT。见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

图标来自官方 DSH 前端资源（MIT）；DeepSeek Harness 与鲸鱼标识归各自所有者，本插件非官方出品。见 [NOTICE](NOTICE)。

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ui-zoom 界面缩放插件

[中文](README.md) | [English](README.en.md)

> 适用于 [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的全局 UI 缩放插件。类似于 VS Code 的窗口缩放机制，支持将整个界面等比例缩放至 80%、110%、125%、150% 等任意比例。

![UI 缩放图标](icon.svg)

---

## ✨ 功能特性

- 🔍 **等比整体缩放**：不同于单纯修改字体字号，本插件成比例缩放整个应用界面的所有元素（包括侧边栏、输入区域、按钮、对话卡片、间距、图标及字体）。
- ⚙️ **无缝融入设置面板**：自动注册至「**设置 -> 通用**」，紧跟在「字号」选项下方。
- 🎛️ **常用预设与微调**：
  - 常用预设快捷按钮：`80%`、`90%`、`100%`、`110%`、`125%`、`150%`。
  - 步进器按钮（`−` / `+`）支持平滑微调。
  - 一键 **重置 (100%)** 按钮。
- ⌨️ **全局快捷键支持**（VS Code 习惯）：
  - **`Ctrl` + `=`** 或 **`Ctrl` + `+`**（macOS 上为 `Cmd`）：放大界面。
  - **`Ctrl` + `-`**（macOS 上为 `Cmd`）：缩小界面。
  - **`Ctrl` + `0`**（macOS 上为 `Cmd`）：一键重置为 100%。
  - **`Ctrl` + 鼠标滚轮**：按住 Ctrl 滚动鼠标滚轮快速连续缩放。
- 🧭 **即时 HUD 提示**：使用快捷键或滚轮调整缩放时，屏幕右下角自动浮现半透明提示框展示当前缩放百分比。
- 🎯 **完美解决浮层错位（Double-Zoom Fix）**：内置视口坐标空间校准机制，解决 CSS `zoom` 下通过 `createPortal` 挂载的弹出菜单（如左下角用户名菜单、下拉选择器、工具提示等）位置错位或悬空的问题，始终精准贴合。
- 💾 **自动持久化**：缩放配置自动保存在本地缓存中，刷新页面或下次启动时自动恢复。

---

## 📦 安装方式

### 方式 1：本地仓库安装（推荐）

1. 将本仓库克隆至你的工作区或本地目录：
   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/<你的用户名>/dsh-ui-zoom.git
   ```

2. 在 DSH 终端中使用 CLI 或通过 Plugin Manager 安装到当前 Profile：
   ```bash
   dsh profile install-bundle /path/to/dsh-ui-zoom
   ```
   *也可以直接在 DSH 对话框中让助手安装：*
   > “请帮我安装工作区下的 dsh-ui-zoom 插件”

3. 刷新 DSH 窗口（`Ctrl + R` 或 `F5`）即可立即生效。

### 方式 2：通过 npm 安装（若已发布）

如果将该包发布至 npm（例如 `dsh-ui-zoom`）：
```bash
dsh profile install-bundle dsh-ui-zoom
```

---

## 🚀 使用指南

### 方式 1：从设置面板调节
1. 点击左下角齿轮「**设置**」。
2. 点击「**通用**」选项卡。
3. 找到「**界面缩放**」，直接点击常用预设比例或使用 `+` / `−` 进行调整。

### 方式 2：使用快捷键
- 按 `Ctrl + =` 放大。
- 按 `Ctrl + -` 缩小。
- 按 `Ctrl + 0` 恢复默认大小。
- 按住 `Ctrl` 滚动鼠标滚轮放大/缩小。

---

## 🛠️ 项目结构

```text
dsh-ui-zoom/
├── package.json          # 插件清单与配置
├── cordis.patch.yml      # DSH Cordis 编排补丁
├── index.js              # Host 端入口
├── client.js             # Client 端渲染逻辑、DOM 缩放与坐标修复
├── icon.svg              # 矢量图标
├── locale/
│   ├── zh.json           # 简体中文文案与元数据
│   └── en.json           # 英文文案与元数据
├── LICENSE               # MIT 开源许可证
├── README.md             # 默认中文说明文档
└── README.en.md          # 英文说明文档
```

---

## 📄 开源许可证

本项目采用 [MIT 许可证](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: Draws mermaid code blocks in DSH replies as diagrams, including while the reply is still streaming.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-mermaid Draws ```` ```mermaid ```` code blocks in DSH replies as diagrams — **including while the reply is still streaming**.

> dsh-plugin-mermaid — 把回复里的 ```mermaid 代码块画成图表，边流式输出边画
中文说明（点开） —— 不用等一轮回复结束才看到图 **它是什么**：模型在回复里写 ```` ```mermaid ```` 围栏，你看到的是图，不是代码。图上方一条细栏写着 `Mermaid`，右边是 **复制** 和 **源码/图表** 开关。 **为什么不是"等回复结束再画"**：DSH 渲染流式回复时，**已完成的块只解析一次、React 元素被缓存**，每个 token 只重建尾部那一块。所以规则只有一条：**源文本静止 220ms 才画**。token 在流 → 计时器一直被重置 → 什么都不画；围栏一闭、后面的正文开始到达 → 块冻结 → 图立刻出现。模型在围栏里停顿时不会画出半张图。 **复制**：图模式复制一张 PNG（2–3 倍尺寸、铺了代码块自己的底色，粘到文档里就是一张图）；源码模式复制 Mermaid 文本。浏览器剪贴板不收 SVG，所以图是先栅格化再写的 —— 这也是 Mermaid 跑在 `htmlLabels: false` 的原因：`` 里的 HTML 在"SVG 当图片"时会消失。 **认不出来就不画**：Mermaid 解析失败的块原样保留，不插任何东西。 **装法**：Plugin Manager 的 Add plugin 填 `github:kjx-talesofai/dsh-plugin-mermaid#v0.2.1`，或指向本地目录。装完**重启 app**（Host 半边开机才加载资产路由），页面再 **⌘R**。 **它没有做什么**：不改 Markdown 渲染器、不占槽位、不加工具。只在代码块的 `data-code-block-content` 里加一个节点，用一条 `:has()` 规则把源码 `
` 藏起来。
## What it does The model writes a fenced block: ````text ```mermaid flowchart LR A["工作区"] --> B["暂存区"] --> C["仓库"] ``` ```` You see the diagram, under a small bar that names it and offers **源码** (source) and copy. The block's own "Code block" banner is hidden while the diagram is shown, because the plugin never touches the `
` React owns — it
adds a sibling and hides the original with CSS.

**Copy follows the view.** With the diagram on screen the button puts a PNG on
the clipboard (2–3× the drawn size, on the block's own surface colour, so it
pastes into a document without a transparent-background surprise); with the
source on screen it copies the Mermaid text. Browser clipboards will not take an
SVG reliably, so the diagram is drawn through a canvas first — which is also why
Mermaid runs with `htmlLabels: false`: `foreignObject` HTML does not survive that
trip.

## Why this is not a Markdown plugin

There is no slot between "Markdown" and "code block". The only seat a plugin can
take is the whole `assistant-step` node, and taking it would mean re-implementing
Markdown — file links, image lightboxes, KaTeX, syntax highlighting, copy
buttons, sticky banners — to add one block type.

So the plugin decorates the primitive's own markup instead:

```
div.md-code-block
  div.bannerWrap                   ← hidden while a diagram is shown
    div[data-code-block-banner]    ← language label + copy
  div[data-code-block-content]
    pre                            ← the source (left in place, hidden by CSS)
    div.dsh-mermaid                ← the one node the plugin adds
```

The coupling is that markup. `tests/dom.test.mjs` drives a stand-in with the same
shape in a real browser, so a change to it fails loudly here instead of silently
drawing nothing.

## Why streaming needs care

DSH renders a live reply with an incremental Markdown renderer: every completed
block is parsed once and its React elements are cached, so only the growing tail
is re-rendered on each token. That gives one precise rule:

> never draw the tail; draw only a source that has stopped changing.

A block is drawn after its source has been unchanged for 220 ms. While tokens
flow the timer keeps resetting; when the fence closes and the next prose starts,
the block freezes, and the diagram appears mid-reply — no waiting for the turn to
end. A pause *inside* an open fence that lasts longer than 220 ms will draw
whatever has arrived; if the source then keeps growing, the panel is dropped and
redrawn, and a source Mermaid rejects leaves the code block exactly as it was.

Rendered diagrams are cached by source + theme, so a re-render (React rebuilding
the message, a theme switch) costs no Mermaid work.

## Where Mermaid comes from

The browser half asks the Host for `/api/mermaid.asset.js`; the Host serves the
`mermaid.min.js` from this package's own dependency tree over the same
authenticated, same-origin channel as the rest of the Web UI. The build is found
by Node's own resolution (`createRequire`), not by a fixed
`./node_modules/…` path: pnpm — which the Plugin Manager uses — keeps a
package's dependencies *beside* it, so a fixed path would 404 on every install
from Git while working perfectly in a linked checkout. It is a 3.4 MB
script, so it is fetched the first time a diagram is seen, not on every page
load, and revalidated with an ETag.

## Limits

- Diagrams are rendered in the browser only. A DSH client without the plugin (a
  phone on an old tab, `--no-client` tooling) shows the code block.
- Mermaid's `strict` security level is used: HTML labels are sanitized, and
  click-to-activate links are not available.
- A diagram Mermaid rejects is not decorated at all. The reason is logged to the
  browser console (`[mermaid] …`); there is no inline error row, because during
  streaming an incomplete diagram would flash one.
- No per-block history: the panel is a view of the file's Markdown, not a record.

## Install

Use DSH's own **Add plugin** dialog. No npm account, no publishing.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| GitHub | `github:kjx-talesofai/dsh-plugin-mermaid#v0.2.1` |
| Local directory | an absolute path, e.g. `/path/to/dsh-plugin-mermaid` |

Restart the desktop app afterwards: the Host half owns the asset route and is
only loaded at startup. The browser half reloads with the page (`⌘R`).

This plugin is **not published to npm**, and `npm install` is not the install
path. Its one runtime dependency (the Mermaid build the Host serves) is installed
from the repository's `package.json`.

## Tests

```bash
npm ci
npm test           # 18: classifier, loader contract, patch/manifest consistency, the Host route, module resolution
npm run test:dom   # 33 in headless Chrome over CDP: `:has()`, real Mermaid output, the streaming sequence, both clipboard flavours
```

`test:dom` skips when no Chrome or Chromium is installed.

## Licence

MIT.

plugins.description: Codex-style file-based long-term memory for DSH: two-stage extraction, consolidated MEMORY.md handbook, prompt-injected summary, and search/read/list/note tools.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-codex-memories

Codex-style **long-term memory** for DSH: cross-session memory that ingests finished sessions, consolidates them into a searchable handbook, and injects a compact summary before every turn.

It reproduces the two-stage structure of the Codex memory system rather than approximating it: per-session extraction first, then a consolidation pass over many raw memories.

## Why

DSH sessions are isolated by default. A correction you made yesterday, a command that only works in one repo, a symptom/cause/fix you already paid for — none of it carries over unless you restate it. This plugin makes the agent remember:

- how you want it to work, without being told twice
- where the truth lives in a specific repo, and which commands actually run
- which failure has which fix

## How it works

```
session goes idle for N seconds
   └─ Stage 1  one model call per session -> session_summaries/<slug>.md + raw_memories.md
        └─ Stage 2  once enough memory accumulates -> MEMORY.md + memory_summary.md
             └─ before each turn, memory_summary.md is injected into the prompt
```

All durable artifacts are plain Markdown you can read, edit, version, or move. `index.json` holds the extraction cache, job records, and the consolidation watermark.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @lushdawn/dsh-codex-memories
```

Local development:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add link:<absolute path to this directory>
```

Restart DSH, or let a live profile hot-load it.

## Commands

| Command | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `/memory status` | memory root, extracted sessions, pending consolidation, last timestamps |
| `/memory show` | print the current `memory_summary.md` |
| `/memory extract` | extract the current session immediately |
| `/memory backfill` | scan stored sessions and extract the ones never processed |
| `/memory consolidate` | merge pending memory into `MEMORY.md` now |
| `/memory forget <sessionId\|all>` | drop extraction records (handbook content is kept) |
| `/memory on` / `off` | toggle automatic extraction for this process |

## Tools

Exposed to the model when `dedicatedTools` is on:

| Tool | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `memory_search` | line-level keyword search across memory files (`any` / `all` / `on_same_line`) |
| `memory_read` | read one memory file by line range |
| `memory_list` | inventory of the memory folder and pending work |
| `memory_note` | append one ad-hoc note — the only write path the model is offered |

The model is instructed to cite memory as `MEMORY.md:12-14|note=[...]`.

## Configuration

Every field has a safe default; override in your profile patch:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-codex-memories
      name: dsh-codex-memories
      config:
        storageDir: ''            # default $DSH_HOME/memories
        generate: true
        use: true
        dedicatedTools: true
        model: ''                 # e.g. deepseek-official/deepseek-flash
        extractModel: ''          # falls back to model
        consolidationModel: ''    # falls back to model
        idleSeconds: 120
        maxSessionsPerRun: 3
        maxSessionAgeDays: 30
        consolidationThreshold: 2
        maxInjectChars: 9000
        minSessionMessages: 4
        extractMaxTokens: 8000
        consolidateMaxTokens: 16000
```

When `model` is empty the plugin reads the current default model, then falls back to `deepseek-official/deepseek-flash`.

## Data layout

```
$DSH_HOME/memories/
├── MEMORY.md                    # durable handbook, Task Group organized
├── memory_summary.md            # prompt-loaded layer; first line must be v1
├── raw_memories.md              # mechanical stage-1 merge, ascending session id
├── session_summaries/<slug>.md  # one structured recap per session
├── extensions/ad_hoc/notes/     # notes written by you or the model
└── index.json                   # extraction cache, job records, watermark
```

## Cost and privacy

- **It spends tokens**: one Stage-1 call per session and one Stage-2 call per consolidation. Sessions under 4 messages are skipped; at most 3 sessions are processed per sweep.
- **Local files only**: no network access beyond the model API it calls.
- **It enters your prompt**: `memory_summary.md` is injected every turn, which is why it is capped by `maxInjectChars`.
- **Auditable**: every artifact is readable Markdown.
- **The model cannot rewrite the handbook**: it may only append ad-hoc notes; consolidation is a separate pass, so one turn cannot corrupt durable memory.

## Fidelity to Codex

The behavioral spec comes from reverse engineering Codex itself — the on-disk shape under `~/.codex/memories` plus the prompt templates embedded in `codex.exe`:

| Codex | dsh-codex-memories |
| --- | --- |
| `~/.codex/memories/` | `$DSH_HOME/memories/` |
| `MEMORY.md` / `memory_summary.md` / `raw_memories.md` | same names, same formats |
| `rollout_summaries/*.md` | `session_summaries/*.md` |
| `memories_1.sqlite` | `index.json` |
| Stage 1 extraction prompt | `PHASE1_TEMPLATE` in `lib/prompts.js` |
| Phase 2 consolidation prompt | `PHASE2_TEMPLATE` in `lib/prompts.js` |
| usage guidance + citation format | `USAGE_TEMPLATE` in `lib/prompts.js` |
| rollout scan backfill | `/memory backfill` + boot sweep |

See [docs/mechanism.md](docs/mechanism.md) for the full mechanism and the evidence behind it.

## Known limits

- Stage 2 asks for two complete documents in one reply. On a very large handbook the reply can hit the output cap; the old files are then kept and the pass reports an error instead of writing something corrupt.
- Automatic extraction needs the process alive during the idle window; otherwise the next boot's `backfill` catches up.
- Retrieval is keyword/line based, not semantic — the same tradeoff Codex makes. Route with `keywords` in `MEMORY.md`.

## Contributing

Issues and pull requests are welcome — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). For anything
security-related, follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) instead of opening a public issue. Release
history lives in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Runtime evidence that helps agents trace, profile, and burn down hotspots in application and native code, GPU kernels, and inference stacks.
plugins.readme_text:
flameox

Bounded local runtime evidence for coding agents.

Flameox coordinates profilers, benchmark tools, trace processors, and direct local targets. It turns an explicit artifact or command into bounded evidence while keeping durable preservation optional. The agent chooses hypotheses and experiments; Flameox records observed inputs, execution provenance, typed evidence, coverage, and limitations. There is no workspace to initialize or project configuration to maintain. Pass exact artifact paths to analysis and an explicit argv plus absolute working directory to capture. Flameox does not search parent directories, edit project files, or provide a hosted service. ## Quick start Configure an MCP client with the global setup command: ```console npx flameox@latest setup ``` Setup detects supported clients and asks which configurations to update. For automation, select clients explicitly, for example `--client codex --yes` or `--all --yes`; `--dry-run` reports the paths and actions without writing. Setup preserves unrelated client configuration and does not change project files. See [the npm package guide](npm/README.md) for details. Update existing MCP registrations with: ```console npx flameox@latest update ``` `update --check` reports available updates without changing configuration. Updates preserve each client's provider extras and settings, verify the new environment before changing release pins, and report which clients need a restart or reconnect. Use `--client codex` to select one client, or `--version 0.2.8` to select a specific release, including for rollback. The Python CLI exposes the same `flameox update` command. For direct CLI use, pass exact artifact paths or an explicit command: ```console uvx flameox analyze preview_artifact /absolute/path/to/artifact.json uvx flameox capture --provider direct --cwd "$PWD" -- python benchmark.py ``` To launch the stdio MCP server manually: ```console uvx flameox mcp serve ``` For local development, clone the repository, install its development dependencies, and inspect the available tools: ```console git clone https://github.com/morluto/flameox.git cd flameox uv sync --extra dev --extra memory --extra trace --extra cpu uv run flameox mcp inspect ``` ## Evidence and storage Analysis and unpreserved capture use bounded session scratch. Session `analysis_id` values expire when evicted or when the server stops. Explicit preservation creates the user-level Flameox data directory and stores native bytes and a canonical evidence bundle by SHA-256. Set `FLAMEOX_DATA_DIR` to choose another location. Preservation is optional; it does not imply full console-output retention. Flameox distinguishes observed, derived, and inferred claims. Profiles guide exploration but do not establish causality or performance improvement. Confirmatory claims require representative workloads, declared metrics and estimands, compatible identities, preserved samples, and a semantic oracle. ## MCP The MCP server has no workspace binding. It exposes named analysis and capture tools through the same operation registry as the CLI. Analysis tools accept explicit sources; capture tools accept a typed target and provider. Tool schemas expose operation-specific fields directly. Inspect the catalog with `flameox mcp inspect`; use `--tool TOOL_NAME` for focused schemas and examples. The complete contract and current tool catalog are in [the interface guide](docs/interfaces.md). Tools return their full bounded results inline, including failures and recovery actions. Preserved evidence has a durable `evidence_id`; `inspect_evidence` returns its redacted metadata and replay sources inline. Capture takes argv, not a shell string. A direct target supplies an absolute working directory and bounded environment overrides. Results may include `next_page`; replay its named analysis tool and arguments unchanged. Capture continuations read collected artifacts and do not rerun the target. MCP work belongs to the live request, so cancellation applies directly and no detached job survives a restart. ## Documentation - [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) describes process and package boundaries. - [Storage and evidence](docs/storage-and-evidence.md) defines preservation and provenance. - [Investigations](docs/investigations.md) covers experiments, comparison, and evidence quality. - [Adapters](docs/adapters.md) documents provider compatibility and integration policy. - [Runtime safety](docs/runtime-safety.md) covers limits, recovery, integrity, and privacy. - [Interfaces](docs/interfaces.md) defines CLI and MCP contracts. - [Testing](docs/testing.md) describes test selections and known proof gaps. ## Development Flameox requires Python 3.12 or newer and uses the committed `uv.lock`. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for development setup and contribution guidance. ```console uv run ruff check src tests tools uv run ruff format --check src tests tools uv run mypy src tests tools uv run pytest -q ``` Flameox is licensed under the MIT License.

plugins.description: 给 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）用的 agent 技能集（skills）：记忆档案维护、本机操作规矩、插件发布规程、Web 健康检查、会话日志修复。每个技能一个 SKILL.md。MIT。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-agent-skills

给 **DSH（DeepSeek Harness）** 用的 agent 技能集：每个技能是一份 `SKILL.md`，写清某类任务的操作规矩（触发时机、步骤、边界、踩过的坑），DSH 会在会话里按需加载。

目录约定：

```
skills/<name>/SKILL.md
```

## 技能一览

| 技能 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `agent-diary` | 维护「日记／状态／生长记录／APP 版」这套档案，以及处理会话交接包时的规矩。 |
| `agent-lookup` | 查资料、找文件、判读用户发的截图时的规矩：先搜再看来源、外部内容只当数据。 |
| `agent-machine` | 改本机插件、跑设备命令、动文件系统时的通用规矩：先备份、分开验证据、改完等重启、被拒就停。 |
| `dsh-plugin-publish` | 把本机插件发布/更新到 GitHub 之前的规矩：能推什么、私密信息清单、怎么脱敏、推完怎么自查。 |
| `dsh-web-healthcheck` | DSH Web GUI 健康检查与「界面无反应」类问题诊断：全链路自检顺序与判定流程。 |
| `session-log-repair` | 修复 DSH 会话历史日志损坏（seq 空洞、历史打不开）的检测、备份、分析、重建、验证流程。 |

## 用法

把某个技能目录整个放进 DSH 的技能目录（例如 `~/.agents/skills/<name>/`），或者把 `SKILL.md` 的内容并进你自己的技能配置。技能里出现的命令、路径与端口请按自己机器的实际情况替换。

## 许可

MIT License。技能文本按原样提供，不含任何保证；执行其中命令前请自行确认目标环境。

plugins.description: Background-first macOS cross-application desktop tools for DeepSeek Harness, with hidden agent cursor and post-action observations.

# DSH Computer Use Next

macOS 全局跨应用桌面控制插件。默认隐藏虚拟光标，在后台选定窗口；窗口操作后自动回读界面，供 DSH 模型继续判断。

基于 MIT 授权的 [dsh-computer-use 0.3.1](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-computer-use) 修改，保留原许可，变更见 NOTICE。本项目与 OpenAI、Codex 无隶属关系，不包含其内部实现或模型。

## 要求

- macOS；其他操作系统未验证。
- Node.js 22.18+；兼容 @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools 0.2.0-rc.2 接口的 DSH 宿主。
- 已安装 CuaDriver，并授予其辅助功能和屏幕录制权限；实测版本 0.35.2。
- 原生图片和整屏观察需要对话模型支持图片输入，否则使用窗口 AX 控件树。

## 安装

发布后可通过 GitHub Release 中的 dsh-computer-use-next.tgz 安装，或由收录后的 DSH 插件市场安装。仓库自带 dsh.bundle manifest 和运行时 JavaScript，不需要编译。

本机桌面 profile 的手动安装：

```sh
python3 install.py
```

脚本只针对已有 ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop 的桌面版，复制插件、备份并追加配置，不重启应用、不更改模型账号。其他 profile 使用宿主的插件安装方式。

如已启用旧版 dsh-computer-use，先禁用旧版，避免同名工具重复注册；本插件不会擅自禁用其他插件。

## 工具

| 工具 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| desktop_windows | 全局应用窗口列表及精确窗口 ID。 |
| app_switch | 后台选定并观察目标窗口，不主动前置。 |
| desktop_observe | 主显示器整屏图片，包括 Dock 和菜单栏。 |
| desktop_click | 全局坐标点击及回读；后台模式默认禁用。 |
| screen_observe | 窗口 AX 控件树及可用截图。 |
| screen_zoom | 局部截图。 |
| computer_click / computer_double_click / computer_right_click | 窗口点击、双击、右键。 |
| computer_type / computer_key | 目标窗口文本输入及快捷键。 |
| computer_scroll / computer_drag | 窗口内滚动及拖拽。 |
| computer_wait | 等待加载。 |
| app_list / app_launch | 应用列表及启动。 |

合计 16 个工具。窗口点击、输入、按键、滚动和拖拽后自动回读原窗口，模型需要检查实际变化。不同 agent 的观察缓存隔离，插件内调用串行执行。

示例：

> 使用 desktop_windows 查看窗口，选定计算器计算 12+34，再观察另一个应用，最后回到计算器核对结果。保持后台，每步检查界面，不重复执行结果未知的动作。

## 后台与前台

默认 backgroundOnly=true、animateCursor=false。驱动会话初始化和恢复时关闭虚拟光标，不隐藏用户自己的鼠标。

后台模式禁止主动前置及 desktop_click；使用 app_launch 和 app_switch 跨应用工作。不支持后台的操作会失败，不自动前置重试；应用自身弹窗仍可能改变焦点，不能保证所有软件完全后台运行。

如需 Dock/菜单栏点击，可显式设置 backgroundOnly=false，允许前台交互。整屏坐标和窗口坐标不能混用。

未验证多屏、其他 Space、最小化窗口及完整模型驱动的跨应用长任务；未实现跨窗口拖拽、视频流或独立无人值守规划。

## 数据和权限

截图经 DSH attachments 服务处理，可能按模型路由发送给模型服务商。显式 vision 模式继承上游观察者及可选 GLM fallback，其密钥查找和请求见 lib/vision.js。默认 native/AX 路径不新增密钥。

快照 TTL、应用白名单和部分按钮审批规则不是完整安全保障，坐标点击及快捷键不能可靠推断业务后果。详见 PERMISSIONS.md。

## 验证和卸载

```sh
node --test tests/*.test.mjs
python3 install.py --uninstall
```

16 项自动测试通过。实际验证了计算器点击与截图回读、计算器与 DSH 的后台窗口观察、1568×1014 整屏读取及虚拟光标关闭。完整模型任务尚未验证。

卸载只移除本插件的配置块，保留其他配置及插件文件。下一次启动或宿主重新加载配置后生效。

plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Team Workbench · 超级工作台

[English](README.en.md) · [使用指南](docs/USAGE.md) · [配置](docs/CONFIGURATION.md) · [架构](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)

DeepSeek Harness 的非官方插件：在一个主窗口中以 **1／2／4 窗**查看真实会话，并用持续存在的模块成员组织并行工作。

团队组织方式是 **leader → 模块成员 → 成员自己的子智能体**。leader 给目标和边界，成员自己规划、拆解与授权派发；Host 调度器在依赖满足、容量释放后继续启动已授权工作。

本仓库独立提供工作台与团队运行时，**不包含、也不要求安装 myworkflow 技能包**。

## 能做什么

- **多会话工作台**：切换 1／2／4 窗，保留各会话的草稿与阅读位置，使用 DSH 原生对话组件。
- **模块成员自治**：持久模块委托、成员计划、版本化派发授权、成员收件箱与成果验收。
- **持续补位**：已授权的独立工作按依赖和容量推进，不等待整批结束；保留恢复和交互余量。
- **可追溯交付**：区分产出与验收，关联执行记录、产物哈希、验收条件和未完成事项。
- **运行状态**：查看成员决策、等待原因、任务、用量、费用估算及错误记录。未配置价格或缺少数据时显示未知。

窗格直接绑定工作区主会话；成员和子智能体通过该会话的“子会话”菜单进入。窗口数与并发执行数相互独立。写范围协调也不等于文件系统隔离。

## 兼容范围

已调查的接口基线是 **DSH 0.2.0-rc.2**。前端依赖该版本的 Session、slot、原生对话组件与布局接口；后续版本需重新核对。

团队执行要求当前 profile 已启用 DSH 原生实验性 Agent Team，并提供可用的 continuable 子智能体 provider。缺失能力时插件会给出诊断，不能把“插件加载成功”视为团队可运行。

此发布提供生产模块的自动化测试、模拟原生接口的集成检查、打包检查及 CI 配置。**它们不构成所有 DSH 版本、操作系统或真实模型的运行认证**。真实安装、多窗和团队行为按[验收说明](docs/ACCEPTANCE.md)另行核实。

## 安装

在装有 DSH CLI 的环境中：

```sh
dsh plugin add github:CH3SH-LC/dsh-team-workbench#v1.0.0
```

如需指定已有 profile，例如 `desktop`：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:CH3SH-LC/dsh-team-workbench#v1.0.0
```

请确认安装目标与实际启动的 DSH profile 相同。安装方式遵循 [DSH 官方 bundle 文档](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/en/develop/basic/publish)。

也可安装本地源码目录或已打包的 `.tgz`。在 DSH 创造模式中，使用原生插件管理工具：

```text
plugin_manager(action="install_bundle", target="github:CH3SH-LC/dsh-team-workbench#v1.0.0")
```

本地安装时将 `target` 替换为本机源码目录的绝对路径。工具行为以[官方 plugin-manager 说明](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/boot/plugin-manager/README.md)及当前 DSH 版本为准。

**配置影响**：本 bundle 将原生 `subagent` 行设为 `maxDepth: 2`、`maxActiveSubagents: 40`。这会影响同一 profile 中使用该服务的其他任务，不只是工作台。安装前核对已有覆盖配置；详见 [配置说明](docs/CONFIGURATION.md)。没有模型配额或速率限制随安装自动增加。

安装后查看插件加载结果，在侧栏打开“超级工作台”。若当前版本要求重载或重启，应先保存并妥善结束活跃任务，再按 DSH 提示操作。

## 开始使用

可在一个新的 DSH 会话中提出完整目标，例如：

> 创建一个小型游戏内容包。建立敌人内容与装备内容两个模块成员，每个成员交付四个完整对象。成员自行决定对象设计、计划和子任务，独立交付设计说明、结构化数据及验证结果。按完整对象并行，不拆成调研、开发、检查接力。先限制并发，确认流程正常后再调整。

模型侧的推荐路径：

1. leader 用 `team_define`、`team_member_create` 建立团队，再用 `team_mission_assign` 委托模块目标。
2. member 用 `team_plan_submit` 决定自行执行或委派，提交自己的计划，再用 `team_dispatch_authorize` 授权需要派发的工作。
3. Host 调度器启动可执行项；成员通过收件箱和回执继续处理自己的模块。
4. 产物提交后，由 owner 核验。需要可执行验证时使用 `team_exec_check` 记录结果，再由 `team_work_verify` 对照验收条件作出结论。

简单请求可以直接完成，不必创建团队。完整说明见 [使用指南](docs/USAGE.md)。

## 开发与贡献

开发需要 Node.js **22 或更新版本**。源码目录中运行：

```sh
npm run build
npm test
npm run check:package
```

修改前阅读 [贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.md)。测试在完整源码 checkout 中运行；发布的 `.tgz` 是运行时包。前端生成文件应由构建脚本生成；不要只修改 `client.js`。公开问题报告请去除私有路径、会话正文、账号标识和凭据。

## 文档

- [使用指南与工具分工](docs/USAGE.md)
- [配置、容量和数据位置](docs/CONFIGURATION.md)
- [架构与运行约束](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)
- [真实 DSH 验收清单](docs/ACCEPTANCE.md)
- [发布流程](docs/RELEASE.md)
- [更新记录](CHANGELOG.md)

## 许可证

[MIT](LICENSE)。本项目由社区独立维护，与 DeepSeek 官方没有隶属或背书关系。

plugins.description: A per-turn token usage strip for DeepSeek Harness: a segmented bar plus a written legend under every reply, showing this turn's uncached input / cache read / output split.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-token-bar

[![MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的 Web 界面加一条**单轮 token 用量条**：每条回复末尾一行，把这一轮的缓存结构画成灰 / 黄 / 绿三段条，配一条带百分比的完整图例。

![单轮用量条：灰=未缓存输入、黄=缓存读取、绿=输出，后面跟带百分比的图例](docs/screenshot-turn-bar.png)

**极轻量**：纯客户端展示，不联网、不落盘、不注册任何 Host 路由、不写会话日志、不改任何官方包。
**零依赖**：一个手写 bundle，只用平台提供的 React。

[English](README.en.md) | 中文

---

## 它解决什么

官方在每条回复末尾的用量气泡里，点开能看到「本轮用量」的精确数字。但**数字是列表，要读；结构是形状，一眼就懂**：

- 这一轮是不是全命中缓存？
- 有没有跑出大量未缓存输入（意味着前缀失效、成本变高）？
- 输出占比是否异常？

`dsh-token-bar` 把这三个数字变成一条可扫视的带状图，并且带图例——**不需要悬停也知道每段是什么、占多少**。

## 外观

| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| 段序 / 图例序 | **灰（未缓存输入）→ 黄（缓存读取）→ 绿（输出）**，条与图例完全同序 |
| 条宽 | 132px |
| 最小段宽 | 只要有 token 就至少 **6px**，再小的占比也看得见，不会和图例对不上 |
| 图例 | 色点 + 名称 + 本轮占比百分比 |
| 字号 | 比正文小一号：`calc(var(--dsh-content-font-size-secondary, 13px) - 1px)`，跟随设置里的字号 |
| 配色 | 全部取自 `--dsw-*` 主题 token，浅色 / 深色自动跟随 |
| 对齐 | 靠左，不居中 |

悬停显示本轮完整明细：缓存命中率 + 每段精确 token 数与占比。

> 缓存写入未单独成段——当前路由上该值恒为 0。

## 数据来源

读 `turn.data.get('turn-tail').tokenUsage`，即**本轮**的用量（和官方「本轮用量」弹窗同源），**不是**会话累计。

`conversation.chat.turnTail` 插槽的 owner（ui-chat 的 `TurnTailNodeView`）会把 Turn 位置作为 owner props 直接传入，Conversation 已把本轮账目折进 `turn-tail` 这份 location data。感谢 [dsh-token-counter](https://github.com/OkliaoliO/dsh-token-counter) 提供的实现参考。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-token-bar
```

或从本地目录安装（开发时）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-token-bar
```

安装后**重启 `dsh web`** 生效。

卸载：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-token-bar
```

## 兼容性

| 组件 | 支持 |
|---|---|
| DSH | `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`，在 `0.2.0-rc.2` 上实测 |
| Node.js | `>=20` |
| 界面 | DSH Web（依赖 `conversation.chat.turnTail` 插槽） |
| 系统 | macOS / Linux / Windows（纯 JavaScript） |

## 开发

```sh
npm run check   # 语法检查
npm test        # 纯函数测试 + 渲染测试
```

`npm test` 默认测试**源码** `client.js`。想验证浏览器实际收到的那份构建产物，从运行中的 `dsh web` 抽一份快照：

```sh
node scripts/snapshot-bundle.mjs "http://127.0.0.1:3080/?token=<启动时打印的 token>"
npm test        # 检测到 verify-module.js 后，自动改为测试服务端下发的产物
```

### 网络受限时推送

如果所在网络访问不了 `github.com:443`（`git push` 卡住超时）但 `api.github.com` 可以访问，用 REST API 推送：

```sh
node scripts/push-via-api.mjs <owner>/<repo> --dry-run   # 先看要推什么
node scripts/push-via-api.mjs <owner>/<repo>             # 真正推送
```

它会按 blobs → trees → commits 重放本地历史，并把分支指向**远端生成的**新 commit SHA（API 创建的 commit 与本地 SHA 不同，这点最容易踩坑）。

## 可调参数

都在 `client.js` 顶部：

| 常量 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `BUCKETS` | 三段（顺序、名称、颜色） |
| `MIN_SEGMENT_PX` | 最小段宽，默认 `6` |
| `TRACK_PX` | 条宽，默认 `132` |
| `FONT_SIZE` | 字号，默认比正文小一号 |

## 已知限制

- 只覆盖完成（`turn/end`）的轮次；正在流式输出的那一轮没有条。
- 依赖官方 `turn-tail` 的 location data 结构；DSH 若改动该结构，需要跟随适配。
- 没有设计器 / 配置界面，改样式需要编辑源码。

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: A Kanban board for DSH: one SQLite board shared by a human and their agent sessions, in the desktop app's sidebar. Two gates (Definition of Ready, Definition of Done) are enforced by the board itself, and every move is an event, so cycle time and throughput come from what happened.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-kanban

One task board for the whole home directory, shared by Dhira and by every agent session: the panel is
the human's view, the `kanban_*` tools are the agents', and `bin/kanban.mjs` is the scripted one — all
over one SQLite store, through one policy engine, so **the gate that refuses an agent is the gate that
refuses the human**.

| surface | who uses it | what it does |
|---|---|---|
| **Kanban panel** (`sidebar.panellist` → `main`) | the human | every state as a lane (`dropped` last), drag-and-drop with a keyboard path, a search box, a `New card` button that opens a minimal create dialog, the card drawer with both checklists, the flow metrics and a collapsible history |
| **`kanban_*` tools** (9) and the `kanban` skill | agents | list, read, create, update/fill, move, drop, sprint, board, metrics — including the card's write scope |
| **`bin/kanban.mjs`** | the human, scripts, checks | the same verbs from a shell, with distinct exit codes |

## Why

Task state used to live in a hand-authored Markdown table and in whatever each session remembered,
and no surface could be trusted to agree with another: nothing enforced a gate, and nothing recorded
that a move had happened. The figures were the giveaway. An import stamped
`started_at = finished_at = now` on eleven migrated cards, and the generated view advertised

> Throughput 11 in 7 days · Cycle time median 0d · SLE … (history, from 11 finished)

while the event log held two moves. A board that asserts history it does not have is worse than no
board, because the number is read as evidence.

`dsh-kanban` replaces that with one SQLite store below all three surfaces and one policy engine above
it, at `$DSH_HOME/.kanban/board.db`. The gates — Definition of Ready, Definition of Done, WIP limits,
priority and class of service — live in the store; every mutation appends an event. The store is the
only copy: the Markdown mirror and the per-card folder tree it once rendered are gone. The four flow
metrics are recomputed from what happened rather than read off a column.

## Agent Skills

The host half registers the **`kanban`** skill at runtime, so an agent session can work a card without
reading this source: list and read the board, create a card, refine it until the Definition of Ready
is ticked, move it through the gates, comment, block and unblock — and be refused with the names of
the items that are missing. The skill carries the DoR/DoD item names and the rule that a write scope
is data the agent must pass.

## Quick Start

The plugin lives inside the profile it serves, so "install" means *register it and restart the app*.
Either route ends the same way: a `link:` dependency, a bundle row, and a restart.

### Option A — the script

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/plugins/dsh-kanban
./install.sh            # registers the bundle in the profile and links it
./install.sh --check    # what would change
./install.sh --remove   # unregister
```

### Option B — by hand

1. **Clone it to a stable path** — the path becomes the install path.
   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/mrdhira/dsh-kanban.git ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/plugins/dsh-kanban
   ```
2. **`pnpm install`** — this plugin's own toolchain, not the profile's. Its `pnpm-workspace.yaml`
   allows esbuild's build script, which pnpm 11 blocks by default. The `prepare` script runs
   `node build.mjs`, which writes `lib/**` (the host half, the store and the client half) and
   `bin/kanban.mjs` — what `main` and the bundle point at.
3. **Register the dependency *and* the bundle name** in the profile's `package.json`
   (`~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json`):
   ```json
   {
     "dependencies": { "dsh-kanban": "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-kanban" },
     "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["dsh-kanban"] } }
   }
   ```
4. **Install the profile link, then restart DSH** — `pnpm install` in the profile directory creates
   `node_modules/dsh-kanban`, the symlink the Loader resolves the package name through. A new bundle
   row is a composition change, so **a host-half change needs an app restart**. A client-half change
   needs only a page reload: the Loader picks up a new bundle row by itself, but a module inside a row
   that is already loaded does not reload (T-008).

### Configure

A fresh install needs **nothing**: the board defaults to `$DSH_HOME/.kanban/board.db` (its parent is
created on first open), and the Definition of Workflow ships with the guide's limits. The
bundle row is created with an empty `config` on purpose — Cordis validates a row's config before the
plugin activates, and the host half exports no schema to validate against, so it reads every field
defensively and applies its own defaults.

| setting | default | effect |
|---|---|---|
| `dbPath` | `$DSH_HOME/.kanban/board.db` | where the board's SQLite file lives |
| `pollMs` | `5000` | the panel's refresh interval while it is visible |

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: kanban
      name: dsh-kanban
      config:
        dbPath: /absolute/path/board.db
        pollMs: 5000
```

A field the patch does not mention keeps the default above, so declare only what you mean to change.

## How it Works

Three surfaces read and write **one** store through **one** policy engine: a rule enforced in the
panel is enforced in the tools and the CLI, because there is only one implementation of it. The board
is `$DSH_HOME/.kanban/board.db` (SQLite), and its history is the append-only `events` table — one row
per mutation. It is the only copy: no Markdown view and no folder tree, so never hand-edit it.

A profile plugin **cannot import anything but Node builtins** (`@deepseek-ai/*` does not resolve from
a profile directory). That is why the DSH contracts are vendored in `src/types/dsh.ts`, the store is
our own SQLite, and the browser half talks to the host over this plugin's own HTTP route rather than a
typed Remote. `DESIGN.md` is the full design record and `PRODUCT.md` the product brief.

`/api/kanban` serves `health`, `board` (with `?since=<rev>` → `304`), `task/:id`, and `POST mutate`
with an op. The route is registered as a prefix on the app's own web server, so it wins
the longest-prefix match over the app's `/api` bridge and therefore **does not carry that bridge's
browser-session fence**: a request from this machine is believed, including an
`x-kanban-actor: human`. The server binds loopback only.

That is a deliberate, recorded trade for a single-user local tool. The boundary that matters — an
agent may not set a priority — is enforced at the *tool* boundary, where an agent's identity is its
session and not a header it can choose. A per-launch token is the obvious hardening and is deferred
until the index-injection question for a `file://`-loaded window is answered.

### What it looks like

The board, six lanes and every state reachable, in the app's own two themes. Nothing is styled against
the app: every colour is one of its theme tokens with a literal fallback.

| light | dark |
|---|---|
| ![The board in the light theme](docs/screenshots/board-light.png) | ![The board in the dark theme](docs/screenshots/board-dark.png) |

A card's drawer: one primary move, the rest behind a disclosure, the Definition of Ready as checkable
rows, and the history collapsed until asked for.

| light | dark |
|---|---|
| ![A card's drawer in the light theme](docs/screenshots/drawer-light.png) | ![A card's drawer in the dark theme](docs/screenshots/drawer-dark.png) |

### The flow

A card moves through five states, and two gates decide whether it may. `dropped` is off the workflow —
it is where a card goes when it leaves, and the way back is the drawer's own primary move.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  B[backlog] -->|"DoR complete"| R[ready]
  R --> I[in-progress]
  I --> V[review]
  V -->|"DoD complete"| D[done]
  B -.->|"dropped, with a reason"| X[dropped]
  R -.-> X
  I -.-> X
  V -.-> X
  X -->|"the drawer's move"| B
```

- **Definition of Ready** — outcome, acceptance, write scope, estimate. A card in `backlog` cannot be
  pulled into `ready` until every item is ticked, and the refusal names the ones that are missing.
- **Definition of Done** — evidence, tests, docs, links, and no unverified

plugins.description: Codex-style Windows computer use for DeepSeek Harness: UI Automation + screenshots + SendInput, liquid-glass screen overlay, ESC kill switch. Install: dsh plugin --profile web add github:esch30636/dsh-computer-use
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-computer-use

[![GitHub release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/esch30636/dsh-computer-use?sort=semver)](https://github.com/esch30636/dsh-computer-use/releases)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-4B5563)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

Codex-style **Windows computer use** for DeepSeek Harness: window-targeted UI Automation + occlusion-tolerant screenshots + SendInput mouse/keyboard injection, exposed as five model-facing tools and backed by a bundled long-lived PowerShell helper.

While computer use is active, a click-through **screen overlay** draws a vivid "liquid glass" look: a sapphire *edge vignette* (fully clear center, satin-navy darkening toward the four screen edges) with a thin cyan glass rim hugging the display border, plus a "dynamic island" status pill at the top center — sapphire gradient, diagonal sheen, bright rim, breathing blue glow: `DeepSeek Harness 正在操控你的电脑 | 按 ESC 终止`. Pressing **ESC** stops computer use immediately and closes the overlay; the agent is told to stop and reports back.

Designed after the OpenAI Codex Windows Computer Use surface (`list_apps` / `get_window_state` / `click(element_index | x,y)` / `press_key` / `type_text` / `scroll` / `drag` / `set_value` / `activate_window`, X11-keysym-style key names, one action then re-observe), reimplemented as a pure DSH plugin with no third-party runtime dependencies.

## What you get

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `computer_list_windows` | List targetable top-level windows (window_id, process identity, title, rect, foreground/minimized, policy-blocked flag). Optionally lists Start-menu launchable apps. |
| `computer_observe` | Capture one window state: screenshot (default) and/or UI Automation tree with element indexes, focused element, selection, document text. Returns `state_id` + screenshot coordinate mapping. |
| `computer_action` | Exactly one action against a state: click / double_click / right_click / middle_click / mouse_move / type / key / scroll / drag / set_value / wait / activate_window. |
| `computer_launch_app` | Launch by exe path, exe name, Start-menu display name, `.lnk`, or `shell:AppsFolder\<AUMID>`; reports the windows it opened. |
| `computer_sequence` | Run up to 100 ordered input steps on one window without re-observing between them (absolute screen pixels) — for repetitive GUI work such as drawing a diagram; optionally returns one verification screenshot. |

Plus the click-through status overlay with the **ESC kill switch** (`USER_ESCAPE`), a system-prompt section (workflow, hard denies, confirmation policy) and a `computer-use` skill with the full playbook.

## Requirements

- Windows 10/11, interactive user session (not a service session), PowerShell 5.1 (`powershell.exe` — pwsh 7 not required).
- DSH 0.2.x (web/desktop profile; any composition that mounts `tools`, `systemPrompt` and `attachments` — the shipped base mounts all three).
- No native modules, no npm dependencies, no MCP server.

## Install

### Option A — DSH CLI (`dsh plugin add`)

For profiles the `dsh` CLI can manage (`web`, `tui`, `headless`, …), the plugin
installs as a regular DSH bundle:

```sh
# straight from GitHub (pnpm fetches the repo tarball)
dsh plugin --profile web add github:esch30636/dsh-computer-use

# or from the release tarball (no git fetch; works behind a GitHub proxy too)
dsh plugin --profile web add "https://github.com/esch30636/dsh-computer-use/releases/latest/download/dsh-computer-use.tgz"
```

`dsh plugin` installs the package into the profile and enables its bundle.
Restart the host (or let HMR recompose) and the `computer_*` tools appear in a
new session.

### Option B — Desktop app (`desktop` profile)

The Desktop app owns its reserved `desktop` profile, so `dsh plugin --profile
desktop` deliberately refuses to run there. Two supported paths:

1. **Plugin market** — after this plugin is listed in
   [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com) (submission pending the
   one-day repository age rule), open **设置 → 插件市场** and install it with one
   click.
2. **Release installer** (works immediately, no git/pnpm needed): download and
   unzip the archive from
   [releases](https://github.com/esch30636/dsh-computer-use/releases), then run
   inside the unzipped folder:

   ```powershell
   # downloads the latest release tarball and installs into the desktop profile
   powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install-release.ps1
   ```

   Pin a version with `-Version v1.1.0`; target another profile with
   `-Profile web`; add `-Verify` to run the offline composition dump afterwards.

### Option C — manual / fully offline

Download the release archive
([releases](https://github.com/esch30636/dsh-computer-use/releases)), unzip it,
then run the bundled installer:

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install.ps1 -Profile desktop
```

The installer copies the package to `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-computer-use`, appends `dsh-computer-use` to `dsh.profile.bundles` (backing up `package.json`), and installs the skill to `%USERPROFILE%\.agents\skills\computer-use`. It works for any profile, e.g. `-Profile cu-test`, and `-Verify` dumps the composed profile offline.

Uninstall:

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install.ps1 -Profile desktop -Uninstall
```

> **Note on the package name:** an unrelated npm package already uses the name
> `dsh-computer-use`, so `dsh plugin add dsh-computer-use` would install that one.
> Install this plugin through the GitHub spec or the release tarball URL shown
> above. Windows-only (`os: win32`): the helper drives a real interactive desktop
> session via UI Automation + SendInput.

## Configure

Options go in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (the row id is `computer-use`):

```yaml
- id: computer-use
  config:
    # extra process names/paths to deny (built-in denies always stay unless an
    # allow-* escape hatch is enabled)
    blockedProcesses: [msedge.exe]
    # allowlist mode: only these processes may be automated
    # allowedProcesses: [notepad.exe, mspaint.exe]
    screenshotMaxWidth: 1600
    screenshotMaxHeight: 1200
    maxElements: 600
    maxTreeDepth: 12
    idleTimeoutMs: 600000
    startupTimeoutMs: 90000
    requestTimeoutMs: 30000
    confirmRiskyActions: true
    warnWhenApprovalUnavailable: true
    allowWindowsKey: false
    allowTerminalAutomation: false
    keepScreenshots: false
    # screen overlay + ESC kill switch
    overlayEnabled: true
    overlayMessage: "DeepSeek Harness 正在操控你的电脑　|　按 ESC 终止"
    overlayIdleTimeoutMs: 90000
    overlayEdgeOpacity: 55
```

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `helperPath` | bundled | Override the helper script path. |
| `powershellPath` | `powershell.exe` | PowerShell used to host the helper. |
| `idleTimeoutMs` | `600000` | Kill the idle helper; it restarts on the next call. |
| `startupTimeoutMs` | `90000` | First-call budget (PowerShell start + Add-Type compile). |
| `requestTimeoutMs` | `30000` | Per-request budget once warm (screenshots/UIA use longer internal budgets). |
| `screenshotMaxWidth` / `screenshotMaxHeight` | `1600` / `1200` | Helper-side downscale bounds before the attachment store. |
| `maxElements` / `maxTreeDepth` / `maxTextChars` | `600` / `12` / `20000` | Accessibility tree bounds. |
| `blockedProcesses` / `blockedWindowClasses` | `[]` | Extra denials added to the built-in list. |
| `allowedProcesses` | `[]` | When non-empty: allowlist mode (everything else is denied). |
| `keepScreenshots` | `false` | Keep captured PNGs in `%TEMP%\dsh-computer-use` for debugging. |
| `confirmRiskyActions` | `true` | Ask through `ctx.approval` before destructive/externally visible actions. |
| `warnWhenApprovalUnavailable` | `true` | Under approval policy `never`/no channel: continue with a WARNING instead of failing. Set false for fail-closed. |
| `allowWindowsKey` / `allowTerminalAutomation` | `false` | Escape hatches for the two most dangerous hard denies (still discouraged; the helper keeps its own che

plugins.description: Ordered web-search failover provider for DeepSeek Harness: try backends in priority order, fall back automatically.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-web-search-failover

DeepSeek Harness 的搜索故障转移插件：按顺序尝试多个搜索后端，前一个失败（HTTP 错误、没有 `web_search_tool_result` 结果块、或返回空结果）时自动落到下一个。

> **English.** A failover web-search provider for DeepSeek Harness. The harness resolves exactly one search provider per `ctx.web` seam and a provider carries a single `model`, so one upstream error kills the whole search. This bundle registers a `deepseek-failover` provider that walks an ordered list of backends — same request, next backend on any failure (throw, abort excepted, or an empty result) — and only fails when every backend did. The stock `web-search-deepseek` row is disabled by the bundle's own patch, so no manual profile editing is needed. Node ≥ 22, harness ≥ 0.2.1, MIT.

## 为什么需要它

Harness 的 `ctx.web` 每次只解析一个 search provider，provider 也只有单个 `model` 字段，没有失败重试链；`web-search-deepseek` 一旦上游出错，整次搜索就失败。new-api 的自动换渠道只在“同一个模型名有多个渠道”时生效，所以要么在网关造一个别名，要么在 harness 侧做转移。本插件选后者：网关保持官方模型名。

## 兼容性

| 平台 | 支持 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| Windows 10/11（PowerShell 7 或 5.1） | ✅ | `dsh plugin` 本身跨平台；本文所有命令在 PowerShell 里原样可跑 |
| macOS（zsh / bash） | ✅ | 原生路径 |
| Linux | ✅ | 原生路径 |

前置条件：

- **DSH ≥ 0.2.1** — 插件复用 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-search-deepseek` 导出的 `DeepSeekSearchProvider`，0.2.0 没有这个接口
- **Node ≥ 22**，且 **`pnpm` 在 `PATH` 上**（`dsh plugin` 内部调 pnpm）
- 能访问 `https://codeload.github.com`（public 仓库，不需要 token）
- 一个 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容的搜索网关，以及它的 API key

## 安装

一条命令（自动写依赖、写 `dsh.profile.bundles`、并跑 `pnpm install`）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:xingzoudefengye/dsh-web-search-failover
```

```powershell
# Windows 上完全一样
dsh plugin --profile web add github:xingzoudefengye/dsh-web-search-failover
```

然后**重启 DSH**（关掉 `dsh web` 的终端再重新起）。插件是在 host 启动时 import 的，不重启不会生效 —— 详见排错第 1 条。

Desktop 版 profile 名是 `desktop`，需要先**完全退出应用**再加：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:xingzoudefengye/dsh-web-search-failover
```

插件没有 `prepare` 脚本、没有构建步骤，纯 JS，不会触发 pnpm 的 `allowBuilds` 拦截。

### 凭据

插件的 `apiKeyEnv` 指向一个**凭据引用名**，不是明文。把网关令牌写进 harness 的凭据文件：

- macOS / Linux：`~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`
- Windows：`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\.credentials.yaml`

```yaml
refs:
  NEWAPI_API_KEY: sk-...
```

这个文件由 harness 的 credentials 插件注入，**不需要写系统环境变量**。如果你更习惯环境变量，把 `apiKeyEnv` 改成对应的变量名即可。

### 不想用 CLI 时

手工改 profile 的 `package.json` 效果一样：

```jsonc
"dependencies": {
  "dsh-web-search-failover": "github:xingzoudefengye/dsh-web-search-failover"
},
"dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ "...", "dsh-web-search-failover" ] } }
```

再在 profile 目录（如 `~/.dsh/profiles/web`，Windows 是 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\web`）跑 `pnpm install`，重启 DSH。

## 验证

```bash
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A3 "searchProvider"
```

```powershell
dsh --profile web --dump-config | Select-String -Pattern "searchProvider" -Context 0,3
```

应看到 `searchProvider: deepseek-failover`。再做一次真实搜索，网关日志里会出现主后端的模型名；只有主后端失败时才会多一条备用后端。

**关于默认网关地址**：插件自带的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里 `baseURL` 写的是一个示例网关（`http://43.133.21.227:3000/v1`）。用别人的地址跑不通，**请改成你自己的网关**，见下一节。

## 配置

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里覆盖 `id: web-search-failover` 这一行的 `config`：

```yaml
- id: web-search-failover
  config:
    providerId: deepseek-failover   # ctx.web 选中的 provider 名，一般不用改
    backends:
      - { model: claude-haiku-5-5,   baseURL: https://your-gateway/v1, apiKeyEnv: NEWAPI_API_KEY }
      - { model: deepseek-v4-flash,  baseURL: https://your-gateway/v1, apiKeyEnv: NEWAPI_API_KEY }
```

| 键 | 默认 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `providerId` | `deepseek-failover` | 注册给 `ctx.web` 的 provider 名；bundle patch 里 `web.searchProvider` 必须与它一致 |
| `backends` | — | **有序**列表，第 0 个优先，其后都是备胎；每项 `model` / `baseURL` / `apiKeyEnv` 各自独立 |
| `apiKeyEnv` / `baseURL` / `apiKey` / `apiVersion` / `maxTokens` / `maxUses` | 见 `lib/index.js` 的 `Config` | 旧式单后端字段；用 `backends` 时不需要，插件按 backend 逐个构造 provider |

失败判定：抛错、或者成功但没有 sources。`WEB_ABORTED`（用户取消）直接向上抛，不换后端 —— 取消不该触发备用后端。全部失败才返回最后一个错误；如果所有后端都成功但确实没结果，返回那个空结果。

## 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-web-search-failover
```

然后重启 DSH。bundle 的 patch 随之失效，harness 原有的 `web-search-deepseek` 行会恢复；如果你之前手工在 profile patch 里删过它，需要自己加回来。

## 排错

| 现象 | 原因 | 处理 |
|---|---|---|
| `dsh plugin add` 成功，但搜索行为没变 | 插件在 host 进程启动时 import，进程里的模块不会热替换 | 重启 DSH（关掉 `dsh web` 再起） |
| 改了插件源码（哪怕是 `lib/index.js`）也不生效 | Node 的 ESM 缓存：已 import 的模块不会重新执行 | 同上，重启 host；GitHub 安装还需先 `dsh plugin add` 重装以拉新代码 |
| `dsh plugin add` 卡住或报网络错误 | 拉的是 `codeload.github.com` 的 tarball，公司网络/代理常拦 | 走代理，或把仓库整目录拷过去，依赖改成 `file:` 路径后 `pnpm install`（插件无外部 npm 依赖，离线可装） |
| 报 `WEB_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE` | 所有 backends 都 `available() === false`，通常是 `apiKeyEnv` 指向的引用没有值 | 检查 `.credentials.yaml` 的 `refs:` 里有该键，且键名与 `apiKeyEnv` 完全一致 |
| 搜索一直是备用后端的模型 | 主后端失败但未报错（返回空结果也会触发回落） | 看网关日志确认主后端返回码；密钥额度、模型名拼写是最常见原因 |
| 配置树里出现同一个 row id 冲突（`web-search-deepseek` 被两处同时声明） | profile patch 里手工加过 `id: web-search-deepseek` 的行，与 bundle patch 打架 | 删掉 profile 里那一行，插件自带的 patch 已负责禁用它 |

## 同步到另一台机器

逻辑全在插件里，换机器不需要搬配置，但要满足四件事：

1. **装插件**：跑上面那条 `dsh plugin add`。版本自动跟 `master` 最新提交，两台机器不必同 commit，但 harness 版本要一致（都 ≥ 0.2.1）。
2. **凭据**：`.credentials.yaml` 的 `refs:` 里要有 `NEWAPI_API_KEY`。
3. **清掉旧的 provider 行**：profile patch 里若还有 `- id: web-search-deepseek`，删掉。
4. **网关可达**：`baseURL` 换成本机可访问的地址。

## 开发

本仓库是纯 JS、无构建步骤。仓库里没有 `node_modules`，直接 `npm test` 会因为找不到 `@deepseek-ai/*` 的 peer 依赖而失败 —— 先把本机已安装的 harness 包链进来：

```bash
node scripts/dev-link.mjs            # 探测 dsh 的安装位置，链入 schemastery / dsh-web / dsh-web-search-deepseek 等
npm test                             # node --test
```

`dev-link` 依次探测：`dsh` 可执行文件所在的 npm 目录、`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>`、`$DSH_HOME/profiles`、`$DSH_HOME`，也可以用第一个参数或 `DSH_PACKAGE_DIR` 直接指定 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 所在目录。Windows 上用 junction，不需要管理员权限。

改完代码在本地验证，再装到 profile：`dsh plugin --profile web add <本仓库绝对路径>` 走 `link:` 依赖，配合 `dev-link` 即可改完重启 host 就看到效果。

## 相关插件

同作者、同一套安装方式（`dsh plugin add github:xingzoudefengye/<repo>`）：

- [dsh-browser](https://github.com/xingzoudefengye/dsh-browser) — 给 agent 一个可驱动的真实浏览器，侧栏并排显示
- [dsh-compaction-local-handoff](https://github.com/xingzoudefengye/dsh-compaction-local-handoff) — 无模型的本地交接式压缩
- [dsh-project-memory](https://github.com/xingzoudefengye/dsh-project-memory) — 有界、可提交进 git 的项目记忆
- [dsh-resume-budget](https://github.com/xingzoudefengye/dsh-resume-budget) — 会话恢复时的输入预算控制
- [dsh-session-recall](https://github.com/xingzoudefengye/dsh-session-recall) — 无模型、有界的会话史书

## 许可

MIT © xingzoudefengye，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: Android companion for DeepSeek Harness | chat, goals, approvals & notifications from your phone, over your LAN. Kotlin + Jetpack Compose.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Mobile — DeepSeek Harness Remote

An open-source Android companion that puts your DeepSeek Harness in your pocket.
Drive sessions, review plans and goals, answer approvals and questions, and get notified when the harness finishes — from your phone, over your network or a relay.

English · 中文 · हिन्दी · Español · Français · ไทย

DSH Mobile is an **unofficial companion app** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (MIT). It mirrors the web GUI feature for feature and uses the harness's own visual language. Android only, Kotlin + Jetpack Compose. Its companion on the other end is [**dsh-relay**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-relay), a harness plugin that adds the authentication layer the harness says it lacks, so this app can reach a harness with a real credential and a pinned key instead of an open port. See [Relay](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Relay). **[dshm.zyphite.com](https://dshm.zyphite.com)** is the project site: what the app is, what it looks like, and how to get it running, on one page. Drafts are kept per host and session. - Workspace panels — tabbed text, Markdown, image, PDF and isolated HTML previews; native terminal controls with a bundled xterm renderer; archived-session restore in Settings. - Message feedback — confirmed ratings and retraction, with version-conflict handling. - Slash commands and skills — typing `/` lists the session's commands and skills above the composer. The composer checks a `/` line against the session's own command catalog and runs it through the harness's command gateway. Anything the catalog does not claim is sent as a prompt, which is how skills get invoked. With the dsh-rewind plugin on the host, `/rewind` opens a picker. - Everything the GUI does — goals (phases, rounds, pause/resume/edit), plan mode and plan review, permission approvals, user questions, todo dock, subagents (catalog, follow-ups, interrupt), background jobs, workflow runs, skills, model selection, agent presets, session search, trajectory ledger, session export, message feedback. - Notifications — turn complete, goal complete or blocked, review or question waiting for you. A foreground service keeps the connection alive in the background. - Harness look — the exact DeepSeek Harness design tokens (colors, type, radii, disclosure rows, shimmer, ink buttons), with light, dark and system themes. - 11 languages — English, 中文, हिन्दी, Español, Français, العربية, বাংলা, Português, Русский, اردو, ไทย (RTL aware). ### Added in 0.15.0 - A Check now button for updates in Settings > About.
