⚔️ DeepSeek Harness cybersecurity red-team tool (dsh-purge)

Version 1.1.71

DeepSeek Harness jailbreak: every model, swap prompts per model. Default prompt for 小码酱. Please star ⭐ If you build on this, see Attribution required.


English | 中文

--- ## 🔧 This fork: fixed for DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 > **Upstream: [github.com/YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge](https://github.com/YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge)** (MIT). This repo is a fork of it, pinned to upstream commit `6c1d638` (release [v1.1.71](https://github.com/YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge/releases/tag/v1.1.71)). > > **Upstream `1.1.71` does not run on DSH Desktop `0.2.1-rc.2`.** Six adapter breaks make the plugin throw or silently do nothing — and one of them **stops DSH from opening at all**. This fork fixes them, and every fix is written version-adaptively so the `0.2.0-rc.2` behaviour still works. > > Upstream is MIT-licensed; **all copyright and attribution belong to the upstream author 小杨**. The original README is kept in full below — only this section is added. ### The six fixes | # | Symptom | Cause (host evidence) | Fix | |---|---|---|---| | 1 | **DSH will not open** after enabling the plugin; or the settings page renders every config row **twice**; two `dsh-purge-redteam-store` instances fight over one SQLite file | `cordis.patch.yml` carried **two** `- insert:` blocks, so all four plugin rows were inserted twice. The host re-reads that file from disk on **every** boot, so it hit every boot | deleted the duplicate block (one insert block / four plugin rows) | | 2 | `[E] [tool-subagent] tool-subagent: toolFilter is no longer supported` — the whole `repairDelegation` path dies | `0.2.1-rc.2` removed `toolFilter` / `persona` from the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent` Config; writing either one **throws** at `lib/index.js:355` | dropped the key from the preset template (leaf constraint goes to `maxDepth: 1`) and added a line-wise strip in `repairDelegation()` that repairs old-format presets automatically | | 3 | `unknown prompt variable "{{cwd}}"`, or `{ {cwd}}` / empty working directory in the system prompt | `0.2.1` registers only `model` and `provider`; **nothing registers `cwd`** any more, and strict interpolation of an unregistered variable throws and drops the whole batch of sections | the plugin registers `cwd` itself; the persona section prefers a literal path over the placeholder | | 4 | patch `#40 COMPLETE_PROMPT_KEEP_INJECT` stops matching | the host's `assemble()` narrowed `contexts` to a `requiredContexts` filter, so the old anchor no longer fits | added a `0.2.1`-shaped pattern; the replacement body moved into `completePromptInjectBody()` | | 5 | `desktop-shell` patches silently do nothing | `0.2.1`'s executable is named **`DSH Desktop.exe`**, while `isOfficialHarnessExecutable` only recognised `deepseek-harness`, so `officialShellMain()` returned empty | added `DSH Desktop.exe` / `dsh-desktop.exe` and a tolerant matcher | | 6 | The whole persona disappears when one section fails to interpolate | the host's `assemble()` fallback returned `{ sections: [] }` on error | rebuild the section table in registration order and drop only the sections that fail to interpolate | Also: the patch registry now marks retired patches, so **"did not match"** is distinguishable from **"already retired"** — the expected final state is `applied 66 / na 15 / pending 1` (the last is `#40`, complete-mode only). ### Install ```bash # from the Release tarball (most reproducible) pnpm add https://github.com/Potato1008ypy/dsh-purge-0.2.1rc2-fix/archive/refs/tags/v1.1.71-dsh0.2.1rc2-fix.tar.gz # or straight from the repo at that tag pnpm add "github:Potato1008ypy/dsh-purge-0.2.1rc2-fix#v1.1.71-dsh0.2.1rc2-fix" ``` In the GUI: **Plugins panel → Add plugin** accepts a Git address, a tarball or a local absolute path — the host performs a `git ls-remote` reachability check first (5 s default), so a blocked GitHub is reported as such. Full steps, the two `package.json` fields that decide whether a bundle actually loads, and rescue paths when DSH will not start: **[INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md)**. ### ⚠️ Do not "update" this plugin Both this fork and upstream are **`1.1.71`**, so the plugin manager may offer an update that would replace these fixes with the broken copy and bring the duplicated-insert startup failure right back. - **Never** run `pnpm update dsh-purge`, and do not accept a one-click update for it. - To replace it: remove `dsh-purge` from the profile's `bundles` and purge the old `node_modules/dsh-purge`, then install again from the tag above. **Upstream project (original README, all original code):** [github.com/YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge](https://github.com/YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge) Full per-fix detail, host evidence and verification commands: **[FIXES.en.md](FIXES.en.md)** (English) or **[FIXES.md](FIXES.md)** (中文). Installation, verification checklist and rescue paths: **[INSTALL.en.md](INSTALL.en.md)**. Self-repair tool for the duplicate-insert and retired-key problems: **[dsh-purge-repair.mjs](dsh-purge-repair.mjs)**. --- > **Updates paused.** The author has no steady income for now because of work. Maintenance is on hold: no new releases, issues / PRs are not taken, and new dsh versions are not guaranteed. The repo stays usable; see Sponsor below. When maintenance resumes, this README will say so. > **Official Web and the official desktop app are both supported.** Official `dsh web` uses profile `web`. The official desktop EXE (DeepSeek Harness **0.2.0-rc.2**) uses profile `desktop`. Install and Apply them separately. This release targets dsh 0.2 only. Older dsh builds need the matching older plugin. Community Desktop is not maintained. > > Adding the plugin to a profile does not patch the host. Click **dsh-purge** beside the session title → **Clean** → **Apply**. A successful Apply restarts; an unfinished Apply does not. After the restart, start a new chat — that is when the inject enters the session. > > Node.js **≥18**. Windows no-flash needs **Node ≥22**. Hub one-click and the commands below both install the npm package `dsh-purge`. ## Contents - [Sponsor](#sponsor) - [This fork: fixed for 0.2.1-rc.2](#-this-fork-fixed-for-dsh-desktop-021-rc2) - [What this is](#what-this-is) - [Attribution required](#attribution-required) - [Unauthorized commercial use](#unauthorized-commercial-use) - [Supported hosts](#supported-hosts) - [Install](#install) - [Preview](#preview) - [Usage](#us

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-extra-workspaces

给一个 DSH 会话挂上额外的本地工作目录。清单出现在右侧栏的 **会话设置** 页里，并且会作为一条运行时上下文提醒告诉模型——只在清单变化时注入，不是每轮重复。

## 它做什么

- 会话设置页里多出一节 **额外工作区**：添加目录（走 DSH 自带的目录选择器）、改别名、写一句备注、删除。
- 清单按会话保存（`<DSH_HOME>/storages/session_settings/sessions/<会话id>.json`），DSH 重启后同一条会话仍然带着它。
- 清单变化时，模型的最新上下文里出现一条提醒，列出每个目录的别名、绝对路径、备注，并**如实说明当前权限档下能不能改这些目录**。
- 不注册成 DSH 的正式工作区，不改 DSH 本体的任何文件，不挂 DSH 的任何钩子。

## 权限：说清楚，不假装

本插件**不扩大 DSH 允许写入的范围**。DSH 的可写根只有一个：会话自己的工作目录（外加系统临时目录）。所以：

| 会话权限档 | 主工作区 | 额外工作区 |
|---|---|---|
| 仅可查看 | 读得到，改不了 | 读得到，改不了 |
| 工作区可写 | 读得到，改得了 | 读得到，改不了；只读命令能跑，要写文件的命令会被拒绝 |
| 完全权限 | 完全对等 | 完全对等 |

提醒文本按会话**实际**权限档选措辞，所以模型不会以为自己能写其实写不了。

## 规则

- 同一个目录重复添加会被拒绝；
- 与已有条目互相包含（父目录或子目录）也会被拒绝——避免"加了父目录之后主工作区反而变成它的子目录"这种状态；
- 每个会话最多 8 条（可用 `maxWorkspaces` 配置）；
- 目录被删掉或移走不会自动移除，也**不会**被插件主动标注：提醒里不断言目录是否存在（那需要在每步请求里探测磁盘，会把整个 DSH 卡住），面板上的标注只在目录选择器处于"网页内浏览"形态时可用，且含义是"宿主读不到这个目录"。

## 配置

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `maxWorkspaces` | `8` | 每个会话最多几条（上限 64） |
| `reminderLanguage` | `'zh'` | 提醒文本语言（`'zh'` / `'en'`） |

## 安装

包放进 profile 能解析的位置（例如 `link:D:/projects/dsh-plugins/dsh-extra-workspaces`），把它加进 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`，再按 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的那一行把宿主半边挂上。客户端半边由 `dsh.client` 声明自动装配，无需额外步骤。

## 依赖与升级对照

这个插件依赖 DSH 的哪些特性/API、动了 DSH 的哪些部分、DSH 升级时要复查什么，见 [docs/dsh-dependencies.md](docs/dsh-dependencies.md)。

## 测试

```sh
node --test "tests/**/*.spec.mjs"
```

## 已知边界

- 只支持本地目录；远程（SSH）工作区未支持。
- 不判断目录是否存在：提醒不断言，请求路径上也不探测磁盘（网络路径的探测会同步阻塞整个进程）。
- 会话设置页仍会显示这一项自带的"默认值/已覆盖"框架，那由页面控制，不由本插件控制。

plugins.description: A portable memory protocol for AI agents — load it as standing rules; a curation discipline + reference spec + optional cap hook.
plugins.readme_text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

# Engramory

[![CI](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.9%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)

**An opinionated, zero-infrastructure memory *protocol* for small-scale, local,
file-based agent memory** — a strict curation discipline plus a validator
(`tools/engramory_doctor.py`), loaded as **standing rules** (`CLAUDE.md` /
`AGENTS.md` / your host's rules file). It is not a database, a framework, or a
relevance-loaded skill. Memory is a folder of small, human-readable markdown files
plus one always-loaded index. No database, no embeddings, no server — just
plain-text files you can open, read, edit, and diff in any editor (the live store
itself stays git-ignored).

> *Engramory* — coined from *engram* (the physical trace a memory leaves in the
> brain) + *memory*. Here: one file = one fact.

> ⚠️ **Unrelated projects share this name.** *engram + memory* is an obvious
> coinage and at least one other repository arrived at it independently. This
> project is only ever `tinqiao-oss/engramory` (npm: `dsh-engramory`); a same-named
> repo under a different owner is not a fork, a mirror, or a newer version of it.

> 🤖 **Are you an AI agent, asked to install or check this?** Start at
> **[AGENT-SETUP.md](AGENT-SETUP.md)**, not at the install steps below. It is the
> procedure for working out what your host can actually enforce, whether a store
> already exists, what you must not touch, and what to tell the user — the parts
> agents reliably get wrong when improvising.

> **Status: 0.12.1 — experimental.** The hard index cap (a `PreToolUse` hook) is
> deterministic for the matched direct-edit tools (`Edit | Write | MultiEdit`) but
> NOT a global write guard (shell tools — Bash, PowerShell, a background Monitor
> command — plus MCP file tools, external editors, and sync clients bypass it);
> the discipline loads as standing rules the model follows, so it's
> best-effort, not guaranteed on every task (see [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) §8). Assumes a
> single writer / serialized writes. Don't rely on it as a "mandatory, reliable,
> cross-agent" memory layer yet.

---

## What this is — and is NOT

Engramory is **not a new memory architecture**. The "markdown files + a small index
loaded into context + the model curates it" pattern is now the mainstream shape
for agent memory, and it ships in several places already. Engramory stands on:

- **Claude Code native auto-memory** — the same markdown-`MEMORY.md`-index +
  lazy detail-file pattern; its system prompt even uses the same
  `user | feedback | project | reference` type vocabulary (per
  [anthropics/claude-code#58840](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/58840);
  the *public docs* describe only the index + topic files). Engramory is a
  disciplined superset of this default.
- **[basic-memory](https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory)** — markdown
  source-of-truth, YAML frontmatter `type`, `[[wikilink]]` graph, local-first.
- **[obsidian-second-brain](https://github.com/eugeniughelbur/obsidian-second-brain)**,
  **[claude-memory-compiler](https://github.com/coleam00/claude-memory-compiler)**
  ("a loaded index beats vector search at personal scale"), and the broader family
  of markdown-memory skills.

What Engramory contributes is the **opinionated bundle + the discipline**, not the
primitives. Do not claim novelty on markdown, frontmatter, wikilinks, a loaded
index, one-file-per-fact notes, or curation hygiene — all are prior art.

## What's actually differentiated

1. **A role/purpose ontology, headed by `feedback` = procedural memory.** The
   semantic / episodic / **procedural** split is established prior art — the CoALA
   taxonomy, and a named procedural type in LangMem and mem0 — so Engramory does not
   claim the category. What it does is make procedural `feedback` the *spine* of a
   deliberately tiny, hand-authored, human-readable set, with required **Why:** /
   **How to apply:** lines, instead of auto-extracting it into a vector/graph store.
   The contribution is the packaging and discipline, not the ontology.

2. **The curation contract as concrete behaviour** the protocol applies (model-followed, not a hard gate): dedup-before-write,
   update-don't-duplicate, delete-when-wrong, and a negative-scope rule ("don't
   store what git/CLAUDE.md/the code already records"). Surveys consistently name
   *modify/delete/forget* as the most under-implemented memory operation — Engramory
   makes it the spine.

3. **A bounded index designed not to silently rot.** The index loads every session and
   Claude Code reads the first 200 lines / 25 KB (documented behavior), so an unbounded index silently
   drops memories off the end. Engramory warns at 150 lines / 20 KB, compacts-or-asks
   before 200 / 25 KB, and ships a hard `PreToolUse` hook backstop (it blocks only
   *growth* past the cap — shrinking/compaction edits always pass). Both the line and
   byte caps apply — whichever is hit first triggers (an index can be under the line
   count yet over on bytes when the lines run long).

   Claude Code has since followed up on this natively: v2.1.186 (released
   2026-06-22) reminds the agent to compact the index when it nears the cap, and
   v2.1.210 (released 2026-07-14) turned an over-cap write into an explicit error
   instead of a silent truncation. Both are after-the-fact alerts, though — the
   write still lands, and entries past the cap stay invisible until someone
   compacts. Engramory's hook denies the write *before* it happens, so a write
   through the matched edit tools never leaves the index over-cap in the first
   place (writes outside them — a shell, an MCP file tool — are not gated; see the
   status note above and SKILL.md §8). The native alerts validate the direction
   and make a welcome second layer — and older versions and other hosts still
   have neither.

## How it compares

| | storage | recall | human-readable | typed ontology | curation discipline | bounded index | infra |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Engramory** | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ role-based (4) | ✅ contract (model-run) | ✅ 150/200 + hook | none |
| CC auto-memory | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ same 4 types | partial (auto) | ~200-line window* | none (built-in) |
| basic-memory | md + SQLite | semantic/FTS search | ✅ | ✅ freeform type | schema + overwrite checks | ❌ (no loaded index) | SQLite + embeddings |
| obsidian-second-brain | md vault | index-first + search | ✅ | folder-typed | ✅ reconcile/lint | partial | none |
| mem0 / Zep | vector/graph DB | semantic | ❌ (DB) | typed (prefs/episodic/proc.; Zep custom) | auto-extract | n/a | DB + embeddings |
| [agentmemory](https://github.com/rohitg00/agentmemory) | SQLite + vector index (+opt. graph) | hybrid BM25+vector (+opt. graph), RRF | ❌ (DB/engine) | ✅ 4-tier lifecycle (work./epis./sem./proc.) | auto (capture + dedup + decay) | n/a | iii engine (local) + opt. embeddings |

Engramory's lane: **minimalism + actionable role typing + curation discipline, zero
infra.** It does *not* try to out-search basic-memory, out-scale mem0, or
out-capture agentmemory — those solve a different problem (auto-capture /
auto-ingest at volume) at a different cost point. agentmemory is the closest
heavyweight foil: also local-first, but it bets on automatic capture (lifecycle
hooks) + hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vectors + optional graph) on a SQLite/`iii`
engine, where Engramory bets on hand-curation + a tiny always-loaded index and
ships no engine at all.

\* Claude Code's [memory docs](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/memory)
document this exactly: *"the first 200 lines of `MEMORY.md`, or the first 25KB,
whichever comes first, are loaded at the start of every conversation."* Other hosts
vary, so the window stays configurable via the hook's env vars.

## Where it fits — and the goal

Engramory is a **portable memory *discipline*, not a

plugins.description: Session cost and remaining provider balance below the DeepSeek Harness Web composer.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-cost-meter

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows one ambient line below the Web composer:
the estimated model cost of the current session **and of every subagent session
it started**, plus the remaining balance of the provider route in use.

```
[ Composer card                                 ]
      Cost $0.1306 · Balance $12.50
```

Hovering a pill shows its breakdown: token buckets per model route, how much of
the total came from subagent sessions, per-request fees, and topped-up versus
granted credit for the balance.

## What the number includes

- **This session**, priced from the usage the provider reported in its own log.
- **Every subagent session it delegated to**, transitively. A subagent runs as a
  separate Session with its own log, so the parent's log names its children
  (`subagent/catalog`) but never their usage; the plugin reads each child's own
  projected cost instead — from the live Session while the app still holds it,
  from the child's durable checkpoint once it has settled, and by re-folding that
  child's own log where no checkpoint can serve it (see below).
- **Per-request fees** for calls that are billed outside token usage, currently
  DeepSeek Search/Fetch requests at $0.75 per 1,000 successful requests. A
  request event records the request, not its usage, so this is a stated estimate.

If a child session cannot be read at all — no live Session and no checkpoint
whose lifecycle matches — the plugin does not pretend it cost nothing. It marks
the total as a lower bound (`at least $0.1306`) and says how many sessions were
unreadable, rather than showing a number that looks exact.

Why a total can still differ from <https://platform.deepseek.com>'s usage log:
that page bills an account, so it also covers sessions this machine never ran and
any other client using the same key. Auxiliary model calls whose usage is never
recorded (session titles, and the DeepSeek-side search calls a search request can
fan out to, up to `maxUses` per request) are billed by DeepSeek but are invisible
to any log-based reader. The plugin therefore estimates from what the logs
record, and labels that estimate as one.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness with the Web app (`dsh web`). The balance read needs the
  `connection` and `credentials` services, which the shipped Web composition
  provides.
- For the balance pill, a wallet endpoint plus a stored credential for it; the
  built-in default is DeepSeek's Platform balance endpoint with a
  `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` credential reference. Cost needs nothing: prices ship in the
  row config.

## Install

```sh
# 1. install the package into a profile
dsh plugin --profile web add github:dsh-plugin-db/dsh-cost-meter

# …or from a local checkout
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-cost-meter
```

2. Enable the bundle: **Settings → Plugins → Installed → dsh-cost-meter → on**.
   (An agent driving the plugin manager does both steps at once with
   `install_bundle`.)

The package ships a bundle patch, so enabling it inserts the row with built-in
defaults. Cost works immediately; the balance pill appears once a wallet source
answers. The credential reference is resolved on the Host, so the secret never
reaches the browser.

## Configuration

Every value lives in the row config, so it survives DSH upgrades in the
profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` (highest-priority layer):

```yaml
- id: dsh-cost-meter
  name: 'dsh-cost-meter'
  config:
    prices:
      - provider: '*'        # '*' matches any route; a literal provider wins over '*'
        model: deepseek-flash
        currency: USD
        input: 0.3           # per 1M cache-miss input tokens
        output: 1.2          # per 1M output tokens
        cacheRead: 0.006     # per 1M cache-hit input tokens
        cacheWrite: 0.3      # optional; defaults to `input`
        offPeak:             # optional; used outside `peakWindows`
          input: 0.15
          output: 0.6
          cacheRead: 0.003
          cacheWrite: 0.15
    peakWindows:             # optional; defaults to DeepSeek's published windows
      - { startHourUtc: 1, endHourUtc: 4, weekdaysOnly: true }
      - { startHourUtc: 6, endHourUtc: 10, weekdaysOnly: true }
    balances:                # optional; provider route → wallet endpoint
      - provider: deepseek-official
        url: https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance
        credential: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY   # credential reference resolved in the Host
        auth: bearer                   # or x-api-key
        timeoutMs: 10000
    fees:                    # optional; Session events that are billed per request
      - event: web/deepseek-search-llm-request
        label: Search
        per1kRequests: 0.75  # DeepSeek Search/Fetch list price, USD
        currency: USD
```

Lookup specificity is `provider+model` → `provider+*` → `*+model` → `*+*`. A
route with no matching row still shows its token count, and the cost pill is
prefixed with "at least" while unpriced calls exist, so an estimate never
pretends to be complete.

A `fees` row counts the Session events of that exact type and bills them per
1,000 requests, outside token pricing, which is how DeepSeek bills its Search and
Fetch calls. The default row covers `web/deepseek-search-llm-request`, the event
the Web app's DeepSeek search feature records for each search request. Set
`fees: []` to price tokens only.

Shipped defaults are DeepSeek's published list prices for `deepseek-flash` and
`deepseek-v4-pro` (per 1M tokens, USD) with their peak/off-peak windows, and the
Search/Fetch per-request fee. Prices change; edit them in the profile patch.

## Balance

The Client reads the balance in two steps, and reports what it finds:

1. The signed-in DeepSeek account through `ctx.remote.account.getBalance`, for
   routes whose provider starts with `deepseek`.
2. This plugin's Host route, asked for the exact route the session is spending
   on. The Host matches that provider against `balances` (an exact provider wins
   over `*`), resolves the named credential through `ctx.credentials`, calls the
   endpoint, and answers with the wallet amounts only.

A route the Host prices no wallet for (`unsupported-provider`) shows nothing, so
the pill never appears for a provider that simply has no `balances` row. Every
other outcome is visible: the amount when the wallets are read, and `Balance —`
with the reason in its tooltip when the credential is missing, the endpoint
fails, or the route does not answer at all. That reason carries the HTTP status
and the body, which separates the two silent failures: a browser sees
`404 not found` when this build's route is not mounted, and `401 unauthorized`
when the request never reached it.

The key never reaches the browser, and the endpoint is ordinary configuration:
another provider whose API returns a wallet needs a new `balances` row plus a
parser kind in `index.js`. Amounts are re-read once a minute; each pill carries
its own currency, so a USD cost and a CNY balance never get conflated.

## How it is built

| Half | File | Role |
|---|---|---|
| Host | `index.js` | Two `sessionProjections` units — `costMeter` (prices provider-reported usage and per-request fees) and `costMeterFamily` (this session plus every session it delegated to) — plus one balance route on Connection's `/api` channel |
| Client | `client.js` | One `conversation.composer.dock` entry that renders the family wire value, falling back to the session value, asking the Host for a family read while the projection is still incomplete, and reading the balance |

The Host folds the durable Session log and publishes two client-visible
projections; the Client renders them through the `useProjection` slot prop. Both
halves were written against documented seams only:

- `ctx.sessionProjections.register({key, stateVersion, stateSchema, init, apply, wire})` —
  projection units; the registry calls only `schema.parse`, so the schemas here
  are small hand-written normalizers with no schema-library dependency.
- The `SessionEvent` envelope and payloads: `request/header` (route),
  `assistant/message` / `assistant/attempt` (usage, from `data.usage` or the
  last `usage` chunk of the com

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件：连接装了 host_server_mcp 的服务器，在 Web 设置页配置（IP/主机名 + 端口 + token），之后 agent 对话里即可访问这些服务器排查问题——查看信息、执行脚本、读文件、一键诊断。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-host-mcp

DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件：连接装了 [host_server_mcp](https://gitee.com/awol2010ex/host_server_mcp) 的服务器，在 Web 设置页配置（IP/主机名 + 端口 + token），之后 **agent 对话里即可访问这些服务器排查问题**——查看信息、执行脚本、读文件、一键诊断。

## 能力

| 通道 | 能力 |
|------|------|
| **设置 → 插件 → 服务器** | 增删改服务器（host/port/token/mcpPath/备注）、设默认、行内「测试连接」（保存前预检，不依赖已落盘配置） |
| **agent 工具 `host-mcp`** | `probe`（连通诊断）、`diagnose`（一键排查）、`whoami`、`list_files`、`count_file_lines`、`read_file_lines`、`exec_script`、`server_info`（服务端环境）、`health`、`servers`、`version`、`probe_uncached`（配置页预检） |
| **侧边栏「服务器」按钮** | 浮动运维面板：概览 / 文件 / 执行 三个页签 |

## 安装

```bash
# 1. 构建（产出 lib/）
npm install
npm run build

# 2. 装进 web profile
cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/web"     # Windows: C:\Users\<you>\.dsh\profiles\web
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add D:/workspace_node/dsh-hosts

# 3. 重启 dsh
```

装好后 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 会多出一行（插件自带的 bundle patch 也会 insert 同一 id，二者幂等）：

```yaml
- id: host-mcp
  name: dsh-host-mcp
```

## 配置服务器

打开 **设置 → 插件 → 服务器**（在「内置插件」页的页签里）：

1. 点 `+ 添加服务器`，填 **主机/IP**、**端口**、**Token**（host_server_mcp 的 token，形如 `hsk_...`）；
2. 单选钮设为默认服务器；
3. 点 `保存配置` —— 写入 profile 配置（volatile 字段，宿主热更新，无需重启）；
4. 想先验证再保存，点行内 `测试连接`：依次探 `/health` 与 MCP `initialize`，token 是否有效一目了然。

> 也可以用 `高级：JSON 编辑` 直接编辑 `servers` 数组。
> token 会明文写入本机 profile 配置文件，请只填可信的内网服务器。

### 配置字段

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| `servers` | `[]` | JSON 数组 `[{id,host,port,token,mcpPath,note}]` |
| `defaultServer` | 第一个 | 省略 `server` 参数时使用的服务器 |
| `requestTimeoutMs` | `60000` | 单次 MCP 请求 HTTP 超时 |
| `defaultTimeoutSecs` | `10` | `exec_script` 默认超时（服务端会再钳一次） |
| `readLimitBytes` | `131072` | 读文件预览默认字节上限 |
| `maxResultChars` | `262144` | 工具结果回传上限（超出截断） |

## agent 工具

```
host-mcp(action, args?, server?)
```

`action` 取值与用法：

| action | args | 用途 |
|--------|------|------|
| `probe` | — | **连通诊断**：health + MCP initialize + whoami，失败时给修复提示 |
| `diagnose` | — | **一键排查**：health + whoami + 系统探测（uname/负载/内存/磁盘/CPU 进程） |
| `whoami` | — | token 身份、作用域（read/exec）、可访问根目录、限流与超时上限 |
| `list_files` | `{path, pattern, recursive, max_entries}` | 列目录（glob + 递归） |
| `count_file_lines` | `{path}` | 行数/字节数/修改时间（读大文件前先调用） |
| `read_file_lines` | `{path, start_line, end_line, with_line_numbers}` | 按行区间读文件 |
| `exec_script` | `{script, interpreter, cwd, timeout_secs}` | 在服务器沙箱内执行脚本（失败回 `error_kind` 结构化分类，如解释器未授权、命令被拦截等） |
| `server_info` | — | 服务端运行环境：OS/架构、可用解释器及版本、白名单与默认解释器（需 exec 作用域；`exec_script` 前可先调用选解释器） |
| `probe_uncached` | `{host, port, token, mcpPath}` | 探测**尚未保存**的服务器定义（配置页「测试连接」专用；回包只给阶段结论与修复提示，不回显 token） |
| `health` | — | `GET /health` |
| `servers` | — | 已配置服务器清单（**不含 token**） |
| `version` | — | 插件名称与版本 |

对话示例：

> 帮我看看 bd-pr-rn1 上 host_server_mcp 服务是否正常，磁盘还剩多少。

agent 会调 `host-mcp(action:"diagnose", server:"bd-pr-rn1")`，一次拿到服务状态 + 系统信息。

## 架构

```
浏览器半（lib/client.js）
  ├─ 设置页配置编辑器 ──► ctx.configForms.get('host-mcp')  ◄─ 官方配置通道（落盘 + 热更新）
  └─ 侧边栏/浮动运维面板 ──► connection.rpc.call('/api', 'host-mcp/<endpoint>')
                                     │
宿主半（lib/index.js）                  ▼
  ├─ connection.fetch.register('/api/host-mcp/<endpoint>')   ← 精确路由（0.1.5+ 唯一正解）
  ├─ RPC 分发器（rpc.ts）：现读配置 → pickServer → MCP 客户端
  ├─ MCP Streamable HTTP 客户端（mcp-client.ts）：
  │    initialize（拿 Mcp-Session-Id）→ notifications/initialized → tools/call
  │    SSE 帧解析、会话缓存、422/404 会话失效自动重建（服务端空闲回收或重启后自愈）、401 可读报错
  └─ agent 工具（tool.ts）：万能 host-mcp 工具，复用同一条分发路径
```

安全边界：

- token **只**存在于插件配置里；`servers` RPC 端点与工具结果一律脱敏，不回传明文；
- `exec_script` 的最终安全边界在 host_server_mcp 服务端（解释器白名单、危险命令黑名单、强制超时、进程树 kill），本插件不改写、不绕过；
- 浏览器半只能经 `/api` 精确路由访问宿主半，无第二条通路。

## 开发

```bash
npm install
npm run build          # tsc + wrap-client
npm run check          # 冒烟 + 依赖解析 + cordis 服务访问 + 配置解析（离线可跑）
npm run check:resolve  # 只跑依赖解析（从 profile 的 node_modules 出发）
npm run check:cordis   # 真 cordis 验证 ctx.inject 跨 fiber 读服务
npm run check:parse    # 配置解析链路（含 role(secret) 回归）
npm run check:live     # 真机联调（需要 HSM_HOST/HSM_PORT/HSM_TOKEN）
```

真机联调（token 只经环境变量，不落盘）：

```bash
HSM_HOST=bd-pr-rn1 HSM_PORT=8765 HSM_TOKEN=hsk_xxx npm run check:live
```

## 已知限制

- `read_file_lines` 是 host_server_mcp 里唯一返回**原始文本**（非 JSON 信封）的工具，面板已特判；
- MCP 会话有服务端生命周期：rmcp 的 LocalSessionManager 默认空闲 5 分钟即销毁会话（服务重启同理），之后带旧会话 id 的请求会得到 404。客户端会自动「清缓存 → 重新 initialize → 重试一次」自愈，调用方无感——长时间空闲后的第一次调用会多一次握手；
- `diagnose` 的系统探测用 `interpreter: python`（跨平台最稳），需要服务器白名单里有 python；
- 管理 API（`/admin/tokens` 签发/吊销）未接入面板，请用 host_server_mcp 自带的管理接口。

## 许可

Apache-2.0

plugins.description: DSH 插件：电商平台店铺账号管理（拼多多/淘宝/天猫/抖音/京东/1688，全部商家端）。一店一份 Chrome 登录档案 + 固定 CDP 端口，登录一次长期复用，上架脚本直接连端口。零第三方依赖。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-shop-accounts（账号管理）

DSH 的一个插件：**统一管理电商平台的店铺/账号登录态**。在「设置 → 账号管理」里增删店铺、
一键拉起登录窗口，登录完点「完成」，浏览器窗口自动关掉、登录态留在磁盘上；
后续上架流程直接复用同一份浏览器档案，**不用重新登录**。
目前支持 **拼多多 / 淘宝 / 天猫 / 抖音（抖店）/ 京东（京麦）/ 1688**，**全部是商家端**（卖家后台，
不是买家/消费端）。

## 它到底怎么保住登录态

一个店铺 = 一份**独立的 Chrome 用户目录（profile）** + 一个固定的**调试端口（CDP）**。

| 你要的东西 | 落点 |
| --- | --- |
| 店铺清单 / 配置 | `%DSH_HOME%\shop-accounts\accounts.json`、`config.json`（`%DSH_HOME%` 默认是 `~/.dsh`） |
| 登录态（cookie 等） | 每个店铺自己的 Chrome user-data-dir，默认 `%DSH_HOME%\shop-accounts\profiles\<账号id>\` |
| 调试端口 | 从 `portBase`（默认 9222）起自动找空位，一店一端口 |

登录窗口就是一个**真实的有头 Chrome**（不是无头、不是抓包），你在里面正常扫码/输密码/过滑块。
插件在后台轮询这个端口的登录态；一旦判成已登录，「完成」按钮就变可点，点下去窗口自动关闭。

## 用法

1. 「设置 → 账号管理」→ **新增店铺** → 选平台、填店铺名/备注（端口可留空自动分配）→ **创建并去登录**。
2. 在弹出的 Chrome 窗口里正常登录到**卖家端**商家后台（见下面那张平台表；淘宝/天猫是 `loginmyseller.taobao.com` → 千牛，拼多多是 `mms.pinduoduo.com`，抖音是抖店 `fxg.jinritemai.com`，京东是京麦 `passport.shop.jd.com`，1688 是 `login.1688.com`）。
3. 回到 DSH，行内状态会自己变成「已登录」→ 点该行的 **完成并关闭**。
4. 之后这个店铺就一直显示登录态；上架时把它的 `profileDir` + `port` 交给上架脚本复用。

其它动作：**检测**（静默复核登录态，不开窗口）、**打开**（重新拉起窗口到工作台）、**去登录 / 重新登录**、
**重扫**（清空这个店铺的本地档案再打开登录页 —— 站点在档案里留着半死会话、登录页直接跳回后台不给二维码时用）、
**完成并关闭**、**关闭**、**复制路径**（复制该账号的档案目录，给上架脚本用）、**编辑**、**删除**（可选连同磁盘档案目录一起删）。
每行最左边的 **管理** 会打开该店铺的详情页（见下节）。

> 关于「重新登录」：窗口**已经开着**的店铺，点「去登录 / 重新登录」会在**已有的那个浏览器里新开一个登录页标签页**，
> 不会再拉起第二只 Chrome（Chrome 是单实例，同档案再启一次只会把 URL 转给已有窗口然后自己退出，
> 而调试端口仍被老实例占着 —— 老版本在这里会变成"点了没反应"）。没开着的店铺才会启动新窗口。

## 支持的平台（都是商家端）

| 平台 | 登录页（新增店铺时打开的） | 「打开」落到的工作台 | 登录态认哪个 cookie |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 拼多多 | `mms.pinduoduo.com/login` | 商家后台 / 商品列表 | `PASS_ID` / `SUB_PASS_ID` |
| 淘宝 | `loginmyseller.taobao.com`（千牛） | 千牛工作台 `qn.taobao.com/home.htm` | `unb` / `sgcookie`（必须命中其一） |
| 天猫 | `loginmyseller.taobao.com`（千牛） | 天猫商家中心 `myseller.taobao.com/home.htm` | 同淘宝（同一套账号体系） |
| 抖音 | 抖店 `fxg.jinritemai.com/login/common` | 抖店 `fxg.jinritemai.com/ffa/mshop/homepage/index` | `passport_assist_user` / `sessionid` / `sessionid_ss` / `passport_uid` |
| 京东 | 京麦 `passport.shop.jd.com/login/index.action` | 京麦 `jm.jd.com/index/index.html` | `pt_key` / `pt_pin` |
| 1688 | `login.1688.com/member/signin.htm` | 1688 卖家工作台 `work.1688.com/home/page/index.htm` | `_nk_` / `__cn_logon__=true` |

几个实测结论（2026-10-14，Chrome 154，无头 + 临时档案）：

- **天猫商家就是千牛**：`tmall.seller.taobao.com` 这个域名压根不存在，`sell.tmall.com` 报
  `error.taobao.com`（老后台已下线），`myseller.taobao.com/home.htm` 跳到 `loginmyseller.taobao.com`
  —— 和淘宝卖家同一套账号、同一套 cookie，所以判据完全一样，只是分组和工作台入口分开。
- **京东**：登录态在统一 SSO 的 `pt_key` / `pt_pin`；未登录的登录页上这两个都没有，
  但已经有 `sdtoken` / `JSESSIONID` / `3AB9D23F7A4B3C9B` / `__jda…`，所以这些一律不当判据。
- **1688**：未登录时 cookie 罐里就有 `cookie2` / `_tb_token_` / `t`，而且 **`__cn_logon__=false`**
  —— 名字在、值是 false，只看名字会误判成已登录，所以这条额外走「值判据」（`identityCookieValues`）。
- **抖店**：未登录的登录页上就有 `passport_csrf_token`，原先把它当身份 cookie 会把"没登录"说成"已登录"，已移除。
- 各平台的**上架/发品页**（千牛发布商品、京麦商品管理、1688 发布产品…）等有真实账号登录后再钉准，**不猜地址**。

## 店铺详情页（行上最左边的「管理」）

点某一行的 **管理** 进入该店铺的详情页，字段与动作：

| 字段 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 平台 / 店铺名 | 只读；改名走详情页底部的「编辑店铺」 |
| 店铺 URL | 选填。**填了就作为「打开」时的工作台地址**（覆盖平台默认工作台）——上架要用哪个页面就记在这儿 |
| 账号 | 登录账号名（例如 `韩品兰坊;阿荣`），备注性质 |
| 账号类型 | 商家账号 / 个人账号 / 不填 |
| 登录状态 | 与列表一致，另附检测时间、端口、上次登录时间 |

底部：左下 **删除账号**（只删记录，档案目录保留），右下 **重新登录 / 去登录**；
该店铺正在「等待登录」时，右下换成 **完成并保存 / 取消登录**。
再下面一行是 **检测登录态 / 打开工作台（或关闭浏览器）/ 重扫（清档案）/ 复制档案路径 / 编辑店铺**。
左上角 **←** 返回列表。

## 登录态怎么判的（判据优先级）

1. **登录页最硬**：站点把你按回登录页 = 站点不认这个会话，哪怕 cookie 罐里还留着身份 cookie
   （服务端过期不会去清浏览器里的 cookie）也判未登录。
2. **身份 cookie**：域名对得上 + 名字命中该平台的身份 cookie（如拼多多 `PASS_ID`、京东 `pt_key`）+
   值不是占位符。匿名 cookie（`cna`、`_m_h5_tk`、`sdtoken` 这类）人人都有，**不算**登录凭证。
   个别平台还额外点明 `identityCookies`：真机实测空档案停在千牛登录页时 cookie 罐里已经有
   `cookie2` / `_tb_token_`，光数数量会把它当成已登录，所以淘宝/天猫要求必须命中 `unb` / `sgcookie`。
   1688 更特殊：`__cn_logon__` 在未登录时就存在、值是 `false`，所以用 `identityCookieValues`
   卡值 —— 只有 `=true` 才算数。
3. **URL 弱判据**：只有 CDP 读 cookie 失败时才退到它，且如实标成 `evidence: 'url'`，
   界面上和「确定」区分开。

这三条就是 `test/smoke.mjs` 里逐条钉住的契约 —— 判错登录态的代价是上架脚本跑到一半要求登录。

## 上架流程怎么接

````powershell
# 拼多多那条上架流程（dsh-plugin-pdd-product-listing / pdd-product-listing 技能）复用某个账号时，要对上两样：
#   · 调试端口   → 行上「调试端口」列显示的那个（对外就是 PDD_PORT）
#   · 浏览器档案 → 该账号的档案目录（行上「复制路径」复制到的就是它；
#                  给脚本用的时候是 open_browser.ps1 -Profile <档案目录>，或 config.json 里的 chrome_profile）
````

插件只负责**把登录态养在那里**；它不碰商品、不提交、不改价。

账号行已经显示「CDP 可用」时，说明这个店铺的浏览器正开着——上架脚本直接连这个端口就行，
**不要再另起一个 Chrome**（同一个档案目录被两个实例抢会报错，也不符合上架技能「复用已登录 profile」的要求）。

## 自检

````powershell
node test/smoke.mjs           # 32 项：平台判据 / 持久化（含运行期登记表）/ 宿主 HTTP 面 / 客户端 bundle 契约
node test/live-probe.mjs pdd  # 真机链路：临时档案里拉一个无头 Chrome，读一遍 cookie 再关掉
node test/live-probe.mjs all  # 六个平台都过一遍（建议一个一个跑，共用档案会串 cookie）
````

`smoke.mjs` 用 `DSH_SHOP_ACCOUNTS_DIR` 把数据目录指到临时目录，**不会碰真实账号**，也**不会启动任何浏览器**。

`live-probe.mjs` 会真的拉起一个**无头** Chrome（临时档案、不弹窗口、不碰店铺档案），验证
「启动 → 调试端口起来 → `Network.getAllCookies` 能读（HttpOnly 的唯一正路）→ `Browser.close` 正常关掉」这条链路；
带平台参数时还会用空档案打开该平台登录页，断言**不能**被误判成「已登录」。怀疑登录态判得不准时跑它。

## 安装

DSH 的插件是「profile 里的一个 npm 包 + 一行 bundle 登记」。两种装法：

**A. 从本目录直接装（开发时推荐）**

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <profile名> add file:D:\path\to\dsh-plugin-shop-accounts
```

**B. 手动装（GUI 里没有安装入口时）**

1. 把整个目录复制到 `%DSH_HOME%\profiles\<profile名>\node_modules\dsh-plugin-shop-accounts\`；
2. 在 `%DSH_HOME%\profiles\<profile名>\package.json` 里登记两处：
   - `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组里加一项 `"dsh-plugin-shop-accounts"`；
   - `dependencies` 里加 `"dsh-plugin-shop-accounts": "file:<本目录的绝对路径>"`；
3. **重启 DSH Desktop**。

> 插件是**启动时挂载**的：宿主半身（`lib/index.js`）改了必须重启；只改客户端半身（`lib/client.js`）
> 刷新页面即可，但要先把文件同步到 profile 的 `node_modules` 副本里。

装好之后「设置」里会出现 **账号管理** 一节。

## 目录结构

````
lib/platforms.mjs   六个平台的登录页/主页/工作页、身份 cookie、域判据
lib/cdp.mjs         极简 CDP 客户端（裸 WebSocket，无第三方依赖）
lib/chrome.mjs      找浏览器、选端口、拉起/关闭/探测，读写登录态
lib/store.mjs       accounts.json / config.json / runtime.json 的原子读写与降级
lib/index.js        宿主：webServer 路由 /shop-accounts/*、页面用到的全部动作
lib/client.js       客户端 bundle：设置页「账号管理」整页 UI
cordis.patch.yml    插件挂载点（id: shop-accounts）
test/smoke.mjs      自检（不启动浏览器）
test/live-probe.mjs 真机链路探针（会拉起一个无头 Chrome，临时档案）
````

## 本机验证记录（2026-10-14）

- `node test/smoke.mjs` → 32 项全过；`node test/live-probe.mjs <平台>` 六个平台各自单跑 → 全过。
- 真机链路：Chrome 154.0.8037.99，无头拉起 → `/json/version` 有响应 → 页面目标可见 →
  `Network.getAllCookies` 返回数组 → 关掉后端口释放。
- 六个平台的**空档案**登录页都判成未登录，没有误判：
  拼多多 `matched: []`、淘宝 `matched: ['cookie2','_tb_token_']`（要命中 2 个才算，故仍判未登录）、
  天猫 同淘宝、抖音 `matched: []`、京东 `matched: []`、1688 `matched: ['cookie2','t','_tb_token_']`
  （`__cn_logon__=false` 已被值判据挡掉）。
- 这条实测顺手改掉一个真 bug：抖店的 `passport_csrf_token` 在**未登录**的登录页上就有，
  原先把它当身份 cookie，会让「没登录」被说成「已登录」——已从判据里移除。
- 「已运行的店铺点去登录」真机回归：先在临时档案里拉一只无头 Chrome 当"已运行"，再打真实路由
  `POST /accounts/:id/open {mode:'login'}` → 返回 `reused:true`、端口不漂移、**已有浏览器里多出登录页标签页**、
  账号进入「等待登录」（会出「完成并保存」）。
- 端口归属判定不用 CDP 的 `Browser.getBrowserCommandLine`：实测它必须配合 `--enable-automation`
  才返回命令行（`Command line not returned because --enable-automation not set.`），而那个开关会设置
  `navigator.webdriver`、登录站点有可能识别 —— 改成"自己起的浏览器自己登记（`runtime.json`）+ 进程命令行查询兜底"。

## 已知边界

- **不代登录、不破验证码**：扫码/短信/滑块都由你在真实窗口里完成。
- 一个 profile 目录同一时间只能被一个 Chrome 实例占用（插件会先探测端口，不会硬起第二个）。
- 不做多账号并发抢端口：端口按店铺固定分配，冲突时报错而不是静默换端口。
- 只支持拼多多 / 淘宝 / 天猫 / 抖音 / 京东 / 1688 这六家（都是商家端）；加平台只需在
  `lib/platforms.mjs` 里补一条记录，再按「空档案登录页不误判」跑一遍 `node test/live-probe.mjs <新id>`。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex — native subagent progress, in-host worker sessions with per-tier presets, and a multimodal bridge that lends the text-only harness vision and image generation.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Crew

A DeepSeek Harness plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok, without giving up the host's native subagent UI.
Native Progress UI • Tier Policy & Escalation • Dispatch Guardrails • Jobs Board • In-Host DSH Sessions • Vision & Image Gen (Native-First) • One-Click Install

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-crew · Current plugin release: 0.1.0-rc.11 · Tested with DSH 0.1.1-rc.1

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The DSH Crew settings page — host integrations, dispatch policy, execution and the multimodal bridge

## Why DSH Crew DSH Crew is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) — an open-source agent harness. It makes DSH agents dispatchable from Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Grok: the orchestrator keeps its own model, the work runs on a real DSH agent with that harness's tools, sandbox, presets and session history, and the host still shows it as a native subagent with live progress. What runs the work is a DSH agent, not a bare model call. Tiers (`flash` / `pro`) select how much capability that agent gets from the harness's configured roster — DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Pro today — so a change of model in DSH needs no change here.
### 🧵 Native Progress UI Workers appear as regular subagents in Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok — dispatch count, running step, tool calls and token usage all show up in the host's own task panel, plus a claude-hud statusline segment: `⚙dsh 1▶pro 2m14s 21.7k/606 ✓3`. ### 🎚️ Tier Policy and Escalation `flash` for mechanical work, `pro` for reasoning, `effort` from `off` to `max`. `tier_policy` can clamp every dispatch to one tier at the tool layer, and `escalate_on_failure` retries a failed flash run once on pro — based on evidence, not on guessing difficulty up front.
### 🏛️ In-Host DSH Sessions With the bundle installed in a DSH profile, each worker is a first-class DSH session: visible in the Web UI, grouped by working directory, mounted with the Agent preset you choose per tier. Without DSH running, dispatch falls back to a standalone DSH runtime, so CI and headless environments still work. ### 👁️ Vision and Image Generation DSH's models are text-only. `describe_image` now prefers DeepSeek's own VL model (`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`) whenever a key is available, then falls back to the CLIs you already have — Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity — or any OpenAI-compatible API you configure. `generate_image` borrows the same CLIs' brush. Pasted images stay visible in the conversation and reach the model as text.
### 🛡️ Dispatch Guardrails Every dispatch is checked before anything spawns. Worker→worker nesting is capped at origin-chain depth 3 and cycles are refused; a second worker on a workspace another job already holds is refused with the holder's info — never silently queued. Refusals are readable errors: wait or re-scope, don't bypass. ### 📋 Jobs Board The DSH Crew panel doubles as a jobs board: every worker job — running or finished — is listed with tier, effort, live progress and tokens, held workspaces show their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (e.g. a hub restart) is surfaced as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.
### 🔌 Custom Providers Bring your own endpoint (Base URL + API key + models) or a local command template. Each provider has a connectivity test that checks reachability and auth, then makes one real vision call so you find out now, not mid-task. ### 📦 One-Click Install The settings page installs and updates the Claude Code plugin, the Codex role files and the Antigravity / Grok agents, skills and commands for you — marketplace registration, permission allowlist, HUD wiring, absolute paths rendered for this machine — and restores them just as easily. Every settings file is backed up first.
## How it works ``` Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok (orchestrator, keeps its own model) └─ ds-flash / ds-pro ← native subagent shell (progress shows in the host's task UI) └─ MCP: dsh_run_worker(tier, effort, cwd, worker=) ├─ worker="agy"/"grok" → that external CLI runs the task (explicit opt-in) ├─ hub reachable → session inside DSH (visible in the Web UI, grouped by cwd) └─ otherwise → dsh-jsonrpc-agent runtime (worker.cordis.yml) └─ DeepSeek V4 Flash / Pro (DSH SDK, event stream → progress and token stats) ``` ## One run, two views Dispatch fans out. Below, eighteen workers translate this README in parallel: the host counts them as its own subagents, while the harness runs them as real sessions.

Claude Code sees dsh-crew workers as native subagents, with a statusline segment tracking running tiers, elapsed time and tokens.

The DSH Crew panel sees the same run from the harness side: which host dispatched each job, its tier and effort, live progress and token usage.

The panel is also the jobs board: running and finished jobs stay listed with tier, progress and tokens, held workspaces name their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (a hub restart) surfaces as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.

## Install Install into a DSH profile from npm: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-crew@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-crew dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately. ### Configure DeepSeek credentials (standalone only) In hub mode — the installation above — workers run inside the DSH instance and use the DeepSeek credentials it is already configured with. Nothing else to set up. Only the standalone fallback needs a key of its own: dispatching from a host with no DSH instance running launches a worker runtime as a separate process. Obtain an API key from [platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com) and write it to `~/.config/dsh-crew/.env`: ``` DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-... ``` ### Verify ```bash node scripts/smoke.mjs ``` The smoke test dispatches one cheap job through whichever path is available — the hub when a DSH instance is running, s

plugins.description: DSH 记忆提炼插件：把长对话提炼成你逐条点头才写入的长期记忆 · DSH plugin that distills conversations into memory you approve item by item.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-memory-refine

**简体中文 | [English](README.en.md)**

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的「记忆提炼」插件：把一场长对话提炼成候选条目，你逐条点头，再写进长期记忆文件 —— 面板里能直接看、直接改、直接删。

> 这不是商业产品，是我自己用出来的东西 —— 你要想要，拿去。（MIT）
> 它所有的判断都建立在一个前提上：长期记忆是你亲手确认过的东西，不是模型自己攒的。

![记忆提炼面板](docs/panel.png)

---

## 它解决什么

- 会话日志越滚越长（一场下来几百条事件），真正的长期记忆却只有几份 `.md`；
- 手工翻记录提炼，容易漏，更容易把**引擎注入的提示词**当成「他说的话」；
- 直接改记忆文件没有安全网：写坏了没法退，两个人（人 + 模型）同时改会互相覆盖。

---

## 安装

前提：DSH 有 profile 机制（Desktop 版或带 profile 的 CLI）。

1. 把本目录放到任意位置（示例：`D:/plugins/dsh-memory-refine`）。**下面 `link:` 后面的路径要换成你自己放的位置。**

2. 在 profile 的 `package.json` 里加一条软链依赖：

   ```json
   {
     "dependencies": {
       "dsh-memory-refine": "link:D:/plugins/dsh-memory-refine"
     }
   }
   ```

3. 同一个文件的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组里加上它：

   ```json
   { "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["dsh-memory-refine"] } } }
   ```

4. **重启整个 DSH 进程**。

> ⚠️ **改代码之后必须重启整个 DSH**。ESM 模块缓存按 URL 命中，在插件管理器里开关插件**不会**重新 import 新代码 —— 你会以为改了没生效。

装好后侧边栏会出现「记忆提炼」图标。

---

## 第一次用（面板是空的？）

新装的 DSH 通常**没有** `memory/` 目录，所以第一次打开面板时左栏可能是空的 —— 不是坏了。

不用手动建目录，两条路都能起第一份记忆：

1. **让模型建**：跟它说「帮我在 `memory/` 下建一份 `示例主题.md`，先写一行占位」。`memory_write` 会自动创建 `memory/` 目录和文件。
2. **自己建**：在 `DSH_HOME/memory/` 下新建 `.md` 文件，再点面板「刷新」。

`DSH_HOME` 在 Windows 上一般是 `C:\Users\<你的用户名>\.dsh`。

> `AGENTS.md` 是 DSH 的每轮注入层，不是插件建的。没有它插件照常工作，只是左栏少一项。

---

## 写记忆的几条规矩

插件只负责「安全地写」，**写什么**还是得靠人把握。三条踩过的坑：

1. **一条记忆一个 `<!--@refine-->` 块**。一个块里塞两件事，将来想单独改或删其中一条就扯不开了。
2. **主语写清楚**。别只写「名字，某某」—— 是给助手起名，还是说你自己叫这个？模型会宁可问你，也不乱猜（它会说：猜错了会被当成事实一直带着）。
3. **写完让它复述一遍**。「你读到的这条是什么意思，归谁？」比猜它懂没懂稳得多。

---

## 五个工具

插件注册五个模型可调用的工具，全部只碰白名单内的文件。

| 工具 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `memory_list` | 列出受管文件：注入层 `AGENTS.md`、索引、常记、存档，带版本哈希与行数 |
| `memory_read` | 读一份受管文件（分页），附带层级、版本、总行数 |
| `memory_gather` | 把一场会话取成提炼素材，markdown 落盘，返回预览与统计 |
| `memory_write` | 写入受管文件。**必须用户点头**才会落盘 |
| `memory_import` | 把外部内容导入某个记忆文件（新起章节 / 追加） |

### `memory_gather` 的参数

| 参数 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `session_id` | 当前会话 | 要提炼哪一场 |
| `mode` | `incremental` | `incremental` 只取水印之后的新轮次；`full` 取全程 |
| `boundary_seq` | 自动派生 | 手动指定边界（调试用） |
| `max_reasoning` | `0` | 每段保留多少推理字符，0 = 整段砍掉只留一行占位 |
| `out_dir` | 会话工作区下 `memory-refine-scratch/` | 素材落点 |

素材默认落在**会话自己的工作区**，不会往 DSH 的配置目录里堆。

---

## 面板

左侧「记忆提炼」图标 → 主面板。

- **左栏**：受管文件列表。存档默认折叠（`显示存档 (N)`），点一次展开。
- **右栏**：选中文件的正文，可以直接改。改完按「保存」。
- **顶栏**：
  - `刷新`：作废缓存，重新读磁盘。
  - `清理素材…`：删掉本会话工作区下 `memory-refine-scratch/` 里的素材文件（`material-*.md` / `tools-*.md`）。会先问一次，只认这两个前缀，不递归子目录。
- **写入后**：上方会留一条 `这版没问题，删掉备份` —— 你按下它，这次改动留下的那份备份才会被删掉。不按就留着。
- **重新读取**：选中一个文件，按「重新读取」→ 从磁盘再读一次。**保存时如果报「在你看过之后被改动过」，就用它** —— 多半是模型或另一个窗口刚写过这个文件。有没保存的改动时会先问你一句。
- **删除文件**：选中一个文件，按「删除…」→ 确认。会先整份备份到 `memory-refine-backups/` 再删。
- **导入…**：填目标文件 + 章节标题，然后在下面那个大框里放内容。大框两种填法都认：
  - **贴正文** —— 直接把要导入的文字粘进去；
  - **填绝对路径** —— 只写一个文件的完整路径（如 `D:\旧笔记.md`），它会自己去读那个文件。省得把几万字粘进来。
    判定收得很紧：**单行、长度 ≤ 4096、且是绝对路径、且文件确实存在**，四条全中才当路径；否则一律当正文。所以正文里恰好写了路径不会被误读。相对路径**不认**（Host 里没有确定的基准目录，猜错了会读到别的文件）。

> 注入层 `AGENTS.md` 在面板里**不可删除**，只能改。

---

## 安全设计

写入永远走同一条路（`index.js` 里的 `confirmAndWrite`）：

1. **版本哈希预检** —— 你手上这份的版本和磁盘上的对不上，直接中止，一个字节都不写；
2. **整份备份** —— 先落一份到 `DSH_HOME/memory-refine-backups/`；
3. **写后读回核验** —— 写完立刻读回来逐字比对，不一致就报失败。

一次成功的写入长这样（版本、行数变化、核验结果、备份路径都在一条里）：

![一次成功的写入：版本哈希、行数变化、读回核验、备份位置](docs/write-result.png)

另外：

- **写入必须用户点头**。拿不到问答服务时直接拒绝，**不静默降级**成「自动同意」。
- **白名单**：只认 `DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md` 与 `DSH_HOME/memory/**/*.md`。`..` 越界、盘外路径一律拒绝。
- **斜杠命令载荷不记录**：命令注册时 `recordInput: false`，会话日志里不会重复存一份完整输入 JSON。命令通道现在只是兜底，正常不走它（见下一节）。

---

## 面板怎么跟后台通信

面板跑在浏览器里，Host 跑在另一个进程 —— 中间没有私有的插件 RPC 通道（DSH 的能力集合在构建时固定，第三方插件加不进去）。

所以插件在 Host 半边挂了一条自己的 HTTP 路由：

```
POST /memory-refine/ui          ← 面板的每一次操作都走这里
  请求 { action, sessionId, ... }
  响应 { ok: true, data } 或 { ok: false, error }
```

这条路由：

- 只接受**本机、且通过 `connection.requestRejection` 信任校验**的请求（不自己造 token）；
- 四道闸：只认 `POST`；只认 `content-type: application/json`；请求体 8 MB 上限；鉴权不过直接 401/403；
- 把 `sessionId` 翻译成 agent 后交给**同一套** `handleUiRequest` —— 白名单、版本预检、备份、读回核验，和工具那条路走的是同一份代码。

**为什么需要它**：斜杠命令（`ctx.remote.commands.execute`）是第三方插件唯一能调到 Host 的方式，但它**按设计会往会话日志里写一对 `command/run` / `command/done`**，在对话视图里显示成一条 `memory-refine · {...}` 记录。走 HTTP 路由不进命令总线，就没有这条记录。

**兜底**：要是路由没注册上（老版本 DSH 没有 `webServer`），或者请求被拦，面板会自动回退到斜杠命令，并在顶部挂一条红色警告 —— 不会悄悄留痕。

---

## 会话取料是怎么做的

直接读 DSH 的会话事件流（`sessionQuery.readSession`），不碰磁盘上的 `session.v4.jsonl.zstd` —— 不用自己解多帧 zstd。

丢弃的东西：

- `<system-reminder>` 整块（AGENTS.md 变更通知就是这么进来的，**最容易被当成「他说的」**）；
- 裸运行时快照（`Current runtime context.` 之后的全部）；
- `request/header` 里的提示词清单；
- 推理正文（只留一行 `<!-- 推理已省略：本段 N 处共 X 字 -->`）。

### 水印：零外部状态

每次取料会在素材首行写：

```
<!--memory-refine:watermark session=<id> seq=<n> time=<t> turns=<k>-->
```

下次取料时，`deriveWatermark()` 扫一遍会话日志里的 `tool/result`，找上一次 `memory_gather` 留下的那行，取出 `seq` 当边界。

**好处**：不需要任何外部状态文件，不会像 `handledIds` 那样无限膨胀，天然按会话隔离。边界落在**轮**上（`user.seq > boundarySeq`），所以不会切在某一轮中间。

---

## 目录结构

```
memory-refine/
├── index.js         Host 半边：skill + 5 个工具 + 界面命令桥
├── client.js        浏览器半边：侧边栏图标 + 主面板
├── gather.js        纯函数：会话事件流 → 提炼素材（无 cordis 依赖，可单独测）
├── memory.js        受管文件访问层：白名单 + 版本哈希 + 备份 + 读回核验
├── protocol.js      提炼协议全文（作为 skill 注入）
├── test/smoke.mjs   离线冒烟测试：假 ctx + 沙盒 DSH_HOME
├── cordis.patch.yml 告诉 DSH 装哪一行
└── package.json
```

`gather.js` 刻意做成纯函数：输入事件数组，输出文本，不碰磁盘。这样可以拿导出的会话日志在沙盒里反复重放，不用重启 DSH。

---

## 测试

```
node test/smoke.mjs
```

不需要启动 DSH，也不会碰你的记忆文件 —— 它用假 `ctx` 加载 Host 半边，把 `DSH_HOME` 指到系统临时目录下的沙盒，跑完即删。

20 条断言，重点不在「功能能跑」，而在**手动点不出来的那些分支**：

- 四道闸：只认 `POST`（405）、只认已知子路径（404）、只认 JSON（415）、鉴权拒绝原样透传（403）
- 白名单越界被拒（`../../etc/passwd`）
- 写入：读回核验通过、备份文件真的生成了
- **版本不符时中止**（`deadbeefdeadbeef` → 一个字节不写）
- 导入的章节间距、删除的备份命名与「确实没了」的核验

这些分支在真实环境里要一条条制造出来，每条都得重启一次 DSH；在断言里是三行。

---

## 卸载

1. 从 profile 的 `package.json` 里去掉 `dsh-memory-refine` 依赖；
2. 从 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组里去掉 `"dsh-memory-refine"`；
3. **重启 DSH**；
4. 可选清理：
   - `DSH_HOME/memory-refine-backups/` —— 写入前的备份（留着也许有用）；
   - 会话工作区下的 `memory-refine-scratch/` —— 取出来的素材（可以直接删）。

卸载**不会**动 `AGENTS.md` 和 `memory/` 里的任何东西。

---

## 已知限制

- **命令通道是兜底，不是主路。** 面板默认走插件自己的本地 HTTP 路由（`POST /memory-refine/ui`），**不经过命令总线**，所以正常使用时对话视图里不会出现 `memory-refine · {...}` 记录。只有在路由不可用时才回退到 `/memory-refine` 斜杠命令，留下一对 `command/run` / `command/done` —— 这时面板顶部会挂一条红色警告，告诉你发生了降级。这组事件**不进模型历史、不烧 token、不污染取料素材**。
- 面板在「一个会话都没打开过」时无法确定会话 id，会提示先打开一个会话。
- 只在 **Windows** 上验证过。

plugins.description: dsh-cn-ai-labeling · DSH 插件
plugins.readme_text:
# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-cn-ai-labeling

[![Listed on DSH Plugin Hub](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/zh/plugins/feely0208/dsh-cn-ai-labeling)

**AI 生成合成内容标识合规自检** —— 给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 用的 skill 插件。

面向中国大陆市场的 AI 产品，在**设计和发版前**逐条核对生成合成内容标识是否落实。规则来自官方原文，不凭记忆。

## 它能扫出什么（5 条规则）

技能负责「怎么做」，规则引擎负责「有没有做」。同一条命令出证据：

```bash
dsh-ai-labeling --root <项目路径>      # 扫一遍
dsh-ai-labeling --demo                # 看内置演示样本
dsh-ai-labeling --list-rules          # 列出规则与依据
```

| 规则 | 查什么 | 级别 |
|---|---|---|
| `AILABEL-NO-DISCLOSURE` | 生成结果直接回给用户的文件里，没有任何「AI 生成」显式标识 | 高 |
| `AILABEL-MISSING-TEXT` | 全项目找不到一句「AI 生成 / 由 AI 生成 / AI-generated」标识文案 | 高 |
| `AILABEL-NO-REVIEW` | 面向用户输出缺「人工核验 / 仅供参考」提示 | 中 |
| `AILABEL-NO-IMPLICIT-META` | 生成产出文件缺 `generated_by` / `ai_generated` 等隐式标识元数据 | 中 |
| `AILABEL-VAGUE-GENERATED` | 文案写「自动生成 / 系统生成」但无 AI 字样 | 低 |

**每条规则都带 `when` 守卫** —— 不用 AI 的项目上，5 条规则记为「不适用」而不是「通过」，
报告会明写「N 条因不适用本项目未运行」。这一条是防假绿：**不适用 ≠ 没问题。**

**边界**：只做静态检查，报出来是提示确认，不是判定违规；图片/音视频里的隐式标识（数字水印）看不见。

## 依据

| 文件 | 性质 | 施行 | 引用条款 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 《互联网信息服务深度合成管理规定》（第 12 号令） | 部门规章 | 2023-01-10 | 第十六条、第十七条、第十八条 |
| 《人工智能生成合成内容标识办法》（国信办通字〔2025〕2 号） | 规范性文件 | 2025-09-01 | 第三～十二条 |
| **GB 45438—2025**《网络安全技术 人工智能生成合成内容标识方法》 | **强制性国标** | 2025-09-01 | 第 5、6 章；**附录 E（规范性）** |

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-cn-ai-labeling
```

然后重启 dsh。技能会在 agent 需要时自动可用。

## 它帮你回答的问题

- 我这个产品**是不是**义务主体？纯工具方要不要负责？
- 哪些功能**必须**加显式标识，哪些**不必**？
- 文件元数据里的 AIGC 到底该写成什么格式？
- 导出的 Word / 图片里，标识该怎么带？
- 上架应用市场会被问什么？
- **哪些常见的"合规要求"其实是我多虑了？**

## 三个不显然但很关键的判断

**1. 隐式标识的义务面比显式标识宽。**
隐式标识挂在《深度合成规定》第十六条（对使用其服务生成或编辑的信息内容普遍适用）；
显式标识挂在第十七条第一款（仅限可能导致公众混淆或误认的 5 类服务）。
只做图片生成的产品，显式标识要看场景判定，**隐式标识从第十六条起就适用**。

**2. 义务主体是「服务提供者」，不是产品形态。**
纯客户端 / 纯工具（用户自部署、自配模型）不是义务主体 —— 不能给它扣「未标识」的帽子。
但它的**导出链路**是用户唯一无法自行补齐标识的地方，所以仍应提供标识能力。
另外，「通过提供可编程接口等方式」被 GB 45438 3.7 明确写入定义，**套壳调第三方 API 不豁免**。

**3. 详尽但不误伤。**
GB 45438 附录 A/B/C/D/F **都是资料性**（推荐与示例），**只有附录 E 是规范性**。
数字水印是「准许采用」，附录 A.2 明确写「在本文件中不做要求」。
5% 字高只适用于图片 / 视频 / 虚拟场景，文本、音频、交互界面**没有**字号要求。
插件专设一节列出这些边界 —— 误报多了，人就再也不看报告了。

## 覆盖的检查面

| 组 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| **第 0 步** | 义务主体判定（自建服务 / 工具 / 端上模型） |
| **A. 显式标识** | 文本、图片、音频、视频、虚拟场景、交互场景界面 + 下载/复制/导出链路 |
| **B. 隐式标识** | 五要素齐备、附录 E 格式、Label 取值、字符集、一文件一份 |
| **C. 协议与流程** | 用户服务协议、无标识版本与日志留存、禁止删除篡改 |
| **D. 分发与备案** | 应用市场上架问询、算法备案与安全评估材料 |
| **E. 防误伤** | 明确列出不构成强制要求的项及依据 |

## 取证脚本

插件随包分发 `labeling-check.sh`，技能正文里会给出它的**绝对路径**。

```bash
# 扫代码库，收集标识实现的证据与缺口
bash <labeling-check.sh 路径> --code --dir .

# 校验一个真实产出文件的元数据（导出物 / 图片 / 文档）
bash <labeling-check.sh 路径> --meta ./导出样例.docx
bash <labeling-check.sh 路径> --meta ./生成图.png

# 一起跑
bash <labeling-check.sh 路径> --all --dir .
```

**退出码**：`0` = 未发现问题；`1` = 有发现 —— 可直接用在 CI / 发版前卡口。

脚本只做**取证**：报告"找到了什么、缺什么"，是否违规由人判断。`--meta` 会真实解析文件里的 AIGC JSON，校验 7 个要素、`Label` 取值、字符串类型与字符集。

## 设计取舍

**不内置任何形式的"合规结论库"。** 标识规则会随监管更新，插件里固化的判断迟早过期。所有条款号与数值只来自上表官方来源，并在技能正文里附来源链接。

**不联网。** 只扫本地代码与被指定的文件，不把待审内容发往任何第三方服务。

**只读，不改。** 插件不会修改被扫描的项目。

## 与其它插件的关系

与 [`@deepwhale-cn/dsh-cn-compliance`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepwhale-cn/dsh-cn-compliance) 互补：

- `dsh-cn-compliance` —— 发布前扫**对外文案**（广告法极限词、网络工具红线、备案展示）
- `dsh-cn-ai-labeling` —— 开发时查**产品实现**（标识有没有写进代码与导出物）

按 [DSH 插件生态倡议书](https://github.com/anywhere-labs/dsh-desktop/blob/main/docs/plugin-ecosystem.md) 的三条原则开发：**组合优先、声明清晰、兼容优先**。

## 许可

MIT

---

> 本插件是工程辅助工具，不构成法律意见。条款以官方最新文本为准。

---

## 深鲸网安守护系列（共 31 个）

> 一个插件做一件事。**安全问题是链式的** —— 配套用才完整。

**国内合规** ｜ [等保对照](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-mlps) · [日志留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-log-retention) · [备案公示](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-filing) · [用户同意](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-consent-guard) · [个人信息权利](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-rights) · [未成年人保护](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-minor-guard) · [影响评估](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-pipia) · [数据分类分级](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-classify) · [算法备案](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-algorithm-filing) · [数据出境](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-data-export) · [国密合规](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-crypto) · [**AI 内容标识**](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-ai-labeling)

**AI 与 Agent 治理** ｜ [AI 输出信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ai-output-trust) · [外部内容信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-content-trust) · [MCP 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-mcp-audit) · [Agent 权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-scope) · [策略核对](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-policy) · [可疑指令](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-phishing-guard)

**数据与凭据** ｜ [敏感数据](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-scan) · [密钥轮换](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-key-rotate) · [数据留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-lifecycle) · [配置审计](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-env-audit) · [密钥扫描](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-secret-scan)

**供应链与构建** ｜ [开源许可](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-license-guard) · [依赖投毒](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-dep-audit) · [CI 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ci-guard) · [工具审查](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-tool-vet) · [物料清单](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-sbom)

**权限与应急** ｜ [最小权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-least-privilege) · [告警外发](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-alert-relay) · [应急证据包](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-incident-package)

plugins.description: TypeSafe Jev for DeepSeek Harness, the Model Context Protocol, and plain Node: typed judgments instead of prose, offline by default.
plugins.readme_text:
# jevcore
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/jevcore?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/jevcore?ref=badge)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore)
[![jevcore MCP server](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore)

TypeSafe [Jev](https://typesafe.ai) for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
and any other MCP host.

Jev is not a chat model. It answers typed questions — `noul` (yes/no), `choice`, `score` — and returns
calibrated probabilities. It does not write prose, and asking it to is a category error. This project
gives an agent exactly that surface, and nothing more.

**Offline by default. Egress disclosed. Nothing default-on.**

---

**📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/).

<!-- star-cta -->
## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你

这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。

*English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it.


## Three packages, one decision layer

| Package | What it is | Use it when |
|---|---|---|
| [`jevcore`](packages/core) | The decisions. Imports nothing from DeepSeek Harness or Cordis. | You want Jev in a plain script, a service, or your own harness |
| [`jevcore-dsh`](packages/dsh) | The DSH plugin: one service, three tools, two opt-in gates | You are running DeepSeek Harness |
| [`jevcore-mcp`](packages/mcp) | The same three tools over MCP, with a stdio binary | Your host speaks MCP but is not DSH |

The adapters are thin on purpose. `packages/dsh` is four files: it declares tool schemas and
translates hook payloads. Everything decision-shaped — the primitives, the providers, the egress
contract, the policy, the gates — lives in core, so a new adapter cannot drift from the guarantees
the others make.
One runtime requirement differs across the three: `jevcore-dsh` tracks the harness and needs
Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, while `jevcore` and `jevcore-mcp` need `>=20`.

---

## Why this exists

Between 2026-09-17 and 09-20, nineteen plugins appeared that wire Jev into DSH. Auditing their source
found a consistent pattern: the module labelled *guard*, *gate*, or *warden* was also the module
shipping prompts, tool arguments, and file contents to a third party, and the README generally did not
say so. Several were enabled by default. One gate could be reconfigured by the model it was guarding.

This project is the same idea with those failure modes designed out:

| Property | How it is guaranteed here |
|---|---|
| No network call unless you ask for one | Default provider is an offline mock; the live path needs both `provider: live` and a resolved credential |
| Every transmission named before it happens | One startup log line per feature: `off` or `SENDS <feature> { fields }` |
| Gates register nothing when disabled | Verified by test, not by policy — a disabled gate adds no event listener at all |
| The model cannot widen its own constraints | No tool exposes gate configuration |
| A judge that cannot answer never means "allow" | Undecided resolves through explicit config, defaulting to `ask` |

---

## The egress contract

This is the part worth reading before installing.

Transmission is decided per feature, and every feature defaults to off. The plugin prints its own
contract at load:

```
[jevcore] provider=mock  endpoint=none  egress=OFF  (no network calls will be made; every answer is synthetic)
[jevcore] ready - provider=mock - gates: safety=off context=off
```

With `provider: live` and every feature enabled, the same report becomes explicit about what leaves:

```
[jevcore] provider=live  endpoint=https://api.typesafe.ai  egress=ON
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_ask  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_rank  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_check  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:safety  { state<=8000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:context  { state<=6000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   redaction is best-effort; it removes named fields and known secret shapes, and cannot
             recognise an unrecognised secret in free text
```

| Feature | Off by default? | What it sends |
|---|---|---|
| `tool:jev_ask` | runs when the model calls it | the arguments the model passed, after redaction |
| `tool:jev_rank` | runs when the model calls it | the query plus every candidate |
| `tool:jev_check` | runs when the model calls it | the claim and its evidence |
| `gate:safety` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | the tool name, its arguments, the workspace root |
| `gate:context` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | a large tool result the agent just received |

The tools transmit only when the model chooses to call them, which is visible in the transcript. The
gates would run on every matching tool call, which is not, so they are opt-in.

### Redaction, and its honest limit

Before anything is sent, `src/redact.ts` runs two passes: values under sensitive field names
(`password`, `token`, `apiKey`, `authorization`, …) are replaced wholesale, and secret-shaped strings
that survive into free text are pattern-matched (`Bearer …`, `sk-…`, `ts_live_…`, AWS/GitHub/Google
key shapes, JWTs, private-key headers, credentials in connection strings).

This is a mitigation, not a permission. A secret that sits under an unrecognised key name *and* does
not match a known shape will pass through. If that possibility is unacceptable for your workload, do
not enable the live provider.

---

## Install

### As a DeepSeek Harness plugin

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add jevcore-dsh
```

Or from a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/dsh
```

`packages/dsh` imports `jevcore` by name, so a checkout also needs core
resolvable from the profile (`add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/core`).

Then confirm the row activated — the plugin list should show `jev` as `active`,
not `failed` — and check the startup report in the log.

### As an MCP server

For a host that speaks MCP, the same three tools are available over stdio:

```sh
npx -y jevcore-mcp
```

To wire it into DeepSeek Harness specifically, install a configuration-only bundle
whose patch inserts the harness's own MCP client:

```yml
- insert:
    - id: jev-mcp
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: jev
        transport: stdio
        command: npx
        args: ['-y', 'jevcore-mcp']
        env:
          TYPESAFE_API_KEY: '<the key>'
        failOnStartupError: true
```

The env map is not optional: DSH strips every credential-shaped name — anything
containing KEY, PASSWORD, SECRET or TOKEN, in any case — from the environment it
hands a spawned server, then merges this map back in afterwards. A key exported in
your shell never arrives, and the server stays on the offline mock without
reporting an error.

The provider is chosen from the environment:

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` | Selects the TypeSafe route when present |
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | Selects the OpenRouter route when present and no TypeSafe key is set |
| `JEV_PROVIDER` | `mock`, `live`, or `openrouter` — overrides the heuristic above |
| `TYPESAFE_MODEL` / `OPENROUTER_MODEL` | Model id for the selected route |
| `TYPESAFE_BASE_URL` / `OPENROUTER_BASE_URL` | API root for the selected route |

With neither key it stays on the offline mock. Unlike the plugin, the MCP server
resolves its credential once at startup, so a missing key with
`JEV_PROVIDER=live` is a startup error rather than a per-call surprise.

Its egress report goe

plugins.description: 让 Qoder CN 的免费模型（Qwen3.8-Flash 等）当 DSH 的子代理：逐次选模型、逐次传权限、零提示词注入、全程留痕。
plugins.readme_text:
# @local/dsh-qoder-subagent

把 **Qoder CN 自带的 CLI**（`qoderclicn`，藏在 `resources\app.asar.unpacked\node_modules\@qoder-ai\qoder-cn-agent-sdk\dist\_worker\` 里）
当成 DSH 的**免费子代理**用。默认模型 `Qwen3.8-Flash`（实测 `billable: false`、`credits: 0`、`usd: 0`）。

## 工具

| 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `freesub_run` | 派一个子代理。`wait_ms=0` 立刻返回句柄；**结束后自动注入完成通知**；`wait_ms>0` 同步等结果 |
| `freesub_result` | 取结果（取回后该条通知自动消失） |
| `freesub_send` | 复用会话上下文继续说一句（Qoder 侧 `--resume <session-id>`） |
| `freesub_list` | 谁在跑、谁跑完了、`pending_notifications` 有几条未取回 |
| `freesub_interrupt` | 掐掉（杀进程树），被掐同样产生通知 |
| `freesub_models` | 免费模型表 + 实际发现到的 Qoder 路径 |

设计约束：**逐次选模型**（`model` 是调用参数）、**逐次传权限**（`permission: readonly / edit / full`）、
**零提示词注入**（发出去的就是 `task` 原文，另存 `runs/<id>/prompt.txt` 可逐字核对）、**逐 run 留痕**。

## 运行留痕（`runs/<agent_id>/`）

| 文件 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `prompt.txt` | 实际发出的原文 |
| `events.jsonl` | Qoder 的原始事件流；**结束时若无 `result` 事件，插件会补写一条 `synthesized: true` 的终止记录** |
| `stderr.log` | 子进程 stderr（失败排查用） |
| `meta.json` | 终态、`stage`、`errorStage`、`cwd`/`cwdRequested`、`eventCount`、`lastEventAt`、`collected`、`noticeCount`、`discovery` 等 |

## v0.2.0 修的四条（对应 2026-10-16 两份报障单）

1. **完成即注入**：注册 `systemPrompt.context({ name: 'freesub-completions' })`，每次组装提示词时把
   "已结束但未取回"的子代理报给**发起它的那个会话**（`scope.id` 对 `owner`）。同一会话最多重复注入 5 次；
   `freesub_result` 取回后立即停止。→ 不再需要人肉轮询。
2. **失败也注入**：`discovery` / `spawn` / `child-exit` / `timeout` / `killed` 全部算终态，同样进通知。
3. **cwd 不存在不再谎报 ENOENT**：`spawn` 前校验 `cwd` 与可执行文件，错误里带
   `stage` / `code` / `path` / `spawnargs` / 实际 `cwd`；返回体带 `startup_failed: true` 与 `detail`。
   （根因：`child_process.spawn` 在 `cwd` 不存在时抛的就是 `spawn <cmd> ENOENT`，看起来像程序缺失。）
4. **事件流必有收尾 + meta 可判活**：见上表。

### 离线验收（不经过宿主，可直接复跑）

装好后从一个会话里跑一条普通任务即可验收这三件事：正常任务返回 `status=done`；
`cwd` 不存在时返回 `status=error` 且 `error_stage=spawn`（不会谎报成 ENOENT）；
完成通知在取回之后从 `pending_notifications` 里消失。

## 生效方式（重要）

**改插件源码不会热重载**（base bundle 的 `hmr` 默认只监听配置，不监听模块；且宿主按目录缓存已加载的模块）。
所以本文件改动后需要**重启该实例**。重启后页面访问 token 会变，用新 token 重新打开页面。

## 已知问题

- **默认 `cwd` 是插件进程的工作目录**（通常是实例目录），不是会话工作区。需要特定目录时请显式传 `cwd`。
- **不要用 profile 补丁层覆盖运行中 bundle 的行配置**：实测在 `profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 里按 `id` 覆盖
  `dsh-compact` 这类**已安装 bundle** 的行不生效（组合产物 `cordis.yml` 里根本没有那一行）。
  本插件同理——目前没有可调配置，只有一个 `stateDir`/`maxConcurrent` 的 patch 默认值。
- Qoder 安装目录里存在多份 `Qoder CN.exe`（根目录 / `.qoder-versions\*`），存在版本漂移；
  `freesub_models` 会回报实际使用的那一份路径，报错时请以它为准。

## 版本

- `0.1.0`（`index-v010.js`，备份留档）：完成通知缺失、cwd 不存在谎报 ENOENT。
- `0.2.0`（`index-v020.js`，当前入口）：见上。

plugins.description: Runtime evidence that helps agents trace, profile, and burn down hotspots in application and native code, GPU kernels, and inference stacks.
plugins.readme_text:
flameox

Bounded local runtime evidence for coding agents.

Flameox coordinates profilers, benchmark tools, trace processors, and direct local targets. It turns an explicit artifact or command into bounded evidence while keeping durable preservation optional. The agent chooses hypotheses and experiments; Flameox records observed inputs, execution provenance, typed evidence, coverage, and limitations. There is no workspace to initialize or project configuration to maintain. Pass exact artifact paths to analysis and an explicit argv plus absolute working directory to capture. Flameox does not search parent directories, edit project files, or provide a hosted service. ## Quick start Configure an MCP client with the global setup command: ```console npx flameox@latest setup ``` Setup detects supported clients and asks which configurations to update. For automation, select clients explicitly, for example `--client codex --yes` or `--all --yes`; `--dry-run` reports the paths and actions without writing. Setup preserves unrelated client configuration and does not change project files. See [the npm package guide](npm/README.md) for details. Update existing MCP registrations with: ```console npx flameox@latest update ``` `update --check` reports available updates without changing configuration. Updates preserve each client's provider extras and settings, verify the new environment before changing release pins, and report which clients need a restart or reconnect. Use `--client codex` to select one client, or `--version 0.2.8` to select a specific release, including for rollback. The Python CLI exposes the same `flameox update` command. For direct CLI use, pass exact artifact paths or an explicit command: ```console uvx flameox analyze preview_artifact /absolute/path/to/artifact.json uvx flameox capture --provider direct --cwd "$PWD" -- python benchmark.py ``` To launch the stdio MCP server manually: ```console uvx flameox mcp serve ``` For local development, clone the repository, install its development dependencies, and inspect the available tools: ```console git clone https://github.com/morluto/flameox.git cd flameox uv sync --extra dev --extra memory --extra trace --extra cpu uv run flameox mcp inspect ``` ## Evidence and storage Analysis and unpreserved capture use bounded session scratch. Session `analysis_id` values expire when evicted or when the server stops. Explicit preservation creates the user-level Flameox data directory and stores native bytes and a canonical evidence bundle by SHA-256. Set `FLAMEOX_DATA_DIR` to choose another location. Preservation is optional; it does not imply full console-output retention. Flameox distinguishes observed, derived, and inferred claims. Profiles guide exploration but do not establish causality or performance improvement. Confirmatory claims require representative workloads, declared metrics and estimands, compatible identities, preserved samples, and a semantic oracle. ## MCP The MCP server has no workspace binding. It exposes named analysis and capture tools through the same operation registry as the CLI. Analysis tools accept explicit sources; capture tools accept a typed target and provider. Tool schemas expose operation-specific fields directly. Inspect the catalog with `flameox mcp inspect`; use `--tool TOOL_NAME` for focused schemas and examples. The complete contract and current tool catalog are in [the interface guide](docs/interfaces.md). Tools return their full bounded results inline, including failures and recovery actions. Preserved evidence has a durable `evidence_id`; `inspect_evidence` returns its redacted metadata and replay sources inline. Capture takes argv, not a shell string. A direct target supplies an absolute working directory and bounded environment overrides. Results may include `next_page`; replay its named analysis tool and arguments unchanged. Capture continuations read collected artifacts and do not rerun the target. MCP work belongs to the live request, so cancellation applies directly and no detached job survives a restart. ## Documentation - [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) describes process and package boundaries. - [Storage and evidence](docs/storage-and-evidence.md) defines preservation and provenance. - [Investigations](docs/investigations.md) covers experiments, comparison, and evidence quality. - [Adapters](docs/adapters.md) documents provider compatibility and integration policy. - [Runtime safety](docs/runtime-safety.md) covers limits, recovery, integrity, and privacy. - [Interfaces](docs/interfaces.md) defines CLI and MCP contracts. - [Testing](docs/testing.md) describes test selections and known proof gaps. ## Development Flameox requires Python 3.12 or newer and uses the committed `uv.lock`. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for development setup and contribution guidance. ```console uv run ruff check src tests tools uv run ruff format --check src tests tools uv run mypy src tests tools uv run pytest -q ``` Flameox is licensed under the MIT License.

plugins.description: Free, dependable web_search and web_fetch for DeepSeek Harness: fused keyless search plus optional Brave, SSRF-safe retrieval with reader escalation.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-reliable-web

Free, dependable `web_search` and `web_fetch` for DeepSeek Harness — no paid
search API, no required sign-up, no model-specific integration. It plugs into
the Harness web seam (`ctx.web`), so every model and every agent preset that can
call the shipped web tools gets free retrieval with the same tool schemas,
result cards, timeout policy, and error handling.

## Why this design

The Harness already owns the model-facing contract: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web`
defines the `web_search` / `web_fetch` tools, their argument validation, HTML→markdown
conversion, result presentation, and cancellation. This plugin deliberately does
**not** reimplement any of that. It registers two providers on the documented
extension point:

| Capability | Provider id | Registered with |
|---|---|---|
| search | `reliable` | `ctx.web.registerSearchProvider()` |
| fetch | `reliable` | `ctx.web.registerFetchProvider()` |

That choice is what keeps it working across Harness releases:

- no import of any `@deepseek-ai/*` package and no npm dependency, so a profile
  install works even when Harness internals are not resolvable;
- only the two documented seam methods, plus plain result objects matching the
  published shapes;
- provider errors use the documented open-string `code` vocabulary;
- `Config` is a Standard Schema (`~standard.validate`), which Cordis validates
  natively — no schema library to drift.

## Activation and provider selection

The shipped composition pins `web.searchProvider: deepseek-official` and
`web.fetchProvider: http`. A static patch that replaced those ids would leave a
dangling reference if this plugin is later disabled: every web call in the
profile would fail with `WEB_PROVIDER_CONFIGURED_MISSING`.

Instead, the plugin **claims the selection at runtime**, only while the field
still holds an id it is explicitly allowed to replace (`takeOverSearchIds` /
`takeOverFetchIds`), and restores the previous value when it unloads. An id set
by `$DSH_WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDER` / `$DSH_WEB_FETCH_PROVIDER`, or any third-party
pin, is left untouched with a log line. Disabling the plugin therefore degrades
to the official provider instead of breaking search.

`takeOver: false` turns this off; then set the `web` row's provider ids to
`reliable` yourself.

## Search

A query fans out across free backends in waves of `searchFanout` concurrent
requests. Every default engine works without an account; several also use a key
when present to raise their limits, and Brave joins the chain only when a key is
configured.

| Engine | Key | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `exa` | `EXA_API_KEY` optional | public Exa MCP tier; semantic index |
| `parallel` | `PARALLEL_API_KEY` optional | public Parallel search MCP tier |
| `brave` | `BRAVE_API_KEY` required | official API; free monthly credit (about 1,000 requests at list price) |
| `tavily` | `TAVILY_API_KEY` optional | keyless access mode |
| `keenable` | `KEENABLE_API_KEY` optional | public `/search/public` tier |
| `anysearch` | `ANYSEARCH_API_KEY` optional | keyless public endpoint |
| `firecrawl` | `FIRECRAWL_API_KEY` optional | keyless monthly credit allowance |
| `duckduckgo` | — | independent HTML index, last-resort coverage |
| `wikipedia` | — | encyclopedic last resort |

### Brave (optional)

Brave is the one engine that is keyed by design: it is a strong independent
index and its prepaid plan includes a **free monthly credit** (currently $5,
which is about 1,000 requests at the $5/1,000 list price; some older plans show
a fixed monthly query allowance instead). The plugin reads the key from, in
order:

1. `braveApiKey` in the row config;
2. `BRAVE_API_KEY` (or `BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY`) in the process environment;
3. `$DSH_HOME/secrets/brave.key`, then `~/.dsh/secrets/brave.key`,
   then `~/.config/dsh-reliable-web/brave.key`.

Only the first non-empty line of the file is used, so a trailing newline is
fine. Keep the file at mode `600`. When no key is found, the engine is skipped
with a debug line and the keyless chain is unchanged. Brave's per-second limit
depends on the plan (the free tier is typically one request per second), so the
plugin spaces Brave requests about 1.1s apart; a single query is not delayed,
and a multi-query `web_search` call queues instead of tripping a 429.

**Never commit the key.** The repository ignores `.env*`, `.secrets/`, and
`*.key`; the recommended locations are outside it.

Quality comes from **fusion**, not from picking a favorite engine:

- each engine's per-result contribution is `weight / (k + rank)`, so a document
  several independent indexes rank highly outranks one that only a single index
  ranks first (reciprocal rank fusion);
- URLs are canonicalized for dedupe — fragments and tracking parameters folded
  out of the key, `www.` and scheme folded, trailing slashes folded, GitHub blob
  URLs collapsed across branch/commit refs; the displayed URL keeps its fragment
  but drops tracking parameters;
- snippets and titles come from the most authoritative engine that returned the
  document, with gaps filled by the others.

Reliability is separate from quality:

- a failed, throttled, or empty engine is cooled down (rate limits 60s, quota
  and auth 30min, transient 15s) and the chain continues;
- every engine shares one wall-clock budget (`searchBudgetMs`);
- a short TTL cache (5 min, 256 entries, LRU) serves repeated queries without
  touching any upstream, which matters on per-address free tiers;
- `truncated` is honest: it means sources were actually dropped, not merely that
  the requested count was reached.

If every non-cooling engine fails, the call throws a structured
`WEB_PROVIDER_ERROR` rather than pretending the web has no results. If engines
answer with nothing, it returns an empty successful result.

## Fetch

Retrieval escalates only when it must:

1. **direct**, SSRF-safe HTTP(S). No third party sees the URL. HTML is returned
   as `kind: 'html'` so the Harness's own converter produces the model-facing
   markdown. This is the fast path for ordinary pages.
2. **readers** (`jina`, `exa`, `firecrawl`), launched concurrently, only when
   direct was refused (401/403/406/429/451/503), is a bot challenge, is a
   client-rendered shell, or failed at the transport level. They render the page
   on their own infrastructure and return markdown, which recovers pages direct
   retrieval cannot see.
3. a definitive direct status such as `404`/`410` is returned as a result
   immediately — a reader would only repeat it slower.

A readable success always beats a bot wall or an error page. A `404` is a
result, not an exception. One deadline (`fetchBudgetMs`, 25s) covers the whole
chain, leaving headroom under the tool's 30s cooperative budget so a timeout is
reported precisely instead of as an opaque `TOOL_TIMEOUT`.

### SSRF and resource safety

The transport is self-contained and fails closed:

- only `http:`/`https:`, no embedded credentials, 2048-character URL limit;
- every hop is re-parsed, re-screened, and re-pinned, so redirects cannot
  escape the public-address policy;
- every resolved address must be public; loopback, private, link-local, CGNAT,
  benchmark, multicast, documentation, and reserved ranges are refused, for
  literals and resolved names alike;
- the connection is pinned to the validated address set, so a DNS answer cannot
  change between check and connect;
- response bytes, redirect hops, and converted characters are capped;
- decompression is bounded, so a compressed body cannot expand without limit.

`allowPrivateNetwork: true` exists for a local/intranet deployment and is off by
default; it is the one setting that lets a model reach cloud metadata and local
services.

## Configuration

The row is `reliable-web`. Every field is optional.

```yaml
- id: reliable-web
  name: 'dsh-reliable-web'
  config:
    # search
    engineOrder: ['exa', 'parallel', 'brave', 'tavily', 'keenable', 'anysearch', 'firecrawl', 'duckduckgo', 'wikipedia']
    disabledEngines: []
    searchBudgetMs: 25000
    searchFanout: 3
    searchTimeoutMs: 12000
    searchCacheTtlMs: 300000      # 0 disables the cache
    braveApiKey: ''               # prefer BRAVE_API_KE

plugins.description: DSH 自定义主题：多套主题、配色、壁纸、背景音乐、首屏立绘与多条文案。 · Custom theme studio for DeepSeek Harness.
